records.title: Machine Learning Algorithms for Predicting Cobb Angle Beyond 25° in Female Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Patients.
records.clinical_problem: predicting which female adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis will progress to a Cobb angle beyond 25°, using minimal radiographic and questionnaire data collected at the first visit
records.patient_population: 1,119 female adolescent idiopathic scoliosis patients treated at a single institution, July 2011-February 2023
records.model_description: Machine learning binary classification models (built with PyCaret) trained on first-visit demographic and whole-spine radiographic data to predict progression to Cobb angle >25° for proximal thoracic, main thoracic, and thoracolumbar/lumbar curves
records.headline_result: AUC 0.94 (proximal thoracic), 0.89 (main thoracic), 0.84 (thoracolumbar/lumbar); recall 0.90/0.85/0.81 respectively

records.title: Brain Alteration Patterns in Children with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy: A Machine Learning Approach to Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
records.model_family: support vector machine on multimodal structural and diffusion measures
records.clinical_problem: whether the absent dystrophin in Duchenne muscular dystrophy leaves a detectable mark on the brain, which would explain the cognitive and behavioral features
records.patient_population: 18 children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy and 18 age- and sex-matched controls with similar cognitive and behavioral profiles
records.model_description: Combines cortical thickness, structure volumes and diffusion measures in one multivariate classifier, with controls deliberately matched on cognitive and behavioral profile so that the classification cannot simply be picking up comorbidity. The forward model then localizes the signal to long fiber bundles — cerebellar peduncles, posterior thalamic radiation, fornix, medial lemniscus — and to motor, cingulate, hippocampal and insular cortex. The sample is small and the accuracy correspondingly optimistic.
records.headline_result: 97.2% classification accuracy between patients and matched controls

records.title: Diagnostic accuracy of convolutional neural network algorithms to distinguish gastrointestinal obstruction on conventional radiographs in a pediatric population.
records.clinical_problem: differentiating normal pediatric abdominal radiographs from gastrointestinal dilatation/obstruction, and surgical from non-surgical causes
records.patient_population: pediatric patients with abdominal radiographs: 540 normal, 298 surgically-corrected dilatation, 314 inflammatory/infectious dilatation, single center
records.model_description: Five transfer-learning CNN models classify pediatric abdominal radiographs as normal, surgically-corrected dilatation, or inflammatory/infectious dilatation, with and without an automated image-cropping preprocessing step.
records.headline_result: Best accuracy 96.9% (ConvNeXtXLarge with cropping) for normal vs abnormal; 94.6% (EfficientNetV2L) for surgical vs inflammatory dilatation

records.title: Predicting Cardiac Magnetic Resonance-Derived Ejection Fraction from Echocardiogram Via Deep Learning Approach in Tetralogy of Fallot.

records.model_description: The EchoNet-Dynamic/EchoNet-Peds CNN model, fine-tuned via transfer learning, predicts left ventricular ejection fraction from echocardiogram videos using cardiac MRI-derived ejection fraction as ground truth in Tetralogy of Fallot patients.
records.headline_result: PSAX view: R2 0.79, MAE 4.41; A4C view: R2 0.53, MAE 6.4
records.study_design: retrospective model fine-tuning and validation study

records.title: Perceived Racism, Brain Development, and Internalizing and Externalizing Symptoms: Findings From the ABCD Study.
records.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry
records.body_region: brain (subcortical regions: amygdala, hippocampus, nucleus accumbens)
records.clinical_problem: assessing effects of perceived racial discrimination on longitudinal subcortical functional connectivity changes and internalizing/externalizing symptoms in adolescents
records.patient_population: 3,321 racial/ethnic minority youth from the ABCD study, split into training (n=2,674) and testing (n=647) sets
records.model_description: Resting-state fMRI functional connectivity of the nucleus accumbens, amygdala, and hippocampus is measured at baseline and two years later in adolescents from the ABCD study. Propensity score-weighted machine learning, trained and cross-validated on 80% of the sample and independently tested on the remaining 20%, assesses the effect of perceived discrimination on 2-year connectivity changes, followed by mediation analyses linking these brain changes to internalizing and externalizing symptoms.
records.headline_result: Perceived discrimination was significantly associated with 2-year connectivity changes in nucleus accumbens, amygdala, and hippocampus in both cross-validation and independent testing

records.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recognition of Fetal Open Neural Tube Defect on Prenatal Ultrasound.

records.clinical_problem: recognizing open fetal neural tube defect (open spina bifida) via the lemon sign on axial cranial ultrasound using deep learning
records.patient_population: 59 fetuses with open neural tube defect and 116 normal controls, 14-28 weeks gestation
records.model_description: Input: axial trans-thalamic fetal cranial ultrasound images; output: CNN transfer-learning classification of normal vs. open neural tube defect (lemon sign) fetuses.
records.headline_result: EfficientNet B0 achieved 100%/95.83% training/validation accuracy, sensitivity 100%, specificity 89%

records.title: Automated Neonatal Hip Ultrasound System for Diagnosing Developmental Dysplasia of Hips Using Assistive AI.
records.journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
records.model_family: convolutional neural network (NASNetMobile, MobileNetV1, DenseNet121, EfficientNetV2B0, ResNet50; segmentation: UnestedUNet, DeepLabV3Plus)
records.clinical_problem: Can an AI-assisted portable ultrasound system diagnose developmental dysplasia of the hip in newborns?
records.patient_population: newborns undergoing hip ultrasonography
records.model_description: An AI diagnostic system, integrated with a smartphone-linked handheld ultrasound device, segments hip anatomy and calculates Graf angles to diagnose DDH; several CNN backbones were compared for classification and segmentation.
records.headline_result: NASNetMobile AUC 0.864 (95% CI 0.850-0.878); average Graf angle error rate 0.21 vs expert
records.study_design: retrospective model development and comparison study

records.title: A Deep Learning-Based Framework for Automatic Determination of Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip from Graf Angles.
records.journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine

records.patient_population: newborn hip ultrasound images
records.model_description: A deep learning framework (DeepLabv3+ with multiple backbone architectures) segments hip anatomy on ultrasound and uses a local maxima method to automatically determine Graf angles for DDH diagnosis.
records.headline_result: MobileNetV2 backbone: 94.64% accuracy, 86.99 Cohen's kappa, 94.31 F-score vs expert radiologists
records.study_design: retrospective method development and comparison study

records.title: Evaluating the reference accuracy of large language models in radiology: a comparative study across subspecialties.
records.clinical_problem: evaluating whether large language models can generate accurate, non-fabricated bibliographic references for radiology literature review/education questions, including in pediatric radiology
records.model_description: Six general-purpose large language models (ChatGPT o1-preview, ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-4o with canvas, Google Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Opus) were prompted with 120 open-ended radiology questions (15 per subspecialty, including pediatric radiology) to generate cited references, and each response's reference accuracy and fabrication rate were scored against verified bibliographic sources.
records.release_evidence: named commercial products: ChatGPT (OpenAI), Google Gemini, Claude (Anthropic)
records.dataset_size: 120 questions (15 per subspecialty) across 8 radiology subspecialties
records.headline_result: Claude 3.5 Sonnet: 80.8% fully accurate references, 3.1% fabrication rate, significantly outperforming other models (P<0.001)
records.study_design: cross-sectional observational comparative study of LLM-generated radiology references

records.patient_population: 52 pediatric patients with diffuse midline glioma (H3 K27M-altered), 70 MRI studies
records.model_description: A modified 3D U-Net with residual blocks takes T1-weighted and T2-weighted/FLAIR MRI (individually or combined) as input and outputs a segmentation mask of the DMG tumor.
records.headline_result: Average Dice Similarity Coefficient of 0.883 on the test dataset (best with combined T1W + T2W/FLAIR)

records.title: Identification of Atypical Scoliosis Patterns Using X-ray Images Based on Fine-Grained Techniques in Deep Learning.

records.model_description: Several ResNet-50-based fine-grained classification models (Coronal, Sagittal, Dual, Concat, Bilinear variants) take coronal and/or sagittal spine radiographs as input and output a scoliosis diagnosis and, for scoliotic cases, a classification distinguishing atypical (Chiari-malformation-associated) from typical adolescent idiopathic scoliosis; heatmaps highlight the radiographic features driving classification.
records.dataset_size: 508 pairs of coronal and sagittal spinal radiographs
records.headline_result: ResNet-50 Dual model reached the diagnostic level of senior spine surgeons for CMS diagnosis; ResNet-50 Coronal model surpassed senior surgeons in specificity and PPV

records.title: Automated Sella-Turcica Annotation and Mesh Alignment of 3D Stereophotographs for Craniosynostosis Patients Using a PCA-FFNN Based Approach.
records.model_family: PCA-FFNN (Principal Component Analysis + Feedforward Neural Network)
records.clinical_problem: Noninvasively predicting the Sella turcica reference point for aligning 3D cranial stereophotographs in infants with craniosynostosis, to avoid the radiation of repeated CT for cranial morphology assessment.
records.patient_population: 153 CT scans, including 68 craniosynostosis subjects (infants)
records.model_description: A PCA-FFNN model takes 3D cranial surface models (derived from CT/stereophotography) as input and predicts the Sella turcica coordinate, used to align 3D stereophotographs within a standardized reference frame as a noninvasive alternative to CT-based cranial assessment.
records.headline_result: PCA-FFNN achieved significantly lower Sella turcica coordinate prediction error than the conventional CCFP method (3.61 vs. 8.38 mm, P < 0.001)
records.study_design: retrospective model development and comparison study

records.title: Quantifying Sagittal Craniosynostosis Severity: A Machine Learning Approach With CranioRate.
records.journal: The Cleft palate-craniofacial journal : official publication of the American Cleft Palate-Craniofacial Association
records.model_family: machine learning (supervised Sagittal Severity Score + unsupervised Cranial Morphology Deviation)
records.clinical_problem: objectively quantifying the severity of sagittal craniosynostosis to standardize assessment and surgical planning
records.patient_population: 195 nonsyndromic sagittal craniosynostosis, 221 nonsyndromic metopic craniosynostosis, 178 age-matched controls; 54 surgeons rated 20 patients' CT scans
records.model_description: CranioRate uses a supervised machine learning model (Sagittal Severity Score, trained on surgeon Likert ratings) and an unsupervised model (Cranial Morphology Deviation) on CT-derived cranial landmarks to quantify sagittal craniosynostosis severity, compared against the traditional cephalic index.
records.dataset_size: 195 SCS, 221 metopic CS, 178 controls; 54 surgeons rated 20 CT scans
records.headline_result: Sagittal Severity Score significantly more accurate than cephalic index in predicting expert ratings (P<.05); Cranial Morphology Deviation correlated with SSS (Pearson 0.92)
records.study_design: cross-sectional model development with expert rating comparison

records.title: Characterization of Healthy Pancreas Morphology Throughout Childhood.

records.patient_population: 223 subjects from ABIDE database (120 ASD) for training/test; independent external test of 87 participants (38 ASD) from Georgetown/Miami ASD datasets

records.title: Use of imaging biomarkers and ambulatory functional endpoints in Duchenne muscular dystrophy clinical trials: Systematic review and machine learning-driven trend analysis.

records.patient_population: 85 DMD trials and non-interventional studies (2010-2022), primarily pediatric males
records.model_description: A systematic review of 85 DMD trials characterizes the use of MRI imaging biomarkers versus functional endpoints for tracking disease progression; an XGBoost machine learning model analyzes trial-level predictors (duration, start year) of imaging biomarker adoption over time.
records.headline_result: Only 13.3% of biologic intervention trials incorporated imaging biomarkers versus 93% using ambulatory functional endpoints; imaging biomarker studies averaged 4.5 years duration
records.study_design: systematic review with machine learning trend analysis

records.title: A comparative study of the interpretation results of different artificial intelligence bone age assessment software.

records.clinical_problem: skeletal maturity / bone age assessment
records.patient_population: children and adolescents aged 3-17 years undergoing bone age assessment
records.model_description: Three commercial AI products (YIZHUN-TW3, LIANYING-TW3, AIBAA-TW3) each take a hand-wrist radiograph and output a bone age using the Tanner-Whitehouse 3 (TW3) method. records.title: First-trimester Placental Ultrasound (FirstPLUS) study: prediction of fetal growth restriction using OxNNet-derived first-trimester placental volume.

records.title: Precision medicine in Moyamoya vasculopathy.

records.title: Clinically Generalizable Low-Dose CT Denoising for Pediatric Imaging via Enhanced Diffusion Posterior Sampling.
records.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics

records.model_description: An enhanced diffusion posterior sampling (E-DPS) framework combines a one-step U-Net denoiser (trained on simulated low-dose/normal-dose CT pairs) with an unconditional diffusion model prior, taking a noisy low-dose CT image as input and producing a denoised, normal-dose-quality CT image.
records.headline_result: PSNR gains of +5.2% and +4.3% at unseen dose levels vs state-of-the-art methods; strong zero-shot generalizability on real low-dose CT
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development study using simulated and real low-dose CT data

records.patient_population: 220 multi-source 3D CBCT/CT images from Canada, Chile, and France, covering both adult and pediatric scans
records.model_description: A multi-source nnU-Net segments the entire upper airway from CBCT and CT scans, validated with a one-center-out approach on an independent institution's data.
records.headline_result: average Dice score 0.962; absolute volume difference 3.31% vs manual segmentation
records.study_design: retrospective multi-source model development with one-center-out external validation

records.title: Deep learning-based automatic adenoid segmentation and a novel volume-based index for adenoid hypertrophy assessment.
records.clinical_problem: Accurately measuring adenoid volume and quantifying nasopharyngeal airway obstruction in three dimensions for pediatric adenoid hypertrophy / obstructive sleep apnea
records.patient_population: three CBCT datasets: 63 pediatric OSA patients (pre/post adenoidectomy), 26 more post-adenoidectomy patients, 161 patients with polysomnography+CBCT
records.model_description: A SegResNet-based deep learning model, trained on preoperative cone-beam CT to predict postoperative airway morphology after adenoidectomy, segments the adenoid (via the volumetric difference) and computes a novel Three-Dimensional Adenoidal-Nasopharyngeal Ratio (3D-AN) index of airway obstruction.
records.dataset_size: 126 CBCT scans (63 patients) + 26 patients + 161 patients across three datasets
records.headline_result: Segmentation Dice similarity coefficient 0.88; relative volume error 0.09; 3D-AN ratio >0.18 correlated with OSA (r=0.56, P<0.01)

records.title: Recognition of Normal Fetal Echocardiograms Based on an Explainable Denoising Deep Learning Model.
records.model_family: Vision Transformer with denoising-guided attention module
records.clinical_problem: classifying normal fetal echocardiogram views
records.patient_population: 358 fetal cardiac ultrasound exams, 2,501 images
records.model_description: GSCAViT is a denoising vision-transformer model that classifies seven types of normal fetal echocardiogram views, using SHAP to highlight the cardiac structures driving classification.
records.headline_result: accuracy 97.1% (validation), 99.4%/81.3%/72.9% on three test sets
records.study_design: retrospective model development with validation and three test sets

records.title: The 4D Human Embryonic Brain Atlas: Spatiotemporal atlas generation for rapid anatomical changes.
records.journal: Computerized medical imaging and graphics : the official journal of the Computerized Medical Imaging Society
records.clinical_problem: Characterize normal embryonic brain anatomical development over time on ultrasound to help identify deviations from normal development
records.patient_population: 402 subjects (831 3D ultrasound images) from the Rotterdam Periconceptional Cohort, gestational weeks 8-12
records.model_description: Takes 3D fetal ultrasound images across gestational weeks 8-12 and uses deep learning-based groupwise image registration with a time-dependent initial atlas to output a 4D (spatiotemporal) atlas of normal embryonic brain anatomy.
records.study_design: retrospective cohort study; spatiotemporal atlas construction with ablation study

records.title: Comparative performance evaluation of ChatGPT-4 Omni and Gemini Advanced in the Turkish Dentistry Specialization Exam.
records.exclusion_reason: dental board exam LLM benchmarking (ChatGPT/Gemini on dentistry specialization exam); non-imaging, not pediatric radiology

records.title: Biomarker discovery in Lennox-Gastaut syndrome: Advances and challenges in electrophysiological, genetic, neuroimaging, and neuroinflammatory approaches.
records.exclusion_reason: narrative review of epilepsy biomarkers (EEG, genetic, neuroimaging, inflammatory); AI mentioned only in passing as a future need, not a radiology-AI study

records.title: Towards contrast- and pathology-agnostic clinical fetal brain MRI segmentation using SynthSeg.
records.clinical_problem: Automatically segment fetal brain MRI structures despite differences in contrast, acquisition, and pathology (domain shift)
records.patient_population: fetal subjects with a wide range of pathologies and acquisition protocols
records.model_description: Takes fetal brain MRI (various contrasts/pathologies) and, using a novel data-driven train-time sampling strategy within the SynthSeg domain-randomization framework, outputs automated structural brain segmentations robust to domain shift.
records.headline_result: Notable improvement in segmentation quality on subjects with intense anatomical abnormalities (p<1e-4), with a slight decrease for cases with fewer abnormalities
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with ablation studies

records.title: Subcortical correlates of developmental language disorder: more than the neostriatum.
records.model_family: Multivariate machine learning (unspecified) alongside volumetric/microstructural group comparison
records.body_region: subcortical brain structures (caudate, putamen, globus pallidus, thalamus, hippocampus)
records.clinical_problem: Characterizing subcortical structural and microstructural brain correlates of developmental language disorder in children and adolescents.
records.patient_population: Children and adolescents with developmental language disorder, a history of language difficulties, and typically developing controls
records.model_description: Input: T1-weighted and diffusion MRI of subcortical structures. Volume and microstructure (DTI, NODDI) are compared between groups; multivariate machine learning relates hippocampal measures to language skills.
records.dataset_size: 156 children/adolescents (54 DLD, 74 typically developing, 28 with language-difficulty history), aged 10:0-15:11
records.study_design: Case-control structural and diffusion MRI study.

records.title: Attenuation-based ultra-low-dose lung computed tomography at 0.1 mSv to 0.3 mSv effective dose in children.
records.model_family: deep learning image reconstruction (vendor CT system)
records.clinical_problem: reducing radiation dose in pediatric lung CT while maintaining diagnostic image quality
records.patient_population: 106 pediatric patients (113 days to 17.85 years), 277 low-dose lung CT scans
records.model_description: A wide-detector energy-integrating CT scanner with deep-learning image reconstruction and attenuation-based auto-prescription is used to acquire ultra-low-dose pediatric lung CT scans, evaluated for radiation dose and image quality.
records.release_evidence: 256-slice-multidetector CT scanner with deep learning image reconstruction
records.headline_result: effective dose 0.12-0.23 mSv; all exams diagnostically sufficient
records.study_design: retrospective single-center dose and image-quality evaluation

records.title: Pubertal Hormones and the Early Adolescent Female Brain: A Multimodality Brain MRI Study.
records.clinical_problem: identifying brain structural and functional correlates of pubertal hormone levels in adolescent females
records.patient_population: 3024 adolescent females aged 8.92-13.33 years, ABCD Study
records.model_description: Elastic-net regression with cross-validation relates estradiol, testosterone and DHEA levels to multimodal MRI brain features (cortical thickness, sulcal depth, white matter microstructure, resting-state connectivity) in adolescent females.
records.study_design: cross-sectional multimodal MRI association study using machine learning

records.title: Noise in the diagnosis of epilepsy by experts.
records.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
records.exclusion_reason: non-imaging (EEG/clinical diagnosis variability); AI mentioned only as a future possibility

records.title: Connectome-based predictive modelling of problematic gaming in youth from the ABCD study.
records.clinical_problem: Identifying brain functional-connectivity networks predictive of problematic video-gaming severity in youth, using task-based and resting-state fMRI
records.patient_population: 1,036 participants from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study, mean age 12.0 years
records.model_description: Connectome-based predictive modelling (CPM), a machine-learning approach using whole-brain functional connectivity from task-based and resting-state fMRI, predicts problematic-gaming severity scores in youth.
records.headline_result: CPM predicted problematic-gaming scores r=0.12, p=0.002
records.study_design: cross-sectional cohort study with machine-learning predictive modeling

records.title: First trimester prediction of gestational diabetes mellitus by machine learning in twin pregnancies.
records.exclusion_reason: non-imaging AI (tabular/clinical/lab prediction of maternal gestational diabetes, not an imaging-based model)

records.title: Development of a Deep Learning Algorithm for Posterior Fossa Abnormality Recognition on First-Trimester US Screening Scans: AIRFRAME Study Part 1.
records.clinical_problem: Detect open spina bifida and cystic posterior fossa anomalies from first-trimester fetal ultrasound screening images of the posterior fossa
records.patient_population: 251 fetuses (150 normal, 101 abnormal: 43 OSB, 58 CPF) from 10 international fetal medicine centers, 11-14 weeks gestation
records.model_description: Takes midsagittal fetal brain ultrasound images from 11-14 week screening scans and, via an ensemble of convolutional neural networks (MobileNetV3 Large Weights best), classifies the posterior fossa as normal or showing open spina bifida / cystic posterior fossa anomaly.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.94, accuracy 88%, recall 81%, specificity 93% on internal test set (MobileNetV3 Large Weights)
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter study with threefold cross-validation and ensemble internal test evaluation

records.title: Advancements in radiation dose reduction for pediatric CT head Imaging: A scoping review of emerging Technologies, Protocols, and optimization strategies.
records.journal: Technical innovations & patient support in radiation oncology
records.clinical_problem: Reviewing methods to reduce radiation dose in pediatric CT head imaging while maintaining diagnostic image quality, including AI-based deep-learning image reconstruction
records.model_description: Scoping review of 24 articles on radiation-dose reduction techniques for pediatric CT head imaging, concluding that deep-learning image reconstruction (DLIR) algorithms enhance image quality at ultra-low radiation doses compared with conventional reduction techniques.

records.title: Artificial intelligence-enabled pediatric radiology in low-resource settings: addressing resource constraints in the African healthcare system.
records.clinical_problem: implementing AI in pediatric radiology under resource constraints (Sub-Saharan Africa)
records.model_description: Narrative review discussing barriers (hardware, annotated pediatric datasets, PACS integration, infrastructure) to deploying AI (image synthesis, reconstruction, segmentation) in pediatric radiology across African healthcare systems, and proposed solutions (federated learning, open datasets).

records.title: Fractal-geometry analysis of pediatric posterior fossa tumors - a preoperative tool for prediction of histopathology.
records.model_family: fractal geometry analysis with logistic regression
records.clinical_problem: preoperative prediction of histopathology of pediatric posterior fossa tumors
records.patient_population: 44 pediatric patients who underwent surgery for posterior fossa tumors
records.model_description: Fractal dimension and lacunarity index are extracted from segmented preoperative MRI (T1, ceT1, T2, FLAIR) and combined via logistic regression to predict tumor histopathological type before surgery.

records.title: Data-driven pediatric ECG reference intervals with VSD-based validation.
records.exclusion_reason: non-imaging (ECG reference intervals; no radiologic imaging)

records.title: Decreased levels of N-Acetylaspartyglutamate, myo-inositol, and syllo-inositol, in cortical brain regions of women exposed to adverse childhood experiences.
records.exclusion_reason: adult-only study (adverse childhood experiences studied in women aged 19-31)

records.title: Hierarchical maturation of structural brain connectomes from birth to childhood.
records.exclusion_reason: no trained model stated

records.title: Aperiodic parameters of the fMRI power spectrum associate with preterm birth and neonatal age.
records.model_family: machine learning regression on aperiodic BOLD parameters
records.clinical_problem: characterizing associations of functional brain activity with preterm birth and predicting postmenstrual age
records.patient_population: neonates from the Developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP), preterm and full-term
records.model_description: Aperiodic components of the resting-state fMRI BOLD power spectrum from 90 brain regions are used with a machine learning regression model to predict a neonate's postmenstrual age and to differentiate preterm from full-term groups.
records.headline_result: age prediction test R2 0.20-0.41
records.study_design: retrospective observational study using a public dataset

records.title: Deep learning-based automated contrast enema analysis to improve the assessment of Hirschsprung disease.
records.clinical_problem: assessing Hirschsprung disease on contrast enema
records.patient_population: 221 pediatric patients (278 contrast enemas), mean age 4.14 years
records.model_description: A pretrained DenseNet121 classifier analyzes contrast enema images to detect findings suggestive of Hirschsprung disease, benchmarked against rectal biopsy as reference standard and historical radiologist assessment.
records.headline_result: balanced accuracy 82.8% at contrast-enema level, AUC-ROC 0.830 vs radiologists' 0.804

records.title: The application of artificial intelligence in blind ultrasound sweep diagnostics for prenatal medicine: A systematic literature review.
records.clinical_problem: using AI on minimally-trained blind ultrasound sweeps to expand access to prenatal diagnostics
records.patient_population: 14 studies (12 original, 2 reviews) of AI applied to blind-sweep obstetric ultrasound
records.model_description: Systematic review of AI models applied to standardized 'blind' transabdominal ultrasound sweeps performed by minimally trained operators, for gestational age estimation, breech detection, amniotic fluid assessment, and fetal anatomy segmentation.
records.headline_result: gestational age MAE 3-5 days; breech detection AUC ~0.98; amniotic fluid Dice ~0.88

records.title: Deep learning assessment of fetal brain maturation on 3D ultrasound volumes in early-onset fetal growth restriction.
records.journal: Ultrasound in obstetrics & gynecology : the official journal of the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology
records.clinical_problem: Quantifying fetal brain maturation via ultrasound-based gestational-age estimation in early-onset fetal growth restriction, to assess whether delayed maturation predicts neonatal complications
records.patient_population: 43 growth-restricted fetuses (13 brain-sparing), single-center prospective (Netherlands)
records.model_description: A deep-learning model trained on optimally developing fetuses estimates gestational age from the size/shape of brain fissures and structures (Sylvian fissure, parieto-occipital fissure, calcarine sulcus, cerebellum) on 3D ultrasound; the difference from true gestational age serves as a maturation-delay marker in growth-restricted fetuses.
records.headline_result: Estimated GA significantly lower than actual GA (deltaGA -3.2 to -5.4 days across measures, P<0.0001); greater delay associated with perinatal complications

records.title: Evaluating the Role of Artificial Intelligence in Fetal Medicine: Opportunities, Evidence, and Challenges, A Narrative Review.
records.clinical_problem: state of AI for prenatal anomaly detection, biometric analysis, and fetal diagnostics
records.patient_population: fetuses
records.model_description: narrative review of AI applications in fetal medicine, including congenital heart defect identification, brain structure segmentation, and fetal growth prediction

records.title: The current state of artificial intelligence research in pediatric radiology and recommendations for the future: a scoping review.
records.clinical_problem: mapping the landscape of AI research applied to pediatric radiology across clinical applications, modalities and subspecialties (2005-2024)
records.patient_population: 789 included articles on pediatric patients (<18 years), screened from 4,376
records.model_description: Scoping review of 789 articles (from 4,376 screened) applying AI to pediatric radiology, characterizing country of origin, imaging modality, subspecialty and AI task type.
records.headline_result: 789/4,376 articles included; top modalities radiography 37.8%, MRI 33.0%, ultrasound 14.4%; image interpretation/diagnosis 91.1% of tasks

records.title: Predictive associations between brain functional connectivity, motor abilities, and executive function development in early childhood: a longitudinal machine learning study.
records.model_family: graph neural network with multimodal feature fusion
records.clinical_problem: predicting motor and executive function developmental trajectories from brain connectivity in early childhood
records.patient_population: 256 healthy preschool children aged 3-6 years
records.model_description: A graph neural network combines resting-state fMRI functional connectivity with motor and cognitive test scores to predict subsequent (12-month) motor and executive function outcomes in preschoolers.
records.headline_result: 76.8+/-4.3% accuracy for motor outcomes, 74.2+/-3.9% for executive function outcomes

records.title: Functional neurobehaviour of the human fetus: a comprehensive framework for prenatal assessment using 4D ultrasound and AI.
records.clinical_problem: Reviewing 4D ultrasound, structured scoring systems and AI platforms for prenatal assessment of fetal neurobehaviour to identify neurodevelopmental vulnerability
records.patient_population: 50 studies reviewed (2000-2025)
records.model_description: Narrative review of 4D-ultrasound-based fetal neurobehavioural assessment tools (KANET, prenatal General Movements Assessment) and AI-assisted classifiers providing objective quantification of fetal movement and facial activity from ultrasound video.

records.title: Mass Spectrometry-Based Metabolomics in Pediatric Health and Disease.
records.exclusion_reason: review of mass-spectrometry metabolomics in pediatrics; not an imaging or radiology topic

records.title: Artificial intelligence in diagnosis of pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders: a scoping review.
records.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI technologies (deep learning, machine learning, decision support, biosignal analysis) for diagnosing pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders, including neuroimaging-based diagnosis
records.patient_population: 22 studies reviewed
records.model_description: Scoping review of 22 studies: deep-learning models applied to neuroimaging achieved diagnostic accuracies exceeding 85% for pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders, while supervised machine learning improved autism/ADHD subtype classification.
records.headline_result: Deep-learning models exceeded 85% diagnostic accuracy in neuroimaging interpretation in most included studies

records.title: Diagnostic Performance of ChatGPT-5 for Detecting Pediatric Pneumothorax on Chest Radiographs: A Multi-Prompt Evaluation.
records.clinical_problem: Detect and localize pneumothorax on pediatric chest radiographs
records.patient_population: 380 pediatric chest radiographs (190 pneumothorax, 190 matched controls) from a tertiary hospital
records.model_description: Takes pediatric chest radiographs as input to ChatGPT-5 under three prompting strategies (instructional, role-based, clinical-context) and outputs a pneumothorax detection/localization judgment.
records.release_evidence: ChatGPT-5, a multimodal large language model
records.dataset_size: 380 pediatric chest radiographs (190 pneumothorax cases, 190 matched controls)
records.headline_result: Accuracy 0.77-0.79, specificity 0.96-0.98, sensitivity 0.57-0.61 (lower for small pneumothoraces: 0.18-0.46)

records.title: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Pediatric Endocrine Tumors: Opportunities, Pitfalls, and a Roadmap for Trustworthy Clinical Translation.
records.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI/ML applications, most robust in imaging, for diagnosis, risk stratification and treatment-response assessment in pediatric endocrine tumors
records.model_description: Pediatric-focused narrative review of AI/ML in endocrine tumors, covering imaging-based approaches such as CT/PET radiomics for metastatic risk and treatment response (largely extrapolated from adult evidence) alongside survival-prediction and recurrence models.

records.title: Three-Dimensional Visualization and Detection of the Pulmonary Venous-Left Atrium Connection Using Artificial Intelligence in Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Screening.
records.model_family: 3D CNN / transformer segmentation models (SegResNet, Swin UNETR, MedNeXt, SegFormer3D)
records.clinical_problem: Detect the pulmonary venous-left atrium connection on fetal cardiac ultrasound to screen for total anomalous pulmonary venous connection (TAPVC)
records.patient_population: 106 fetuses (100 normal, 6 TAPVC cases)
records.model_description: Takes fetal cardiac ultrasound videos and applies 3D segmentation models (SegResNet, Swin UNETR, MedNeXt, SegFormer3D) to segment the pulmonary venous-left atrium junction, then computes distance and angle measurements to screen for TAPVC.
records.headline_result: Best AUC for TAPVC screening: 0.844 (MedNeXt-PLD), 0.840 (SegResNet-PLA)

records.title: Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Dentistry: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
records.exclusion_reason: Systematic review of AI in pediatric dentistry; non-radiologic (dental) imaging

records.title: Artificial Intelligence in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery: Integrating Clinical Innovation and Workflow Optimization.
records.exclusion_reason: Review of AI in oral and maxillofacial surgery; dental/OMFS focus, not pediatric-specific or radiologic

records.journal: Zhejiang da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Zhejiang University. Medical sciences
records.exclusion_reason: non-imaging AI (auscultation/audio signal analysis, not radiologic imaging)

records.title: One-stop strabismus digital diagnosis via AI-integrated skin-like and wearable "Eyelectronics".
records.exclusion_reason: ophthalmic strabismus diagnosis via wearable skin strain sensors ('Eyelectronics'); non-radiologic imaging modality

records.title: IUGC: A benchmark of landmark detection in end-to-end intrapartum ultrasound biometry.
records.model_family: various (foundation model distillation, ensemble learning - challenge, multiple submitted frameworks)
records.clinical_problem: Automatically detect anatomical landmarks (pubic symphysis, fetal head) on intrapartum ultrasound to measure the angle of progression for labor monitoring
records.patient_population: large-scale multi-center dataset, >32,000 images from 24 hospitals/research institutes
records.model_description: A benchmark challenge in which teams submitted end-to-end and semi-supervised models taking intrapartum ultrasound images and outputting pubic symphysis and fetal head landmark coordinates to compute the angle of progression.
records.dataset_size: >32,000 images from 24 hospitals and research institutes
records.headline_result: Winning team: Mean Radial Error 6.53+-4.38 px (right PS), 8.60+-5.06 px (left PS), 19.90+-17.55 px (FH tangent); AoP error 3.81+-3.12 deg
records.study_design: multi-center grand challenge benchmark (MICCAI 2025) comparing 10 teams' algorithms

records.title: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Sex and Age Estimation from Panoramic Radiographs in a Brazilian Young Population.
records.exclusion_reason: Dental panoramic radiograph forensic age/sex estimation; non-radiologic (dental) imaging

records.title: Deep learning in fetal, infant, and toddler neuroimaging research.
records.clinical_problem: Reviewing how deep learning methods are being applied to fetal, infant, and toddler brain imaging research, given the field's especially scarce datasets and high anatomical variability
records.patient_population: fetuses, infants and toddlers in neuroimaging research broadly
records.model_description: A narrative review, aimed at clinicians and developmental scientists without formal AI training, covering applications of deep learning in fetal, infant, and toddler neuroimaging research, including structural image analysis, enhancement of data acquisition, modeling of cognitive/perceptual processes, and automated video tagging.

records.title: A Comprehensive X-ray Dataset for Pediatric Ulna and Radius Fractures Analysis.
records.clinical_problem: Providing a large annotated dataset and baseline classifier for detecting and classifying pediatric forearm (ulna and radius) fractures on X-ray
records.patient_population: over 10,000 de-identified pediatric forearm radiographs
records.model_description: The PediURF dataset provides over 10,000 radiologist-annotated pediatric ulna/radius radiographs labeled by fracture type (proximal, midshaft, distal); URFNet, a dual-view (anteroposterior + lateral) classification model, is proposed and benchmarked on the dataset for automated fracture-type classification.
records.release_evidence: publicly available collection of >10,000 de-identified images (Scientific Data descriptor)
records.headline_result: URFNet achieved the best classification performance compared with other classification models (specific metric not given in abstract)
records.study_design: dataset descriptor with benchmark model development

records.title: Identifying scoliosis in a population-based adult cohort: automation of a validated method based on total body dual energy X-ray absorptiometry scans.
records.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society
records.exclusion_reason: adult-only study (population-based adult DXA cohort)

records.title: Generalizability of YOLOv11 models for mesiodens detection in pediatric panoramic radiographs.
records.exclusion_reason: non-radiologic imaging (dental panoramic radiograph)

records.title: Adolescents' ventral striatal reward neural activity moderates the association between lifetime trauma exposure and lower depression after 6 months.
records.exclusion_reason: no trained model stated

records.title: Functional fingerprinting for the developing brain using deep metric learning.
records.clinical_problem: Characterizing individual functional brain architecture ('fingerprints') during childhood and adolescence using deep learning on longitudinal fMRI
records.patient_population: longitudinal neuroimaging cohort, childhood through early adolescence
records.model_description: Metric-BolT, a deep metric learning framework, extracts individual 'brain fingerprints' from longitudinal functional MRI to identify subjects across scan sessions and characterize developmental trajectories.
records.headline_result: Identification accuracy 97.6% (within-session) and 86.6% (across 4 years)

records.title: Artificial intelligence-driven 3D surface-topography app for screening and monitoring adolescent scoliosis: early results from a single institution.
records.clinical_problem: Predicting Cobb angle from smartphone-based 3D surface topography to screen and monitor adolescent idiopathic scoliosis without radiation
records.patient_population: 125 patients (105 analyzed after exclusions) plus external data (142 controls, 188 scoliosis patients)
records.model_description: An AI-powered smartphone application analyzes 3D surface-topography scans (standing and forward-bending) to predict radiographic Cobb angle for scoliosis screening and monitoring.
records.dataset_size: 125 patients (79 training, 26 validation) + 142 external controls, 188 external scoliosis patients
records.headline_result: Correlation with radiographs r=0.922; MAE 5.9 deg overall, 6.4 deg in AIS 10-50 deg; AUC 0.978 at 10 deg, 0.917 at 25 deg, 1.000 at 40 deg
records.study_design: single-institution observational validation study with external data augmentation

records.title: Artificial intelligence in emergency medicine: a narrative review.
records.journal: The American journal of emergency medicine
records.exclusion_reason: General narrative review of AI in emergency medicine; pediatric radiology mentioned only briefly among many EM applications

records.title: A probabilistic deep learning approach for choroid plexus segmentation in autism spectrum disorder.
records.clinical_problem: segmenting the choroid plexus to study morphological alterations in autism spectrum disorder
records.patient_population: local ASD/control cohort (adults) and the ABIDE dataset (children and adults)
records.model_description: ASCHOPLEX is a finetunable deep learning tool that segments the choroid plexus on brain MRI, with a probabilistic version added to quantify segmentation uncertainty; tested for generalizability to ASD cohorts including children.
records.dataset_size: local dataset plus the ABIDE dataset
records.headline_result: generalized well in adults; accuracy declined in children (no single number given)
records.study_design: retrospective model finetuning and multi-dataset validation

records.title: Altered white matter integrity in pediatric bipolar disorder and the potential role of psychotic symptoms revealed by free water elimination corrected and superficial white matter DTI analyses.
records.model_family: support vector machine (SVM) with leave-one-out cross-validation
records.clinical_problem: distinguishing pediatric bipolar disorder (with or without psychotic symptoms) from healthy controls using diffusion tensor imaging white matter metrics
records.patient_population: 27 patients with pediatric bipolar disorder and psychotic symptoms, 25 with pediatric bipolar disorder without psychosis, and 19 healthy controls
records.model_description: Input is diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) metrics (fractional, mean, radial and axial diffusivity) from standard, free-water-corrected, and superficial white matter models. A support vector machine with leave-one-out cross-validation uses regional DTI metrics to distinguish children/adolescents with pediatric bipolar disorder (with or without psychotic symptoms) from healthy controls. The abstract states the altered regions could effectively discriminate the groups but gives no numeric accuracy.
records.dataset_size: 71 participants (27 PBD with psychosis, 25 PBD without psychosis, 19 healthy controls)
records.headline_result: SVM analyses with leave-one-out cross-validation reportedly discriminated PBD patients from healthy controls using altered DTI metrics; no accuracy percentage given

records.title: Performance of an adult-trained AI tool for intracranial hemorrhage detection on head CT in children aged 6-17 years.
records.clinical_problem: Evaluating whether an adult-trained, FDA-cleared AI tool for intracranial hemorrhage detection performs adequately on non-contrast head CT in children aged 6-17
records.patient_population: 1,996 non-contrast head CTs, children/adolescents 6-17 years, 21 sites
records.model_description: An FDA-cleared, adult-trained AI tool analyzes DICOM head CT images to flag intracranial hemorrhage; performance is compared against radiologist-adjudicated ground truth derived with an NLP tool applied to reports.
records.release_evidence: FDA-cleared, adult-trained AI tool for ICH detection
records.headline_result: Sensitivity 94.2%, specificity 94.7%, accuracy 94.6%, PPV 62.5%, NPV 99.4%

records.title: Radiation-free Cobb angle estimation in adolescent scoliosis using surface topography and a linear regression model.
records.clinical_problem: Predicting Cobb angle without radiation using 3D surface topography for adolescent scoliosis monitoring
records.model_description: Principal component analysis reduces dimensionality of 3D surface-topography data; several machine-learning models (linear regression, neural networks, XGBoost, stacking) were compared, with a linear regression model (LRM) selected as best for predicting Cobb angle.
records.headline_result: MAE 3.97 deg, RMSE 4.70 deg, correlation r=0.91 (linear regression model)
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and internal validation study

records.title: Hematologic markers and machine learning in predicting placenta accreta: A case-control study.
records.journal: International journal of gynaecology and obstetrics: the official organ of the International Federation of Gynaecology and Obstetrics
records.exclusion_reason: prediction model uses tabular clinical/hematologic markers and discrete documented ultrasound findings as inputs, not image-analysis AI

records.title: Infants have rich visual categories in ventrotemporal cortex at 2 months of age.

records.patient_population: more than 100 2-month-old infants (awake fMRI), with follow-up at 9 months
records.model_description: Input: awake fMRI responses to visual categories in infants; output: comparison of infants' neural representational geometry to that of a deep neural network model of vision, to characterize the developmental origin of visual category representations.
records.study_design: prospective developmental neuroimaging cohort study with computational model comparison

records.title: Performance Evaluation of a Commercial Deep Learning Software for Detecting Intracranial Hemorrhage in a Pediatric Population.
records.journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
records.clinical_problem: detecting intracranial hemorrhage on pediatric head CT
records.patient_population: 2,502 pediatric patients aged 6-17 undergoing head CT, single center
records.model_description: Aidoc, a commercial AI tool originally trained on adult data, analyzes head CT images to flag suspected intracranial hemorrhage; evaluated here in a pediatric population against a radiologist-adjudicated reference standard.
records.headline_result: sensitivity 96.0%, specificity 93.7%, accuracy 93.8%

records.title: Clinical Profile of Neurosurgical Consultations from the Emergency Department : A Retrospective Analysis.

records.title: Evaluating ChatGPT-5.0 in developmental dysplasia of the hip: A scenario-based validation study against AAOS and AAP guidelines.

records.title: 3D-QALAS synthetic MRI with Zero-DeepSub in children: initial experience including post-contrast imaging feasibility.

records.title: Image quality comparison between low-dose thin-slice deep-learning reconstruction and standard-dose thick-slice hybrid iterative reconstruction in pediatric abdominal CT.

records.title: Meconium metabolomic profiling dysregulation and neonatal brain injury in selective fetal growth restriction.

records.title: Automated Echocardiographic Detection of Congenital Heart Disease Using Artificial Intelligence.

records.title: Normative volumetric growth modeling of the whole fetal body, placenta and amniotic fluid for 3-dimensional T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences

records.clinical_problem: Automating volumetric measurement of the fetus, placenta and amniotic fluid on 3D reconstructed T2-weighted MRI to enable normative growth curves for clinical use
records.patient_population: 357 healthy control pregnancies (16-41 weeks GA) plus 95 longitudinal scans (42 fetuses) and 86 preterm pregnancies
records.model_description: A 3D U-Net, applied after deformable slice-to-volume 3D reconstruction of motion-corrupted T2-weighted MRI stacks, automatically segments the fetus, placenta and amniotic fluid; a reporting tool then generates centiles and z-scores for normative volumetric growth.
records.dataset_size: 357 healthy controls; 95 longitudinal scans (42 fetuses); 86 preterm pregnancies
records.headline_result: Automated 3D segmentation required only minor corrections (<1% volume difference) in <25% of control datasets; preterm pregnancies had significantly lower fetal, placental and amniotic-fluid volumes/centiles than term controls

records.title: Performance of adult-trained artificial intelligence models in paediatric imaging-a scoping review.

records.headline_result: pulmonary nodule detection sensitivity dropped from 68-100% (adults) to 26-68% (children); segmentation Dice score reductions >0.10 across organs and modalities; greatest deficits in children 2 years old or younger

records.headline_result: Best cutoff combination (sulcus angle + LPFA): sensitivity 98%, specificity 85%, AUC 0.97

records.title: Deep learning model for automated identification of ventrally positioned right hepatic artery in contrast-enhanced computed tomography of pediatric congenital biliary dilatation: development and clinical application.

records.patient_population: 232 patients with congenital biliary dilatation (116 with ventrally positioned right hepatic artery, 116 controls), single center
records.model_description: A YOLOv12-based model trained on radiologist-selected key arterial-phase CT slices detects a ventrally positioned right hepatic artery, a surgically important anatomic variant, in children with congenital biliary dilatation, and is compared against two radiologists.
records.headline_result: best sub-model (YOLOv12n) recall 0.842, F1 0.914, mAP50 0.989, AUC 0.977; outperformed junior radiologist (AUC 0.737, P<0.001), comparable to senior radiologist (AUC 0.947, P=0.515)

records.title: A 23-µJ-per-Frame All-on-Chip TinyML U-Net Processor for Real-Time Autonomous Image Segmentation in Miniaturized Ultrasound Devices.
records.journal: IEEE transactions on biomedical circuits and systems
records.clinical_problem: enabling real-time autonomous ultrasound image segmentation (e.g. prenatal fetal biometry, bladder/urinary retention monitoring) on wearable, battery-powered devices
records.patient_population: bladder and fetal head ultrasound segmentation datasets (not further specified)
records.model_description: A custom 28nm chip implements a binarized U-Net with 4-bit skip connections for on-device, real-time medical image segmentation in wearable ultrasound patches, validated on bladder and fetal head segmentation datasets, aiming to preserve accuracy while eliminating external memory and cutting energy use for battery-powered, privacy-preserving deployment.
records.headline_result: 13.4 frames per second, 23 microJ per frame on bladder and fetal head segmentation datasets

records.title: Towards Objective Obstetric Ultrasound Assessment: Contrastive Representation Learning for Fetal Movement Detection.

records.clinical_problem: objectively detecting fetal movement from ultrasound video to assess prenatal health
records.patient_population: 92 subjects, each with 30-minute extended fetal ultrasound video recordings
records.model_description: CURL is a self-supervised contrastive learning framework that learns motion representations from extended obstetric ultrasound video recordings, using a dual spatial-temporal contrastive loss and a task-specific sampling strategy, to detect fetal movement without relying on maternal perception or cardiotocography.
records.release_evidence: Our code is available at: https://github.com/Mr-TalhaIlyas/CURL/
records.headline_result: sensitivity 78.01%, AUROC 81.60%
records.study_design: retrospective technical development and validation study

records.title: Optimizing pediatric chest CT: superior image quality and lower radiation dose with deep learning reconstruction.
records.clinical_problem: Comparing image quality and radiation dose between deep-learning and hybrid iterative reconstruction in unenhanced pediatric chest CT
records.patient_population: 142 pediatric patients (<16 years), 2021-2024
records.model_description: Deep-learning image reconstruction (DLIR) is compared against hybrid iterative reconstruction (HIR) for unenhanced pediatric chest CT, assessing subjective and objective (noise, attenuation) image quality and radiation dose across age groups.
records.headline_result: Lower image noise with DLIR (e.g., lung 63 vs 81 HU, p=0.017); radiation dose reduced (CTDIvol 1.6 vs 4.3 mGy; effective dose 0.70 vs 2.51 mSv, p<0.001)

records.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted triage of pediatric supracondylar humerus fractures in emergency departments: A single-centre validation study.
records.clinical_problem: classifying and triaging pediatric supracondylar humerus fractures (Gartland system) into operative versus non-operative management in the emergency department
records.patient_population: 1,811 annotated AP/lateral radiographs from a single tertiary pediatric orthopedic center, 2010-2017; tested on 215 independent radiograph pairs
records.model_description: A convolutional neural network trained with transfer learning classifies pediatric elbow radiographs into operative (Gartland IIB, III, flexion type) versus non-operative supracondylar humerus fracture categories, to support emergency-department triage where specialist orthopedic input may not be immediately available.
records.headline_result: accuracy 77% (95% CI 71-82%), AUROC 0.84 (95% CI 0.78-0.89); kappa vs surgeon consensus 0.51

records.title: Altered brain network topology in adolescents with major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder: A resting-state fMRI graph-theoretical and machine learning study.
records.clinical_problem: distinguishing adolescent major depressive disorder from bipolar disorder using resting-state fMRI network features
records.patient_population: 125 adolescents aged 12-19 years (48 with major depressive disorder, 36 with bipolar disorder, 41 healthy controls)
records.model_description: Input is resting-state fMRI functional network features, including nodal centrality and clustering coefficient from graph-theoretical analysis. A support vector machine trained on these network features distinguishes adolescent major depressive disorder from bipolar disorder, driven mainly by insula and cingulate gyrus features. It is presented as a research classifier, not a validated diagnostic test.
records.dataset_size: 125 adolescents (48 MDD, 36 bipolar disorder, 41 healthy controls)
records.headline_result: SVM classifier distinguished adolescent MDD from bipolar disorder with 88.24% accuracy (p < 0.001)

records.title: Spinal morphology-based multimodal AI for predicting pulmonary dysfunction in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.
records.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society
records.model_family: dual-stream deep learning (EfficientNet + MLP with Feature-wise Linear Modulation)

records.journal: Journal of the Pediatric Orthopaedic Society of North America
records.model_family: deep learning automated segmentation + classification pipeline

records.title: Evidence-Guided Diagnostic Reasoning for Pediatric Chest Radiology Based on Multimodal Large Language Models.
records.model_family: vision-language model + multimodal large language model with retrieval-augmented generation
records.clinical_problem: generating interpretable, evidence-based diagnoses from pediatric chest radiographs
records.patient_population: VinDr-PCXR public pediatric chest radiograph dataset
records.model_description: A two-stage system: a vision-language model fine-tuned on pediatric data first extracts structured radiological findings from a chest radiograph, then a multimodal large language model combines the image, extracted findings, patient demographics, and retrieved external medical knowledge to generate a final diagnosis, aiming to mirror radiologists' evidence-based reasoning rather than a black-box classification.
records.headline_result: 90.1% diagnostic accuracy, 70.9% F1-score, 82.5% AUC; up to 13.1% accuracy improvement over baselines
records.study_design: retrospective technical development on a public benchmark dataset

records.title: Artificial intelligence and radiomics for pediatric brain tumor classification and molecular characterization: a systematic review.
records.clinical_problem: classifying pediatric brain tumors and predicting their molecular subtype from imaging
records.patient_population: children aged 0-18 with brain tumors, across 24 studies published 2010-2025
records.model_description: A systematic review that scores the methodological quality of the field rather than only its accuracy, using the Newcastle-Ottawa scale and the CLAIM checklist. The headline accuracies are high — median AUC 0.91 — and most studies were rated low risk of bias, but only three of 24 validated on an independent cohort. Radiomics still dominates over deep learning here, which reflects how small the available pediatric cohorts are.
records.headline_result: reported AUCs 0.73-0.98 (median 0.91); 96% used MRI and 88% radiomics-based machine learning; only 12.5% performed external validation

records.title: Automated Echocardiographic Detection of Congenital Heart Disease Using Artificial Intelligence.
records.model_family: multitask, view-agnostic transformer-based architecture (expands on PanEcho)
records.clinical_problem: automated detection of critical and non-critical congenital heart disease on echocardiography, to extend expert-level interpretation to under-resourced settings
records.patient_population: internal cohort: 54,727 echocardiograms (3.4 million videos) from Boston Children's Hospital, median age 7.1 years; referral cohort: 3,356 echocardiograms (167,484 videos) from external US and international centers, median age 2.5 years
records.model_description: EchoFocus-CHD is a multitask, view-agnostic deep learning model (built on the PanEcho architecture with an added transformer encoder) that detects 12 critical and 8 noncritical congenital heart lesions, individually and as composites, from full pediatric echocardiogram studies, trained and tested internally then evaluated on an independent US/international referral cohort.
records.dataset_size: 54,727 echocardiograms internal (3.4M videos); 3,356 echocardiograms referral cohort (167,484 videos)
records.headline_result: internal AUROC 0.94 (critical CHD composite), 0.90 (noncritical composite); referral cohort AUROC 0.77 for critical CHD, improving to 0.87 after retraining on all US data
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development with external referral-cohort validation

records.title: Artificial intelligence support for diagnosis of neurodevelopmental disorders during childhood: an umbrella review.
records.model_family: machine learning / deep learning (SVM, ANN, CNN) [review]
records.clinical_problem: Synthesize evidence on AI-assisted diagnosis of neurodevelopmental disorders (ASD, ADHD, intellectual disability, communication and learning disorders) in children, largely from neuroimaging data
records.patient_population: children with suspected/diagnosed neurodevelopmental disorders (64 studies from an umbrella review, Jan 2015-Aug 2025)
records.model_description: An umbrella review of 64 systematic reviews/meta-analyses on machine learning and deep learning models (SVMs, neural networks, CNNs) that take neuroimaging and other data (electrophysiological, clinical, motion/sensor) as input and output a diagnostic classification for autism, ADHD, and related neurodevelopmental disorders.
records.dataset_size: 64 included studies (148 records screened); neuroimaging modality used in 59 studies
records.headline_result: Diagnostic accuracy ranged 66% (facial/eye movement-based) to 99% (neuroimaging/voice/motion-based); 80% of studies rated critically low methodological quality (AMSTAR-2)
records.study_design: umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses

records.title: Biologically informed dual deep learning for skeletal maturity prediction in pediatrics.
records.clinical_problem: Estimating skeletal (bone) age from radiographs for growth assessment
records.model_description: A conceptual dual deep neural network framework integrating anatomical/developmental knowledge, with one network extracting morphological features from public datasets and a second capturing age-related growth patterns; illustrative simulations only, no real-world data collected.
records.study_design: conceptual perspective with illustrative simulations, no real-world validation

records.title: Classification of pediatric dental diseases from panoramic radiographs using natural language transformer and deep learning models.
records.exclusion_reason: Panoramic radiograph classification of pediatric dental diseases; non-radiologic (dental) imaging

records.title: Automatic lateral ventricle and choroid plexus segmentation method in infant brain MR images.
records.clinical_problem: Segmenting the lateral ventricles and choroid plexus on infant brain MRI to study cerebrospinal fluid dynamics and neurodevelopment
records.patient_population: Infants (Baby Connectome Project dataset n=154; in-house retrospective dataset n=52)
records.model_description: A fully automated deep learning segmentation method for joint lateral ventricle and choroid plexus segmentation on T1-weighted infant brain MRI, using an anatomy-aware loss enforcing that the choroid plexus is contained within the ventricles.
records.headline_result: Dice 0.818+/-0.075 (LV) and 0.827+/-0.084 (CP) in BCP dataset; Dice 0.964+/-0.060 (LV) and 0.932+/-0.059 (CP) in in-house dataset
records.study_design: retrospective method development and validation on two independent datasets

records.title: Quantitative radiomics and morphometry analysis of brain sub-regions reveals neurodevelopmental alterations in children with Tetralogy of Fallot.
records.clinical_problem: Identifying brain structural alterations associated with neurodevelopmental risk in children with Tetralogy of Fallot
records.patient_population: 60 children with Tetralogy of Fallot and 61 healthy controls
records.model_description: A radiomics-morphometry fusion model combining Pyradiomics and FreeSurfer-derived features from 68 brain regions on 3D T1-weighted MRI, using LASSO feature selection and SVM classification to distinguish children with Tetralogy of Fallot from healthy controls.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.99 (training), 0.77 (testing)

records.title: Intraventricular hemorrhage in preterm infants: A systematic review of risk- and outcome-prediction models.
records.exclusion_reason: systematic review of largely non-imaging (clinical/biomarker) prediction models for IVH risk and outcomes; neuroimaging is only one of several predictor types, not the review's focus

records.title: Developing an artificial intelligence tool for detecting fractures of child abuse: preliminary findings.
records.clinical_problem: Detecting inflicted (non-accidental) fractures on skeletal survey radiographs in suspected physical abuse
records.patient_population: 1740 children under 5 years old undergoing skeletal survey for suspected physical abuse
records.model_description: A deep learning-based AI tool (BoneView) retrained to detect inflicted fractures on pediatric skeletal survey radiographs.
records.headline_result: Baseline AUC 0.46; after preliminary retraining AUC 0.55, sensitivity 52%, specificity 67%

records.title: Real-time deep learning interpretation of echocardiographic video for automated detection of anatomical features associated with tetralogy of fallot in pediatric patients : a feasibility study.
records.clinical_problem: Automating detection of anatomical features of Tetralogy of Fallot from echocardiograms for screening
records.patient_population: 174 pediatric patients at Seoul Asan Medical Center (2018-2023)
records.model_description: A Detectron2/Mask R-CNN-based deep learning model trained to detect four characteristic anatomical defects of Tetralogy of Fallot in echocardiographic images and videos, for screening in regions lacking pediatric cardiology specialists.
records.headline_result: AUC ~1.00, F1 score 96.8%, >97% accuracy

records.title: A machine learning approach to using ultrasound for body composition and nutritional status assessment in newborns: a pilot study protocol.
records.clinical_problem: Assessing infant body composition (fat and fat-free mass) and nutritional status using ultrasound
records.patient_population: 50 infants (20 preterm, 30 full-term) at two sites (Boston, USA and Jimma, Ethiopia)
records.model_description: Planned CNN-based machine learning models to predict whole-body composition (fat/fat-free mass) from ultrasound images, as part of a feasibility pilot study establishing the scanning protocol and image database.
records.study_design: pilot study protocol (feasibility); ML models not yet trained/validated on full data

records.title: Early identification of refractory Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children using CT-based radiomics: a multicenter study.
records.clinical_problem: Early prediction of refractory Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children using clinical, imaging and radiomics features from chest CT
records.patient_population: 419 children (248 training, 62 testing, 109 external validation)
records.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from chest CT (via PyRadiomics) are combined with clinical and imaging variables in random-forest models to predict which children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia will develop a refractory (treatment-resistant) course.
records.headline_result: Integrated model AUC 0.811 (95% CI 0.704-0.917) in external validation, vs radiomics-only 0.784 and clinical-imaging-only 0.675
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter study with external validation

records.title: Ultrasonography and the Reorientation of Developmental Hip Dysplasia Research: An NLP-NMF Trend Analysis (1980-2024).
records.exclusion_reason: Bibliometric/text-mining (NLP-NMF) trend analysis of the developmental hip dysplasia literature, not an imaging AI model.

records.title: Wavelet-enhanced autoencoder based image denoising with CNN fusion.
records.exclusion_reason: general-purpose image denoising algorithm evaluated on mixed, mostly non-pediatric-specific datasets (fetal ultrasound is only one of three test datasets); not a pediatric-focused study

records.title: The LURN Study-What Have We "LURN"ed So Far?
records.exclusion_reason: adult urology study (lower urinary tract symptoms), not pediatric; imaging component is incidental neuroimaging research, not radiology AI

records.title: Magnetically Controlled Capsule Endoscopy: Innovations, Standardized Practice, and Emerging Clinical Roles.
records.exclusion_reason: endoscopy (capsule endoscopy), non-radiologic imaging excluded per scope; also not pediatric-focused

records.title: Deep Learning-based Bone Mineral Density Prediction Using Pediatric Chest Radiographs: A Multicenter Feasibility Study.
records.clinical_problem: Predicting bone mineral density (lumbar spine areal BMD) and detecting low BMD in children from chest radiographs
records.patient_population: Patients <18 years undergoing DXA and chest radiography at two tertiary hospitals
records.model_description: An AI model combining chest radiograph images with clinical variables (age, sex, height, weight) to predict lumbar spine areal BMD Z scores and detect low BMD, using DXA as the reference standard.
records.dataset_size: 1464 radiograph-DXA pairs (774 development, 376 internal test, 314 external test)
records.headline_result: Internal test: r=0.85, AUC 0.92 for low BMD; External test: r=0.76, AUC 0.90

records.title: Automated Detection of Pediatric Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis: A Deep Learning Approach Using Anatomically Informed Attention Guidance.
records.clinical_problem: Detecting slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE) on pediatric pelvic radiographs
records.patient_population: 174 pelvic radiographs (139 training, 35 testing)
records.model_description: A two-stage deep learning model: U-Net++ segments the femoral head to define a region of focus, then an attention-guided EfficientNet B1 classifies the radiograph as SCFE or no SCFE, with Grad-CAM for interpretability.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.893, accuracy 91.4%, sensitivity 93.3%, specificity 90.0%
records.study_design: retrospective diagnostic model development and testing

records.title: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven ensemble model for comprehensive chest X-ray abnormality detection and deployment.
records.journal: The Indian journal of medical research
records.model_family: ensemble deep learning (multi-model CNN ensemble with lung segmentation)
records.clinical_problem: Detect abnormalities including tuberculosis on chest radiographs for large-scale screening in resource-limited settings
records.patient_population: children and adults; 54,000 CXR images (36,500 abnormal, 17,500 normal) from 18 centers across 11 Indian states; prospective validation on 13,927 CXR images from outpatient clinics
records.model_description: Takes chest radiographs (no metadata/clinical input required) and, via a multi-model ensemble including lung segmentation and lesion-specific models, classifies the image as normal or abnormal for large-scale TB/thoracic screening.
records.dataset_size: 54,000 CXR images (282,000 annotated data points) for training; 13,927 CXR images for prospective validation
records.headline_result: Sensitivity 92.2% (95% CI 91.6-92.7), specificity 77.4% (95% CI 76.1-78.6) in blind prospective validation
records.study_design: multicentric retrospective development with prospective independent validation

records.title: Preoperative MRI-Derived Navigation Reduces Radiation Exposure in Pediatric Spinal Fusion.
records.clinical_problem: Eliminating preoperative CT and reducing radiation exposure during pediatric spinal fusion for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis by converting MRI to synthetic CT for surgical navigation
records.patient_population: 94 pediatric patients undergoing posterior spinal fusion for AIS (fluoro-only n=39, CT-only n=28, MRI-to-CT n=27)
records.model_description: A machine learning model that translates MRI signal intensities into CT-equivalent Hounsfield units to generate synthetic CT for intraoperative navigation, eliminating the need for a preoperative CT scan.
records.headline_result: MRI-to-CT group: intraoperative dose 0.55+/-0.49 mSv vs 0.91+/-0.57 mSv fluoro-only (P=0.008); zero preoperative radiation vs 19.6 mSv for CT-only (P<0.05)
records.study_design: retrospective cohort study, single tertiary center

records.title: Impact of multimodal information on the estimation of fetal growth indicators using machine learning regression models.
records.exclusion_reason: ML regression on tabular fetometric/clinical/sociodemographic variables, not image-based AI (no image processing applied to ultrasound images)

records.title: Automated quantification of coronal balance in spinal deformity: a safety-aware clinical workflow.
records.clinical_problem: Automated quantification of coronal balance parameters (shoulder height difference, pelvic obliquity, C7 plumb line offset) in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
records.patient_population: 847 full-spine radiographs
records.model_description: An HRNet-based deep learning system with a Clinical Safety Gating Mechanism that automatically measures shoulder height difference, pelvic obliquity, and C7 plumb line offset from full-spine radiographs, suppressing unreliable outputs in anatomically ambiguous cases.
records.headline_result: Mean absolute error 0.86-2.45mm; Pearson r>0.95 agreement with manual measurements

records.title: Machine learning framework for depression subtype grouping: integrating high-resolution imaging and clinical symptom analysis via correlation and clustering.
records.exclusion_reason: adult major depressive disorder MRI clustering study; no pediatric population stated

records.title: CT-based radiomics models for predicting the prognosis of children with mycoplasma pneumonia.
records.journal: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
records.clinical_problem: Predicting prognosis of mycoplasma pneumonia in children using clinical and CT radiomics features
records.patient_population: 356 children with mycoplasma pneumonia from two hospitals
records.model_description: A radiomics model extracting features from chest CT lesion regions using LASSO feature selection, combined with clinical variables, to predict prognosis of mycoplasma pneumonia in children.
records.headline_result: Combined clinical+radiomics model AUC 0.842 (training), 0.825 (validation), 0.748 (test)

records.title: Quality evaluation of ultrasound images for fetal crown-rump length measurement at 11 to 14 weeks' gestation: A fusion model can be interpreted using SHAP method.
records.model_family: DeepLabV3 ResNet101 (segmentation) + radiomics/deep transfer learning fusion model
records.clinical_problem: Automated quality evaluation of ultrasound images used for fetal crown-rump length measurement in early pregnancy
records.patient_population: 1149 midsagittal plane images from two hospitals, early pregnancy
records.model_description: A fusion model combining radiomics and deep transfer learning features (using a DeepLabV3-ResNet101 segmentation model for ROI extraction) to classify fetal CRL ultrasound images as standard or non-standard planes, interpreted using SHAP.
records.headline_result: Fusion model AUC 0.947, accuracy 88.4%, sensitivity 83.0%, specificity 92.7%; performance comparable to senior radiologists

records.title: Challenges in translating AI-driven ASD/ADHD diagnosis: A methodological systematic review.
records.exclusion_reason: Systematic review of multimodal (facial imaging, EEG/fMRI) informatics for ASD/ADHD diagnosis; not radiology imaging.

records.title: Automatic detection of the fetal brain midsagittal plane on MRI using a deep learning pipeline.
records.journal: American journal of obstetrics & gynecology MFM
records.clinical_problem: Automated localization of the fetal brain midsagittal plane on MRI for quality control and standardized assessment of midline brain structures
records.patient_population: 432 fetal brain MRI stacks from 225 fetuses (normal anatomy, 18-36 weeks)
records.model_description: A multitask 2D U-Net detects four midline brain structures (corpus callosum genu/splenium, cerebellar vermis, pons) to generate slice-level midsagittal-plane probability scores, aggregated by a LightGBM classifier into a case-level decision.
records.headline_result: Slice-level AUC 0.95, accuracy 0.87; case-level AUC 0.81, accuracy 0.74

records.title: Reassurance-Focused First-Trimester Euploidy Screening With Machine Learning.
records.exclusion_reason: ML model on maternal/biochemical/ultrasound-derived numeric variables (not image-based AI); ultrasound is used only as one input variable type, not as image input to the model

records.title: EVALUATION OF NEUROCOMBAT AND DEEP LEARNING HARMONIZATION FOR MULTI-SITE MAGNETIC RESONANCE NEUROIMAGING IN YOUTH WITH PRENATAL ALCOHOL EXPOSURE.
records.clinical_problem: Harmonizing multi-site MRI signal differences prior to volumetric analysis in a pediatric cohort with prenatal alcohol exposure
records.patient_population: Pediatric cohort (age 7 to 21) with controls and cases of prenatal alcohol exposure, three scanners
records.model_description: HACA3, a deep learning image harmonization method, processes MRI signals across scanners/sites prior to downstream volumetric quantification (MaCRUISE), aiming to remove site-related variance while preserving biological signal; compared against the statistical method neuroCombat.
records.headline_result: HACA3 qualitatively improved inter-site contrast variation but statistical methods (neuroCombat) reduced more site-related variance in MaCRUISE volume metrics (ANCOVA)

records.title: Evaluating Artificial Intelligence Conversational Platforms for Parental Queries on Antenatal Hydronephrosis: A Comparative Blinded Assessment.

records.title: Genetic and adenoviral ablation of the choroid plexus reduces postnatal hippocampal neurogenesis.
records.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
