records.title: The Use of Machine Learning to Enable Objective Assessment of Surgical Outcomes in Sagittal Craniosynostosis.
records.journal: Plastic and reconstructive surgery. Global open
records.clinical_problem: Objective assessment of head shape and quantification of surgical outcomes after correction of sagittal craniosynostosis
records.patient_population: 108 healthy children and 239 preoperative sagittal craniosynostosis patients; 21 CVR and 37 SAC pre/postoperative pairs
records.model_description: A Swap Disentangled Variational Autoencoder (SD-VAE) trained on CT, MRI, and 3D photographs to objectively quantify global and regional head shape relative to healthy norms, used to assess surgical outcomes after spring-assisted cranioplasty and calvarial vault remodeling.
records.dataset_size: 108 healthy children, 239 preoperative SC patients, 58 pre/postoperative pairs
records.headline_result: SD-VAE accurately distinguished SC patients from healthy controls based on global/regional morphology; both SAC and CVR resulted in head shape normalization

records.title: Diagnostic accuracy of artificial intelligence-assisted infant hip ultrasound interpretation for developmental dysplasia of the hip: systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.clinical_problem: Assessing the diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted ultrasound interpretation for infant developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), which is normally highly operator-dependent
records.patient_population: 29 studies; 9 studies (6,351 hips) pooled in meta-analysis
records.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI applied to 2D/3D infant hip ultrasound for detecting developmental dysplasia of the hip, compared against expert Graf-based interpretation or clinical follow-up as reference standard.
records.headline_result: Pooled sensitivity 0.92 (95% CI 0.86-0.95), specificity 0.96 (95% CI 0.91-0.98)
records.study_design: systematic review and diagnostic test-accuracy meta-analysis

records.title: A multicentre benchmark dataset for comprehensive landmark-based fetal ultrasound biometry.
records.clinical_problem: Providing an open, multi-site annotated benchmark dataset and baseline AI model for automated fetal biometric landmark detection (head/abdominal diameters, femoral length)
records.patient_population: 1904 subjects, 4513 images from four clinical sites, seven ultrasound devices
records.model_description: An open-access multicentre benchmark dataset of fetal ultrasound images with expert landmark annotations for biometric measurements (head, abdomen, femur), with an automated landmark-based baseline model to quantify domain shift across centers/devices.
records.release_evidence: All data and annotations are available on the UCL Research Data Repository. Training code and evaluation pipelines are available at https://github.com/surgical-vision/Multicentre-Fetal-Biometry.git
records.headline_result: Single-center training/evaluation overestimates performance relative to multicentre testing (domain shift demonstrated)
records.study_design: multicentre benchmark dataset with baseline model evaluation

records.title: Image Quality Advancements in Low-Dose Pediatric CT Using Super-Resolution Deep-Learning Reconstruction.

records.model_description: Super-resolution deep-learning reconstruction (SR-DLR) applied to raw low-dose pediatric abdominal CT data to reduce noise and improve edge sharpness, compared with hybrid-iterative and conventional deep-learning reconstructions.
records.headline_result: SR-DLR showed greatest noise reduction, highest CNR and ERS, outperforming hybrid-IR and C-DLR (p<0.001)

records.title: Deep learning for pediatric synovial recess distension detection in hemophilia: synthetic image augmentation with styleGAN2-ADA.
records.journal: International journal of computer assisted radiology and surgery
records.clinical_problem: Classifying pediatric synovial recess distension (joint bleeding) on musculoskeletal ultrasound in children with hemophilia

records.title: Ultrafast Infant Brain Quantitative MRI Using Overlapping-Echo Acquisition with Volumetric Physical Simulation of Slice-level Non-Idealities.
records.model_family: deep learning quantitative reconstruction (synthetic data-driven, MOLED)
records.clinical_problem: Ultrafast quantitative MRI (T2, T2*, T2') mapping of the infant brain to characterize early brain development, overcoming motion and scan-time limitations
records.patient_population: 30 infants (0-1 year)
records.model_description: A deep learning quantitative reconstruction framework trained on physics-informed synthetic data (VoluSimu) applied to multiple overlapping-echo detachment (MOLED) MRI acquisitions to rapidly generate T2, T2*, and T2' maps of the infant brain without prolonged scan times.
records.headline_result: Network trained on synthetic data provided accurate quantitative T2/T2*/T2' maps despite imperfect RF pulses and B0 inhomogeneity; motion-artifact-free maps obtained
records.study_design: prospective method development and in vivo validation study

records.title: Performance of Open-Source LLMs in Identifying Pediatric Pneumonia From Free-Text Chest Radiograph Reports.
records.clinical_problem: Classifying free-text pediatric chest radiograph reports for community-acquired pneumonia
records.patient_population: 1000 pediatric emergency department encounters with CXR (2016-2022), median age 4.2 years
records.model_description: Five open-source large language models (Gemma2 9B, Gemma2 27B, Falcon3 7B, DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B, Llama3.1 8B) were evaluated to classify free-text chest radiograph reports as positive, negative, or indeterminate for pneumonia.
records.release_evidence: evaluated five open-source LLMs (Gemma2 9B, Gemma2 27B, Falcon3 7B, DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 8B, and Llama3.1 8B)
records.dataset_size: 1000 pediatric ED encounters with CXR reports
records.headline_result: Gemma2 9B: pneumonia F1 0.82 (three-class), F1 0.97 (binary); outperformed traditional NLP classifiers

records.title: Automated Deep Learning-Based Demyelination Load Segmentation in Metachromatic Leukodystrophy.
records.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation and quantification of demyelinated white matter (demyelination load) in metachromatic leukodystrophy as an imaging biomarker of disease burden
records.patient_population: 35 MLD patients for training (189 scans); independent testing on 130 scans from 49 patients
records.model_description: A self-configuring nnU-Net convolutional neural network trained on 3D T1- and axial T2-weighted MRI to automatically segment demyelinated white matter in metachromatic leukodystrophy, compared with a conventional semi-automated method.
records.dataset_size: 189 scans from 35 patients (training); 130 scans from 49 patients (independent test)
records.headline_result: Median Dice 0.82 (3D T1) and 0.75 (2D); CNN-derived demyelination load correlated with motor impairment (rS=0.38-0.56, p<0.001)
records.study_design: retrospective method development and independent testing

records.title: [Diagnostic sonography in obstetrics and gynecology].

records.title: BIBSNet: A deep learning baby image brain segmentation network for MRI scans.
records.model_name: BIBSNet (Baby and Infant Brain Segmentation Neural Network)
records.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting infant brain tissue on MRI to support studies of typical and atypical early brain development
records.patient_population: 90 participants, age range 0-8 months (median 4.6 months)
records.model_description: BIBSNet, an open-source deep neural network trained using manually annotated real images plus synthetic segmentations (SynthSeg) with a 10-fold procedure, performs infant brain tissue segmentation that outperforms joint label fusion and is faster at inference, producing FreeSurfer-compatible labels.
records.release_evidence: an open-source model for robust and generalizable brain tissue segmentation
records.headline_result: Dice similarity coefficient: gray matter 0.849 (BIBSNet) vs 0.713 (joint label fusion); white matter 0.862 vs 0.791; BIBSNet is about 600x faster than joint label fusion at inference
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation against joint label fusion and iBEAT segmentation

records.title: Brain entropy as a biomarker of major depression in adolescents and young adults: insights from multimodal resting-state functional magentic resonance imaging.
records.clinical_problem: Can resting-state fMRI markers of brain entropy help diagnose major depressive disorder in adolescents and young adults?
records.patient_population: 204 individuals aged 12-24 years (119 with MDD, 85 healthy controls)
records.model_description: SVM-RFE classifier uses brain entropy plus standard resting-state fMRI features (ALFF, ReHo, FCD) from brain regions to classify patients as having major depressive disorder or not.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.877 (combined BEN+ALFF+FCD model)
records.study_design: cross-sectional case-control machine learning classification study

records.title: Artificial intelligence-assisted quality assessment of mid-trimester ultrasound examinations using large vision-language models.

records.patient_population: 22,544 ultrasound planes from 273 internal and 29 external examinations plus public data
records.model_description: A SonoNet-based CNN identifies standard fetal ultrasound planes and key anatomical structures; a fine-tuned vision-language model synthesizes the CNN-derived descriptions to assess overall exam completeness and quality, providing interpretable feedback on missing/low-quality planes.
records.dataset_size: 22,544 ultrasound planes (273 internal + 29 external examinations, plus public data)
records.headline_result: Best VLM F1 0.944 (internal), 0.922 (external) for exam-level assessment; AI assistance improved reader diagnostic consistency and recall
records.study_design: multicenter retrospective study with reader study

records.title: Development and validation of a machine learning model to predict prognostic outcomes in infantile epileptic spasms syndrome.

records.patient_population: Pediatric orthopedic patients (review, no single study population)

records.title: Graph theory reveals functional connectome disruptions in adolescent major depressive disorder with childhood trauma.

records.title: Optimized fetal head circumference estimation in 2D ultrasound using EfficientNet-B7 and Adam optimizer.

records.headline_result: Normalized MAE 0.028, HC-specific MAE 1.978mm, inference time ~0.03s
records.study_design: retrospective model development on public benchmark dataset

records.model_description: A vendor-neutral deep residual convolutional neural network denoising system applied to simulated low-dose (~50% dose reduction) pediatric chest radiographs, evaluated for image quality and diagnostic performance (pneumonia, atelectasis, cardiomegaly) by blinded radiologists.
records.headline_result: Image quality improved (4.4+/-0.5 vs 4.5+/-0.4 full-dose); delta-AUC=-0.03 for diagnostic performance, non-inferiority not formally established

records.title: Emerging role of artificial intelligence in necrotizing enterocolitis and implementation challenges.

records.model_description: A narrative review tracing the evolution of AI in pediatric neuroimaging and neurosurgery, from handcrafted imaging biomarkers to deep learning-based segmentation/prediction/anomaly detection, and describing emerging brain foundation models, spatial computing, physical AI (robotic safety), and multimodal AI surgical copilot agents.

records.title: Evaluating the usability and practicality of AI-enabled smartphone-based obstetric ultrasound in Sierra Leone: a mixed-methods study.

records.patient_population: 2,315 obstetric sweep protocols conducted by 81 healthcare providers across seven facilities in Sierra Leone

records.title: Silent Verb Generation during fMRI Reveals Post-Radiotherapy Alterations in Cerebellar-Cerebral Language Regions in Patients Treated for Medulloblastoma.

records.model_family: radiomics + nomogram (LASSO-selected features combined with clinical/imaging findings)
records.clinical_problem: Differentiating Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia from bacterial pneumonia in children using CT imaging
records.patient_population: 585 pediatric pneumonia patients (249 MPP, 336 bacterial pneumonia)
records.model_description: A clinical-radiomics nomogram combines CT-based radiomics features (segmented with PHIgo-LK software), CT imaging findings, and clinical indicators to differentiate Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia from bacterial pneumonia in children.
records.headline_result: Combined nomogram AUC 0.971 (training), 0.958 (validation)
records.study_design: retrospective case-control study with radiomics nomogram development

records.title: Current challenges for global equity related to the implementation of artificial intelligence in pediatric imaging.
records.clinical_problem: Address barriers to global validation and implementation of AI in pediatric radiology (data inequality/bias, infrastructure, regulatory/ethical gaps, workforce, language, cost, sustainability) and propose an equity-focused roadmap
records.model_description: A World Federation of Pediatric Imaging position paper outlining barriers to equitable global implementation of AI in pediatric radiology and a time-sequenced roadmap to address them.

records.title: uFlowAM: an unsupervised framework for detection and visualization of abnormal intracardiac microflow on early-pregnancy fetal cardiac microflow imaging.
records.model_family: self-supervised deep learning (representation learning, anomaly detection)
records.clinical_problem: Detecting abnormal intracardiac microflow patterns suggestive of congenital heart disease on early-pregnancy fetal cardiac microflow ultrasound imaging
records.patient_population: 650 early-pregnancy fetal cardiac microflow examinations (500 internal, 150 external cohort), CHD-enriched referral population
records.model_description: uFlowAM, a self-supervised deep learning framework, learns a normal microflow template from control fetal cardiac microflow imaging (temporal-order discrimination and masked-frame reconstruction, no pixel-level labels) and flags abnormal intracardiac flow patterns via a latent-space abnormality index, tested as a second-reader assistive tool.
records.headline_result: External cohort AUC 0.92, sensitivity 0.90, specificity 0.86; reader-assisted median AUC increased from 0.85 to 0.92, reading time decreased from 78s to 59s
records.study_design: multicenter diagnostic accuracy study with multi-reader multi-case (MRMC) evaluation

records.title: An end-to-end pipeline for automated fetal brain segmentation and biometry from 3D SSFP MRI.
records.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation and biometric measurement of the fetal brain from 3D SSFP MRI to support diagnosis of neurodevelopmental abnormalities
records.model_description: An end-to-end deep learning pipeline (Tri-Attention nnU-Net for head localization, nnU-Net for multi-structure segmentation) automatically segments the fetal head, brain parenchyma, and extra-axial CSF and estimates head circumference from whole-body 3D SSFP MRI.
records.headline_result: Mean Dice 94.48% (head), 93.58% (brain parenchyma), 82.75% (extra-axial CSF)
records.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation study

records.title: Clinical 2D MRI radiomics for infant brain age and trajectory modeling.
records.model_family: radiomics framework (automatic registration, segmentation, feature extraction) with GAMLSS trajectory modeling
records.clinical_problem: Predicting infant brain age and modeling normative brain development trajectory from routine clinical 2D MRI to detect developmental delay
records.patient_population: 2,893 routine T1- and T2-weighted scans from children aged 0-2 years
records.model_description: A radiomics framework with automatic registration, segmentation, and feature extraction predicts brain age from routine clinical 2D T1- and T2-weighted MRI in infants, and models the normative developmental trajectory of the corpus callosum median using GAMLSS to flag developmental delay.
records.headline_result: Brain age prediction MAE 1.19 months; developmental delay detection accuracy 0.96 (ages 6-24 months)
records.study_design: retrospective cohort study using routine clinical MRI with radiomics-based modeling

records.title: Cortical surface-based descriptors for childhood autism classification using segmentation-guided cortical reconstruction from sMRI.
records.model_family: machine learning classifiers (SVM, random forest, KNN, multilayer perceptron) on cortical surface features
records.clinical_problem: Classifying childhood autism spectrum disorder from cortical surface-based structural MRI descriptors not usually visible on routine imaging
records.model_description: Cortical surface descriptors (volume, surface area, thickness, curvature, folding index) are extracted via FreeSurfer-based segmentation-guided reconstruction from pediatric structural MRI and classified using machine learning models (SVM, random forest, KNN, multilayer perceptron) to distinguish autism from typical development.
records.headline_result: Multilayer perceptron: 69.4% accuracy, AUC 72.6%
records.study_design: retrospective cohort study using public dataset (ABIDE-II), machine learning classification

records.title: Optimising chest computed tomography (CT) scan ranges in paediatric patients to reduce radiation exposure.
records.exclusion_reason: protocol optimization study (chest CT scan range boundaries) with no AI model developed; AI mentioned only as a future direction in the conclusion

records.title: Structure-function coupling abnormalities in adolescent obsessive-compulsive disorder and their molecular correlates.
records.model_family: machine learning classifier applied to structural-functional connectivity coupling features
records.clinical_problem: Classifying adolescent obsessive-compulsive disorder and predicting symptom severity using structure-function coupling from multimodal neuroimaging
records.patient_population: 50 adolescents with OCD and 53 healthy controls
records.model_description: Structural-functional connectivity coupling is computed across 246 brain regions from multimodal MRI (diffusion and functional) and used with machine learning to discriminate adolescents with OCD from controls and predict symptom severity.
records.headline_result: SC-FC coupling discriminated OCD from controls with 66.0% accuracy (AUC 0.691, p=0.003); predicted symptom severity (r=0.426, p=0.002)
records.study_design: case-control observational study with machine learning classification

records.title: The transformative potential of artificial intelligence in pediatric medicine: Current applications, methodological challenges, and future directions.
records.exclusion_reason: broad review of AI in pediatric critical care, perinatal/neonatal medicine, and oncology; imaging (radiomics, prenatal ultrasound) is a minor part, not primarily about radiology AI

records.title: Predicting brain age in children aged 2-6 years with autism spectrum disorders using routine T1- and T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging.
records.clinical_problem: Can routine clinical brain MRI be used to estimate brain age and detect abnormal brain maturation in young children with autism spectrum disorder?
records.patient_population: 2010 typically developing children and 822 children with ASD, aged 2-6 years
records.model_description: A ridge regression brain-age model trained on T1- and T2-weighted routine clinical MRI predicts a child's brain age; the gap between predicted and chronological age (brain age difference) is compared between typically developing children and children with autism.
records.dataset_size: 2010 typically developing children, 822 children with ASD
records.headline_result: MAE 0.526 years (TDC test set); significantly delayed brain maturation in ASD vs TDC (p<0.001)
records.study_design: retrospective model development and case-control comparison

records.title: Highlights of the 2026 European Crohn's and Colitis Conference: redefining the IBD care continuum.

records.exclusion_reason: uses retinal optical coherence tomography angiography (ophthalmic imaging), an excluded modality; combined with clinical/PSG variables in a nomogram, not radiologic imaging

records.title: Multivariate environmental exposures are reflected in whole-brain functional connectivity and cognition in youth.
records.model_family: connectome-based predictive modeling (cross-validated, data-driven machine learning)
records.clinical_problem: prediction of cognitive performance from functional connectivity associated with environmental exposome
records.patient_population: early adolescents enrolled in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study; exact ages not given
records.model_description: Input is resting-state and task fMRI functional connectivity from adolescents in the ABCD Study. A cross-validated, data-driven connectome-based predictive model relates connectivity patterns to an environmental 'exposome' score and to cognitive performance across three domains (general cognition, executive function, learning/memory). Results generalized across data-collection sites and cognitive domains, but this is a research association study, not a diagnostic tool.
records.dataset_size: n = 6,137-8,391 across models, ABCD Study cohort
records.headline_result: Cross-validated models: r = 0.34-0.44, p < .001, robust across data-collection sites and cognitive domains (p < 0.0009)

records.title: Comparative Assessment of Performance of Domain-Specific and Primed Versus Non-Primed Artificial Intelligence Chatbots for Clinical Decision-Making in Injuries to the Primary Dentition: An Exploratory Pilot Study.
records.journal: Dental traumatology : official publication of International Association for Dental Traumatology
records.exclusion_reason: dental trauma clinical-decision chatbot comparison; dental domain excluded, and no image analysis is performed by the chatbots

records.title: Deep Learning-Based Multi-Class Pediatric Wrist Fracture Subtype Classification: A Pilot Study Comparing Convolutional Neural Network Architectures.
records.clinical_problem: Classifying pediatric wrist fracture subtype (buckle/torus, greenstick, Salter-Harris, other, no fracture) from plain radiographs to support settings lacking subspecialty expertise
records.patient_population: 940 pediatric wrist radiographs (GRAZPEDWRI-DX dataset)
records.model_description: Three ImageNet-pretrained CNN architectures (DenseNet-169, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B4) were compared for five-class classification of pediatric wrist fracture subtype from plain radiographs, using transfer learning and Grad-CAM interpretability.
records.headline_result: DenseNet-169 best: balanced accuracy 0.532, macro F1 0.516, macro AUROC 0.815 (after extended training); accuracy remained below clinically usable thresholds
records.study_design: pilot retrospective study comparing CNN architectures with patient-level stratified split

records.title: Transdiagnostic monoamine-based subtyping for attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and autism spectrum disorder via unsupervised machine learning.

records.title: Assessment of Myocardial Iron Overload and Strain Abnormalities in Pediatric β-Thalassemia Using Multiparametric CMR.
records.clinical_problem: Assessing myocardial iron overload and early subclinical cardiac dysfunction (strain) in pediatric transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia using AI-assisted CMR feature tracking
records.patient_population: 68 pediatric patients with beta-thalassemia major and 20 age-matched healthy controls
records.model_description: AI-based cardiovascular MRI feature tracking (CMR-FT) automatically measures myocardial strain (global circumferential, longitudinal, radial strain) and is correlated with T2*/T1 mapping and LV geometry to detect subclinical cardiac dysfunction in pediatric beta-thalassemia patients with myocardial iron overload.
records.headline_result: GCS reduced in iron overload group (-17.4% vs -19.3% in controls, p<0.01); GCS correlated with T2* (r=-0.33) and T1 (r=-0.45)
records.study_design: retrospective case-control study using AI-assisted CMR feature tracking

records.title: Fully Automated Biometric Parameter Measurement in Prenatal Ultrasound Screening for Total Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Connection.
records.clinical_problem: Improving prenatal detection of total anomalous pulmonary venous connection (TAPVC) via automated measurement of biometric indices (PLAS index, LAPSD ratio) on fetal cardiac ultrasound four-chamber view
records.model_description: Automated four-chamber view extraction from fetal cardiac ultrasound videos, using DeepLabv3+, UNet3+, or SegFormer to segment the heart, crux, and descending aorta, followed by automated measurement of the post-left atrium space index and left-atrial posterior-space-to-diagonal ratio to screen for total anomalous pulmonary venous connection.
records.headline_result: AE-SegFormer AUC 0.940 (PLAS) and 0.940 (LAPSD), outperforming residents (0.784-0.797) and fellows (0.801), approaching experts (0.996)

records.title: EGT-UNet: Evolutionary Game-Theoretic Adaptive Optimization for Pediatric Panoramic Tooth Segmentation.

records.exclusion_reason: review of diagnostic strategies for neonatal cholestasis/biliary atresia spanning biomarkers, genetics, and imaging; AI-assisted ultrasound interpretation is only one bullet among many non-imaging strategies discussed

records.title: A Multitask Deep Learning Model for Pediatric Echocardiography Analysis.
records.clinical_problem: Detecting 28 congenital heart defects, structural/functional abnormalities, repairs, and interventions from complete pediatric echocardiography studies
records.patient_population: >12,000 echocardiography studies (>700,000 videos), Stanford Medicine 2014-2021; external cohort Children's Hospital of Philadelphia 2024-2025
records.model_description: EchoAI-Peds, a video-based vision transformer, simultaneously detects 28 congenital heart defects and structural/functional abnormalities, repairs, and interventions from multi-view pediatric echocardiography studies, outperforming adult-based echocardiography foundation models (EchoCLIP, EchoPrime).
records.dataset_size: >12,000 studies (>700,000 videos); training 10,815, validation 1,294, internal test 1,336, external test 2,121 studies
records.headline_result: Macroaveraged AUROC 0.91 internal, 0.89 external; outperformed EchoCLIP (0.58/0.61) and EchoPrime (0.58/0.60)
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and external validation study

records.title: Development of a deep learning model for intussusception using point-of-care ultrasound.
records.model_family: machine learning ensemble/transfer learning/fine-tuning models (ImageNet feature extraction)
records.clinical_problem: Detecting the target sign of intussusception on point-of-care ultrasound in the pediatric emergency department
records.patient_population: 49 patients (8 positive for intussusception), POCUS media from ED visits
records.model_description: Multiple machine learning approaches (classical ML, ensemble learning, transfer learning, fine-tuning on ImageNet features) were compared for detecting the intussusception target sign on point-of-care ultrasound images/videos from pediatric emergency department visits.
records.dataset_size: 785 media files from 49 patients (converted to 1,582 intussusception and 1,965 normal images)

records.title: High Resolution Isotropic 'Pseudo' 3D Cine imaging with Automated Segmentation using Concatenated 2D Real-time Imaging and Deep Learning.
records.journal: Journal of cardiovascular magnetic resonance : official journal of the Society for Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance
records.model_family: deep learning (signal correction, respiratory correction, super-resolution, segmentation; 4 models)
records.clinical_problem: Creating fully segmented, isotropic pseudo-3D cardiac cine MRI from free-breathing 2D real-time images to speed up cardiac MRI in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients
records.patient_population: 20 patients undergoing routine cardiovascular MRI examination
records.model_description: Four deep learning models (interslice signal correction, interslice respiratory correction, through-slice super-resolution, and cardiac chamber/vessel segmentation) convert a stack of free-breathing 2D real-time cardiac MRI cines into a fully segmented, isotropic pseudo-3D cine dataset, validated against breath-hold and whole-heart reference imaging in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients.
records.release_evidence: Our models are trained from fully open-source datasets, allowing our technique to be easily shared with other clinical centers.
records.headline_result: No significant bias in LV/RV volumes (e.g., LV EDV bias 0.7+/-8.8 mL); total reconstruction time under 1 minute

records.title: The Diagnostic Value of Pituitary MRI Radiomics Combined with Clinical Features for Central Precocious Puberty in Girls.
records.model_family: radiomics model (texture features) combined with clinical fusion
records.clinical_problem: Distinguishing idiopathic central precocious puberty from isolated premature thelarche in girls using pituitary MRI radiomics combined with clinical features
records.patient_population: 316 girls (231 ICPP, 85 PT) internal cohort; 47 girls external validation cohort
records.model_description: A pituitary MRI radiomics model (texture features, primarily sagittal anterior pituitary) combined with clinical and hormonal features (BMI, bone age, FSH, LH, E2) in a fusion model distinguishes idiopathic central precocious puberty from premature thelarche in girls, with external validation at a second center.
records.dataset_size: 316 girls internal (231 ICPP, 85 PT), 47 girls external validation
records.headline_result: Clinical-radiomics fusion model AUC 0.944
records.study_design: retrospective diagnostic study with external validation

records.title: Diagnostic and prognostic applications of machine learning in paediatric traumatic brain injury: a systematic review of single and multimodal approaches.
records.model_family: various (XGBoost, Random Forest, CNNs, transformers; systematic review)
records.clinical_problem: Machine learning and deep learning for acute detection (e.g., skull fracture, CT-necessity triage) and outcome prognostication in pediatric traumatic brain injury
records.patient_population: 20 studies, 68,331 subjects total, ages 0-18 years
records.model_description: A systematic review of machine learning and deep learning models (including CNNs, transformers, gradient boosting) for acute detection of pediatric traumatic brain injury (e.g., skull fracture on imaging, CT-necessity triage) and prognostication of outcomes (mortality, functional recovery), using single or multimodal (clinical, imaging, biomarker) data.
records.headline_result: AUROC up to 0.98 for mortality prediction; marginal gains over no-information rate for low-risk triage

records.title: Uncertainty-Aware Risk Stratification in Pediatric Low-Grade Glioma Using Multimodal Data.
records.model_family: deep learning survival model (ResNet-based) with late fusion
records.clinical_problem: Risk stratification (survival prediction) in pediatric low-grade glioma integrating deep learning imaging features, molecular subtype, and clinical data, with uncertainty quantification
records.patient_population: 360 subjects with imaging data, 493 with molecular subtype data, Children's Brain Tumor Network
records.model_description: A pretrained deep learning model fine-tuned for pediatric brain tumor segmentation extracts imaging features from T2-weighted MRI, which are combined in a regularized survival model (clinico-ResNet) with clinical data, and further fused with a clinical-molecular survival model; bootstrap resampling quantifies per-patient prediction uncertainty for risk stratification in pediatric low-grade glioma.
records.dataset_size: 360 subjects with imaging (752 for segmentation fine-tuning), 493 with molecular data, 294 with both
records.headline_result: DL-M1 C-index 0.73 discovery, 0.70 replication; multimodal fusion reduced uncertainty interval width by approximately 75%
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter cohort study with deep learning survival modeling and independent replication

records.title: Evaluating Clinical NLP Services for Chest Radiograph Report Labeling: A Comparative Study on an Independent Pediatric Dataset.
records.journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
records.exclusion_reason: NLP entity-extraction/labeling of chest radiograph report text (comparing commercial NLP services), not an image-interpretation model.

records.title: Artificial intelligence for pediatric fracture detection: impact on diagnostic revisions and patient recall rates in a tertiary emergency setting.
records.clinical_problem: Whether AI-assisted fracture detection reduces diagnostic revisions and patient recalls after pediatric emergency skeletal radiographs interpreted out-of-hours.
records.patient_population: Children and adolescents (2-18 years) undergoing appendicular skeletal radiography in a tertiary emergency department
records.model_description: A commercial AI system (TechCare Kids, Milvue) analyzes appendicular skeletal radiographs of children to flag fractures, with output used to support treating physicians' interpretation.
records.release_evidence: commercial AI system (TechCare Kids, Milvue, Paris, France)
records.dataset_size: 667 patients enrolled (296 with fractures) of 1515 screened
records.headline_result: AI accuracy 95.1%; diagnostic revisions 8.6% without AI vs 5.7% with AI (RR 0.66, 95% CI 0.37-1.19)
records.study_design: prospective single-center study of AI-assisted fracture detection in pediatric emergency radiography

records.title: Automated readings of imaging reports by natural language processing (NLP) supplemented by clinical data predict disease course in children and adults with Crohn's disease: report from the epi-IIRN.

records.headline_result: Imaging-based predictors AUC 0.59 (95% CI 0.53-0.65); combined imaging+clinical AUC 0.69 (0.64-0.74)
records.study_design: retrospective cohort study using NLP-extracted imaging features and machine learning survival models

records.title: Emerging biomarkers in breast fibroadenoma: implications for differential diagnosis, malignant transformation, and precision medicine.

records.title: Artificial intelligence-based ultrasound screening for antenatal detection of placenta accreta spectrum.
records.journal: American journal of obstetrics & gynecology MFM
records.model_family: CNN (EfficientNetB0) + ensemble (logistic regression, random forest, gradient boosting)
records.clinical_problem: Whether an AI model can predict placenta accreta spectrum from prenatal placental ultrasound images to improve antenatal detection
records.patient_population: Pregnant patients at risk for placenta accreta spectrum, imaged 2018-2025
records.model_description: An EfficientNetB0 convolutional neural network classifies frames from 2D placental ultrasound DICOM images for placenta accreta spectrum; frame-level probabilities are averaged and combined with clinical risk factors (prior cesareans, previa) in an ensemble of logistic regression, random forest, and gradient boosting to output a per-patient prediction.

records.title: Radiomics of the Airway (RadAr): Multi-Scale Airway Phenotyping for Disease Characterization on Routine CT Imaging.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
records.clinical_problem: Whether quantitative multi-scale airway radiomic measurements from routine chest CT can characterize airway disease and correlate with outcomes across several respiratory diseases, including pediatric cystic fibrosis
records.patient_population: N=1331 patients across four cohorts: fibrotic interstitial lung disease, COVID-19, progressive pulmonary fibrosis (adults), and pediatric cystic fibrosis
records.model_description: RadAr extracts over 400 interpretable multi-scale airway measurements (tapering, luminal dimensions, architectural distortion) from chest CT airway segmentations; in pediatric cystic fibrosis, these measurements were correlated with prior exacerbations and airway inflammation markers.

records.title: AI segmentation requires accounting for brain size to maintain performance on developmental MRI cohorts.

records.study_design: retrospective methodological evaluation and adaptation of a deep learning segmentation tool across a developmental MRI cohort

records.title: Ultrasound-based machine learning models for assisting the prediction of neonatal size and mode of delivery.
records.model_family: random forest / K-nearest neighbors / stochastic gradient descent / stacking ensemble
records.clinical_problem: Whether machine learning models using prenatal ultrasound biometric measurements can predict neonatal birth weight, head circumference and mode of delivery

records.title: Global and Voxel-Wise Brain Age Prediction Analyses Following Perinatal Stroke.

records.title: Comparative Analysis of Bone Age Estimation Using the Manual Greulich and Pyle Method Versus Artificial Intelligence Algorithms in an Indian Pediatric Population Aged 1-18 Years.
records.clinical_problem: How accurately do AI-based bone age assessment software platforms agree with manual Greulich-Pyle atlas assessment in an Indian pediatric population
records.patient_population: Children aged 1-18 years, Indian population, 74 hand radiographs
records.model_description: Three commercial AI software platforms (Xrayhead, 16-Bit Physis, FreeBoneAge) each take a hand radiograph and output an estimated bone age, compared against manual Greulich-Pyle atlas reading.
records.release_evidence: three automated AI software platforms: Xrayhead (AI1), 16-Bit Physis (AI2), and FreeBoneAge (AI3)
records.headline_result: 16-Bit Physis: ICC 0.983 (0.973-0.989), MAE 1.24 years vs GP; Xrayhead moderate agreement ICC 0.729, unreliable under age 6

records.title: Deep learning reveals a neurocomputational mechanism predicting depression risk in adolescents.
records.clinical_problem: Whether a computational biomarker derived from functional MRI and deep learning can predict future depression risk in adolescents before symptom onset
records.patient_population: Population-based adolescent cohort IMAGEN (N=1332), with follow-up N=725; validated in STRATIFY patient cohort N=411
records.model_description: A brain-aligned deep learning model of emotion perception is fit to functional MRI signals; perturbation experiments identify an overregularized emotion-perception signature, used as a computational biomarker to predict later depression symptom onset.
records.headline_result: Neurocomputational signature predicted depression symptom onset up to 4 years later and improved depression classification in the STRATIFY cohort
records.study_design: prospective cohort study with computational modeling and external cohort validation

records.title: Left Atrial Myopathy Across the Spectrum of Pediatric Heart Disease: Imaging, Mechanobiology, and Clinical Consequences.
records.exclusion_reason: narrative review of left atrial mechanobiology and imaging in pediatric heart disease; AI mentioned only briefly as a future direction, not the review's focus

records.title: Multi-modal ensemble learning prediction of anti-TNF treatment response in pediatric patients with Crohn's disease using clinical, radiomic, and deep learning MR enterography features.
records.clinical_problem: Whether combining radiologist assessment, radiomic features, and deep learning features from pre-treatment MR enterography with clinical data can predict which pediatric Crohn's disease patients will respond to anti-TNF therapy
records.patient_population: 92 pediatric Crohn's disease patients (median age 14.6 years) who underwent MRE before starting anti-TNF therapy, 2009-2021
records.model_description: A two-stage stacking ensemble model combines radiologist MRE assessment, radiomic features from bowel regions, deep learning features from bowel images, and non-imaging clinical data to output a predicted probability of anti-TNF treatment response (mucosal healing).
records.headline_result: Combined MRE+clinical ensemble AUROC 0.817 (95% CI 0.793-0.842) vs individual feature types 0.706-0.724

records.title: Human-AI Interaction With AI-Assisted Tumor Overlays in Pediatric Whole-Body Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Exploratory Reader Study.
records.clinical_problem: Whether an AI-assisted tumor-highlighting overlay changes radiologist workflow, lesion marking, follow-up recommendations and workload during surveillance whole-body MRI in children with a cancer predisposition syndrome
records.patient_population: Children with Li-Fraumeni syndrome undergoing surveillance whole-body MRI
records.model_description: A patch-based deep learning segmentation model trained on augmented 2D slices from 675 surveillance whole-body MRI volumes highlights regions with high tumor probability as an overlay for radiologists during interpretation.
records.dataset_size: 675 surveillance whole-body MRI volumes (training); reader study with 2 radiologists
records.headline_result: AI assistance increased case evaluation time; mixed effect on number of candidate lesions marked between the two radiologists
records.study_design: exploratory reader study evaluating human-AI interaction with an AI-assisted overlay

records.title: Autism in adolescence and adulthood.
records.exclusion_reason: editorial introducing a journal collection on autism in adolescence and adulthood; not about radiology or imaging AI specifically

records.title: Bone age estimation from chest radiographs using deep neural networks: a proof-of-concept study.
records.body_region: chest (opportunistic bone age from chest radiograph)
records.clinical_problem: Whether bone age can be opportunistically estimated from chest radiographs using deep learning when dedicated hand radiographs are unavailable
records.patient_population: Children aged 3-15 years who underwent both chest and hand radiography at a tertiary center over 20 years
records.model_description: Three pretrained deep neural networks are fine-tuned (with and without sex as an input) to estimate bone age directly from chest radiographs, using hand-radiograph-derived TW2-RUS bone age as the reference standard.
records.headline_result: Sex-considering model ICC up to 0.87 (95% CI 0.63-0.99), RMSE 1.30 years

records.title: Interobserver and intraobserver variability of fetal and maternal Doppler measurements: systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.journal: Ultrasound in obstetrics & gynecology : the official journal of the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology
records.exclusion_reason: systematic review of interobserver/intraobserver variability of manual Doppler ultrasound measurements in pregnancy; AI mentioned only in passing as a future improvement strategy, not the focus

records.title: Precision Medicine in Transfusion-Dependent and Non-Transfusion-Dependent β-Thalassemia: Toward Personalized Diagnosis and Therapy.
records.exclusion_reason: narrative review of precision medicine in thalassemia (transfusion, genomics, MRI iron monitoring); not pediatric-specific, AI mentioned only briefly

records.journal: Knee surgery, sports traumatology, arthroscopy : official journal of the ESSKA
records.exclusion_reason: systematic review of deep learning for avascular necrosis of the femoral head; explicitly excludes pediatric populations

records.title: Latent Koopman Dynamics of Brain Structure-Function Coupling for Identifying Adolescent Prenatal Drug Exposure.
records.model_family: graph neural network (GNN) with Koopman operator
records.clinical_problem: Whether joint structural and functional brain connectivity modeling can identify adolescents with a history of prenatal drug exposure
records.patient_population: 10,199 adolescents from the ABCD (Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development) cohort
records.model_description: NeuroKoop++ uses graph neural network encoders to extract structural and functional connectivity from brain MRI, fuses them via cross-attention, and models their coupling with a Koopman operator conditioned on cognitive scores to classify prenatal drug exposure history.
records.headline_result: Outperformed leading multimodal approaches with statistically significant improvements for PDE classification (no single summary statistic given)
records.study_design: retrospective cohort study developing a graph neural network model on a large adolescent neuroimaging cohort

records.title: Study protocol of the Speech of children After Neonatal Encephalopathy (SANE): a single-centre prospective cohort study.
records.exclusion_reason: study protocol for a cohort study of language development after neonatal encephalopathy; the ML component predicts a language outcome from combined clinical/lab/EEG/neuroimaging-derived variables, not an image-based radiology AI model, and no results are yet reported

records.title: Integrated quantitative biomarkers of placental texture and hemodynamics improve assessment of pregnancies at risk for adverse fetal outcomes.
records.clinical_problem: Whether quantitative texture analysis of B-mode placental ultrasound, combined with Doppler and clinical variables, improves identification of pregnancies at risk for adverse fetal outcomes (e.g., preeclampsia, severe fetal growth restriction, perinatal hypoxia)
records.patient_population: 129 pregnant patients imaged at 28-32 and 34-38 weeks gestation
records.model_description: Texture features are extracted from B-mode placental ultrasound pixel data and combined with Doppler measurements and clinical variables in logistic regression and random forest models to predict high-risk pregnancy status.
records.headline_result: Quantitative placental texture features had predictive performance comparable to Doppler; combined clinical+Doppler+texture model improved performance over clinical alone (no single AUC reported)
records.study_design: prospective cohort study developing predictive models from ultrasound texture and Doppler biomarkers

records.title: Multiparametric MRI radiomics for noninvasive risk stratification of pediatric neuroblastoma: a pilot study.
records.model_family: XGBoost (and five other ML classifiers), radiomics
records.clinical_problem: Whether multiparametric MRI radiomics can noninvasively stratify pediatric neuroblastoma into low/intermediate vs. high risk without relying solely on tissue and molecular characterization
records.patient_population: 30 children with histologically confirmed neuroblastoma (mean age 38±40 months)
records.model_description: 208 radiomic features are extracted from T1, T2, and diffusion-weighted whole-tumor MRI volumes, reduced by feature-selection methods, and used to train machine learning classifiers (best: XGBoost) that output a binary risk classification (low/intermediate vs. high-risk neuroblastoma).
records.headline_result: Best discrimination AUC 0.88 ± 0.06-0.07 (T2-weighted and combined T1w+T2w+ADC features with XGBoost)

records.title: Placental Blood-Flow Velocity Quantification From Diffusion MRI.
records.clinical_problem: Whether machine learning applied to diffusion MRI can quantify placental capillary blood velocity to help identify placental blood-flow pathology (e.g., preeclampsia, fetal growth restriction)
records.patient_population: In vivo placental diffusion MRI plus simulated data (patient number not stated)
records.model_description: Monte Carlo simulations of placental perfusion/diffusion generate training data for supervised regressors (random forest, multilayer perceptron) that estimate capillary blood velocity, perfusion fraction, and diffusivity directly from diffusion MRI signal, applied to simulated and in vivo placental scans.
records.headline_result: MC-based MLP produced physiologically reasonable in vivo velocity estimates with greater sensitivity than IVIM methods (no single quantitative error metric stated)
records.study_design: methodological development study combining Monte Carlo simulation and machine learning regression, with in vivo validation

records.title: Machine learning-based prediction of postoperative restenosis risk following direct repair of paediatric coarctation of the aorta.
records.exclusion_reason: machine learning model predicting restenosis risk after pediatric aortic coarctation repair using preoperative/intraoperative clinical variables (e.g., body surface area); not based on imaging or radiomic features

records.title: Advances in AI for detecting pulmonary inflammation and perioperative medicine: a mini-review.
records.exclusion_reason: mini-review of AI for pulmonary inflammation detection focused on elderly/perioperative populations; pediatric pneumonia mentioned only as one data point, not the review's focus

records.title: Pretreatment Coronary Ultrasound Radiomics Combined With the Prognostic Nutritional Index for Predicting IVIG Resistance in Children With Kawasaki Disease.
records.clinical_problem: Whether radiomic features from pretreatment coronary artery ultrasound, combined with a nutritional index and clinical data, can predict IVIG resistance in children with Kawasaki disease
records.patient_population: 352 children diagnosed with Kawasaki disease, 2020-2026
records.model_description: Radiomic features are extracted from segmented 2D coronary artery ultrasound images (LCA, LAD, RCA) via LASSO selection and combined with the Prognostic Nutritional Index and clinical variables in a logistic regression model to predict IVIG treatment resistance.
records.headline_result: Combined Clinic+PNI+Radiomics model AUC 0.880 (95% CI 0.817-0.944) in validation cohort
records.study_design: retrospective single-center model development and validation study

records.title: A scoping review on the application of new technology in the screening and diagnosis of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.
records.exclusion_reason: scoping review of AI for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis screening using non-radiological inputs (RGB photos, 3D surface scans, depth maps); explicitly not radiologic imaging

records.title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Multimodal Ultrasound Model for Prediction of Spontaneous Preterm Birth: Development and Validation.
records.journal: Journal of ultrasound in medicine : official journal of the American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine
records.clinical_problem: Whether a multimodal AI model combining cervical ultrasound images, elastography, and ultrasound parameters can predict spontaneous preterm birth in the second trimester
records.patient_population: 721 pregnant women undergoing transvaginal ultrasound screening at 20-24 weeks gestation (44 with spontaneous preterm birth)
records.model_description: A DenseNet121 deep learning model scores cervical 2D ultrasound and elastography images; these deep-learning scores plus ultrasound parameters (elasticity contrast index, hardness ratio, etc.) feed five machine learning classifiers, the best being a neural network, to predict spontaneous preterm birth.
records.headline_result: Best multimodal neural network AUC 0.85 (95% CI 0.73-0.96) in validation set; DenseNet121 image-only AUC 0.92-0.93
records.study_design: prospective cohort study developing and validating a multimodal AI model

records.title: Text-prompted foundation-model segmentation of intrapartum fetal ultrasound: a controlled methodological study with F-TPA-SAM2.
records.clinical_problem: Whether text-conditioned prompting can direct a frozen segmentation foundation model (SAM 2) to segment fetal anatomical structures on intrapartum ultrasound for labor-progress monitoring, without manual geometric prompts
records.patient_population: Intrapartum fetal ultrasound images (PSFHS training/test dataset); zero-shot transfer evaluated on 779 HC18 images
records.model_description: F-TPA-SAM2 is a small trainable adapter (0.871M parameters) that maps frozen FetalCLIP text embeddings into a prompt for a frozen SAM 2 mask decoder, enabling text-selected segmentation of fetal anatomical structures on intrapartum B-mode ultrasound.
records.dataset_size: PSFHS dataset with label budgets N=20/100/400; zero-shot test on 779 HC18 images
records.study_design: controlled methodological development study with ablation controls

records.title: MDIFN: a deep learning-based multi-dimensional interaction fusion network for placental MRI segmentation.
records.journal: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery
records.clinical_problem: Whether a deep learning model combining 2D and 3D feature fusion can automatically and accurately segment the placenta on MRI
records.patient_population: 267 placental MRI cases
records.model_description: MDIFN combines a 2D-UNet and 3D-UNet branch via a bidirectional gated cross-dimension fusion module, plus global context recalibration and residual refinement, to output an automatic placental segmentation mask from MRI.
records.headline_result: Dice coefficient 0.8749±0.0132, an improvement of 16.2% over pure 2D-UNet and 8.4% over pure 3D-UNet
records.study_design: retrospective model development study with 10-fold cross-validation and ablation

records.title: Artificial intelligence model based on the detection of key anatomical structures for identifying standard planes on ultrasound of the first-trimester fetal central nervous system: a multicenter study.
records.journal: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery
records.clinical_problem: Whether an AI model can identify standard first-trimester fetal CNS ultrasound planes by detecting key anatomical structures, to assist sonographers of varying experience
records.patient_population: 2,901 first-trimester fetal CNS ultrasound standard-plane images from three hospitals, plus external validation of 300 images from a fourth hospital
records.model_description: FCNS-Model detects key anatomical structures on first-trimester fetal ultrasound images to classify/identify standard CNS planes (midsagittal, transthalamic, coronal frontal, transventricular), compared against physicians of varying seniority against an expert-team reference standard.
records.dataset_size: 2,901 images (train 2,124/test 264/internal val 254/clinical val 259) plus external validation 300 images
records.headline_result: Test set precision/recall/F1 >92%; clinical validation AUC up to 0.984 vs senior physician 0.906 (P<0.001) for midsagittal plane
records.study_design: prospective multicenter model development and validation study

records.title: Placenta Accreta Spectrum: A Narrative Review of Clinical Management, Contemporary Innovations, And Global Challenges.
records.journal: International journal of medical science and dental health
records.exclusion_reason: narrative review of placenta accreta spectrum clinical management and global challenges; machine learning mentioned only briefly as one of many intraoperative adjuncts, not the review's focus

records.title: EVALUATION OF NEUROCOMBAT AND DEEP LEARNING HARMONIZATION FOR MULTI-SITE MAGNETIC RESONANCE NEUROIMAGING IN YOUTH WITH PRENATAL ALCOHOL EXPOSURE.
records.journal: Proceedings. IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging
records.clinical_problem: Whether a deep learning harmonization method (HACA3) can remove multi-site scanner-related variance while preserving biological signal in a pediatric/adolescent cohort with prenatal alcohol exposure, compared to a purely statistical harmonization method (neuroCombat)
records.patient_population: Youth aged 7-21 years across three scanners, controls and cases of prenatal alcohol exposure
records.model_description: HACA3, a deep learning harmonization model, processes multi-site MRI images prior to downstream volumetric quantification (MaCRUISE) to reduce site-related signal variance, compared against and combined with the statistical neuroCombat method.
records.headline_result: HACA3 qualitatively improved inter-site contrast variation but statistical methods (neuroCombat) reduced more site-related variance in volume metrics (ANCOVA); no single accuracy number given
records.study_design: methodological evaluation/comparison study of image harmonization methods in a multi-site pediatric neuroimaging cohort

records.title: Echo-Mamba: A Lightweight Mamba-Based Framework for Generalizable Left Ventricular Segmentation Across Multiple Echocardiographic Views.
records.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
records.clinical_problem: Can a lightweight AI model accurately segment the left ventricle on echocardiograms across different views and age groups, including children?
records.patient_population: public echocardiography datasets including EchoNet-Dynamic, EchoNet-Pediatric, CAMUS, HMC-QU
records.model_description: Echo-Mamba is a lightweight state-space-model architecture with an Adaptive Feature Enhancement module that segments the left ventricle across multiple echocardiographic views, tested on adult and pediatric public datasets.
records.release_evidence: The implementation of our approach is publicly available at https://github.com/Beliefs666/EchoMamba
records.dataset_size: four public datasets (EchoNet-Dynamic, EchoNet-Pediatric, CAMUS, HMC-QU)
records.headline_result: 0.323M parameters; generalizable segmentation across anatomical targets, age groups, and views (specific Dice not given)
records.study_design: retrospective method development and benchmark comparison

records.title: Analysis of Interindividual Lesion Progression Variability in Adult Cerebral Adrenoleukodystrophy.
records.exclusion_reason: multicenter study of lesion progression in adult cerebral adrenoleukodystrophy (adult men only); not a pediatric population

records.title: Pediatric vs. Adult Pneumonia Detection: Quantifying Age-related Generalization Gaps in Zero-shot Multimodal Large Language Models.
records.model_name: GPT-5.2; Claude Opus 4.5; Gemini 2.5 Pro; InceptionV3 (CNN baseline)
records.clinical_problem: How well do zero-shot multimodal large language models detect pneumonia on pediatric versus adult chest radiographs compared with a domain-trained CNN, and how large is the pediatric-adult generalization gap
records.patient_population: Balanced pediatric and adult chest radiograph test sets (n=1000 each, 500 pneumonia/500 normal); pediatric development pool n=4715, adult n=13,863
records.model_description: Three general-purpose multimodal LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro) are evaluated zero-shot for pneumonia detection on frontal chest radiographs, compared to cohort-specific InceptionV3 CNNs trained separately on pediatric and adult images; performance and age-related generalization gap (Matthews correlation coefficient) are measured for each.
records.dataset_size: Pediatric: 4715 development + 1000 test; Adult: 13,863 development + 1000 test
records.headline_result: Pediatric: CNN MCC 0.799 vs GPT-5.2 0.484, Claude Opus 4.5 0.470, Gemini 2.5 Pro 0.272; LLMs showed a larger adult-pediatric generalization gap than the CNN
records.study_design: retrospective comparative diagnostic accuracy study, zero-shot LLMs vs domain-trained CNN

records.title: AI-driven Assessment of Vertebral Rotation in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Using Weight-bearing Cone-beam CT.
records.clinical_problem: Whether an AI algorithm can automatically and accurately quantify 3D vertebral rotation on weight-bearing cone-beam CT in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, and how well the standard 2D Nash & Moe grading system represents true 3D rotation
records.patient_population: 72 adolescents with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
records.model_description: A U-Net-based algorithm processes weight-bearing cone-beam CT images of the spine to automatically compute vertebral rotation angles for each vertebra, compared against manual measurements by two radiologists and against the 2D Nash & Moe grading system from standing radiographs.
records.headline_result: ICC 0.881 (95% CI 0.852-0.905) between automated and manual vertebral rotation measurements

records.title: Biological domain shift and statistical nesting concerns in generative AI-based spatial tumor growth prediction for pediatric diffuse midline glioma.
records.clinical_problem: Methodological critique of a generative AI model (guided denoising diffusion implicit model) for predicting spatial tumor growth on MRI in pediatric diffuse midline glioma, questioning domain shift and statistical nesting concerns for radiotherapy planning translation
records.patient_population: Discussion references the prior study's external validation cohort of 13 pediatric patients (pooled adult glioblastoma and pediatric high-grade glioma training data)
records.model_description: Commentary on a denoising diffusion implicit generative model that produces patient-specific spatial tumor growth maps on MRI for pediatric diffuse midline glioma, raising concerns about pooling adult and pediatric training data and about slice-level versus patient-level performance reporting.
records.dataset_size: External validation cohort of 13 patients (as reported in the original study under discussion)
records.headline_result: Growth-region prediction continuous Dice coefficient median ~0.22 (range 0.071-0.376) vs full-tumor cDICE median ~0.81, as reported in the original study

records.title: Artificial Intelligence in Obstetrics: Current Trends and Future Directions.
records.clinical_problem: State of evidence for AI applications across obstetric care, including fetal ultrasound biometry and anomaly detection, fetal monitoring, and maternal risk stratification
records.patient_population: Pregnant patients / fetuses, literature 2016-2026
records.model_description: Narrative review of AI (machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, NLP) across obstetric care, with a focus on image-based tasks (ultrasound fetal biometry and structural anomaly detection) alongside non-imaging applications (cardiotocography, genomic screening, telehealth); reports that image-based tasks often exceed AUC 0.85 while most evidence is retrospective and internally validated.
records.headline_result: Image-based tasks often AUC/accuracy >0.85; intrapartum CTG analysis AUROC ~0.60-0.70

records.title: Quantitative assessment of fetal lung development using MRI-based radiomics: a comparative analysis of 3D and 2D approaches with external validation.
records.model_family: support vector regression / partial least squares regression
records.clinical_problem: Whether 2D or 3D MRI radiomics better quantifies fetal lung development, using gestational age estimation as a surrogate marker
records.patient_population: 292 fetal MRI scans (28-38+6 weeks gestation), original dataset n=252 and independent test set n=40, from two institutions
records.model_description: 102 radiomics features are extracted from manually segmented 2D (single-plane) and 3D (whole-lung) regions of interest on T2-weighted fetal MRI; support vector regression and partial least squares regression models estimate gestational age from these features as a surrogate for lung maturity, with external validation.
records.dataset_size: 292 fetal MRI scans (252 development, 40 independent external test)
records.headline_result: 3D radiomics r=0.904 (SVR)/0.902 (PLSR) in original dataset, 0.846/0.861 in independent test set; 2D-3D correspondence ICC median 0.379 (original)/0.247 (test)
records.study_design: retrospective model development study with external validation of 2D vs 3D radiomics

records.title: An interpretable machine learning model based on routine clinical indicators for early identification of obesity-related non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in children: a single-center retrospective study.
records.exclusion_reason: interpretable ML model predicting ultrasound-defined NAFLD risk in obese children using clinical and biochemical variables; model input is clinical/laboratory data, not imaging

records.title: Federated learning for privacy-preserving ophthalmic artificial intelligence: clinical applications and translational challenges.
records.exclusion_reason: narrative review of federated learning for ophthalmic AI; retina/OCT imaging is non-radiologic and excluded per protocol

records.title: Interpretable multimodal machine learning for injury risk stratification in adolescent athletes: integrating kinematic, physiological, and load data with SHAP/LIME explainability.
records.exclusion_reason: multimodal ML injury risk model in adolescent athletes using kinematic, physiological, and training load data; not an imaging-based radiology AI model (ultrasound elastography is one minor input among many non-imaging sensors)

records.title: PET/CT In paediatric lymphoma: Current role and advances.
records.clinical_problem: The current and evolving role of FDG PET/CT in staging, response assessment, and treatment adaptation for pediatric lymphoma, including emerging AI and radiomics applications
records.patient_population: Children with lymphoma
records.model_description: Review describing PET/CT quantitative biomarkers (MTV, TLG) for pediatric lymphoma, noting that AI and radiomics are being introduced for automated image analysis and risk stratification, alongside dose-reduction and PET/MRI hybrid approaches.

records.title: A preliminary study on the radiomic assessment of the surrounding trabecular bone microenvironment in taurodontism: Is it more than a dental anomaly?
records.exclusion_reason: radiomic study of dental panoramic radiographs for taurodontism trabecular bone assessment; dental imaging excluded per protocol

records.title: Comments on Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Wireless Handheld Ultrasound for Screening Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip in Infants.
records.journal: Journal of ultrasound in medicine : official journal of the American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine
records.clinical_problem: Commentary on AI-assisted wireless handheld ultrasound for screening developmental dysplasia of the hip in infants
records.patient_population: Infants screened for developmental dysplasia of the hip
records.model_description: Letter commenting on a study of AI-assisted wireless handheld ultrasound for DDH screening in infants; no abstract text is available to describe further detail.

records.title: Identifiable regional and neural network abnormalities in early childhood anxiety.
records.exclusion_reason: no trained model stated (GLM and ICA analyses only, no machine learning classifier)

records.title: Prompting the future: artificial intelligence in pediatric radiology.
records.model_description: Editorial commentary on the trajectory of artificial intelligence in pediatric radiology (no abstract available).

records.title: Prospective Comparison of Ultra-Low-Dose Versus Standard-Dose Computed Tomography for Esophageal Foreign Body Detection.
records.clinical_problem: Whether ultra-low-dose CT (incorporating deep learning image reconstruction) is non-inferior to standard-dose CT for detecting esophageal foreign bodies while reducing radiation dose, in a mixed adult and pediatric population
records.patient_population: 180 patients with suspected esophageal foreign body ingestion (120 adults, 60 children)
records.model_description: An ultra-low-dose CT protocol combines reduced kV/mA acquisition with deep learning image reconstruction (plus iterative reconstruction) to maintain diagnostic image quality for esophageal foreign body detection, compared against standard-dose CT with conventional reconstruction.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.985 (ULD-CT) vs 0.991 (SD-CT), non-inferior; effective dose reduced 63% (P<0.001)

records.title: Evaluating the impact of segmentation strategies on radiomic feature stability for paediatric brain tumour diagnosis using diffusion weighted imaging.
records.clinical_problem: How much do different tumor segmentation (ROI drawing) strategies affect the stability of radiomic features and downstream diagnostic classification accuracy for pediatric brain tumors on diffusion-weighted MRI
records.patient_population: 106 pediatric brain tumor patients
records.model_description: Ground-truth tumor ROIs on ADC maps are systematically eroded or dilated to simulate conservative versus extensive segmentation, and radiomic feature stability and machine learning diagnostic classification accuracy are compared across these segmentation strategies.
records.headline_result: Classification accuracy reduced by 3.8±0.8% (erosion) and 5.6±0.9% (dilation) vs ground-truth ROI features; stable-feature selection reduced the drop to 1.4±0.7%/2.9±0.3%

records.title: Deep learning applications in osteosarcoma MRI: A systematic review of recent advances in AI-based osteosarcoma diagnosis.
records.model_family: CNN, vision transformers, multimodal architectures, radiomics
records.clinical_problem: How well do machine and deep learning methods applied to MRI (including DWI and DCE-MRI) perform for osteosarcoma tumor segmentation, classification, and prognosis, a cancer that peaks in adolescence
records.patient_population: 38 studies (2020-2025) of osteosarcoma imaging, a tumor most common in adolescence
records.model_description: Systematic review of 38 studies applying radiomics, CNNs, vision transformers, and multimodal architectures to MRI (including DWI, DCE-MRI) for osteosarcoma segmentation, classification, and prognosis (e.g., prediction of pathological necrosis after chemotherapy).
records.headline_result: Multimodal segmentation best average Dice 94.7% (94.5-94.9%); necrosis-prediction nomogram AUC 0.807-0.848; all 38 models retrospective, single-center

records.title: Automated segmentation of postsurgical resection cavities on magnetic resonance imaging in focal epilepsy: A Multicentre Epilepsy Lesion Detection study.
records.clinical_problem: Whether a deep learning tool can automatically and accurately segment postsurgical resection cavities on MRI after epilepsy surgery in a heterogeneous multicenter cohort of children and adults
records.patient_population: 969 subjects across 27 centers (MELD project) plus 133 from the EPISURG dataset; children and adults
records.model_description: MELD-PostOp is an nnU-Net-based deep learning model trained on postoperative T1-weighted MRI to automatically segment resection cavities after epilepsy surgery, compared against existing automated tools (Epic-CHOP, ResectVol, RESSEG) and evaluated on stratified and independent test cohorts.
records.release_evidence: MELD-PostOp is an open-source research tool
records.dataset_size: 969 subjects (27 centers) + 133 (EPISURG); final model trained on 965 masks; Stratified Test Cohort n=50, Independent Test Cohort n=87
records.headline_result: Median DSC 0.85, HD95 3.61 on combined test cohort, outperforming existing tools (DSC 0.43-0.69)
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and validation study

records.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence in Non-Contrast Brain Computed Tomography Scan for Intracerebral Hemorrhage: A Scoping Review.
records.clinical_problem: How explainable AI methods have been applied to AI models for hematoma detection, segmentation, and outcome prediction on non-contrast brain CT in adult and pediatric intracerebral hemorrhage
records.patient_population: 12 studies of adult and pediatric patients with spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage
records.model_description: Scoping review mapping explainability (XAI) methods, mainly Grad-CAM and saliency maps, used in AI/deep learning studies of non-contrast brain CT for intracerebral hemorrhage detection, segmentation, and outcome prediction.

records.title: Radiomics of planar Tc-99m methylene diphosphonate bone scintigraphy for pediatric osteomyelitis: a paired infected-contralateral analysis.
records.clinical_problem: Whether radiomics analysis of planar Tc-99m MDP bone scintigraphy can quantitatively distinguish infected from normal bone in children with suspected osteomyelitis
records.patient_population: 28 pediatric patients with suspected osteomyelitis
records.model_description: 62 quantitative radiomic features (shape, intensity, texture) are extracted from paired infected and contralateral normal bone ROIs on planar Tc-99m MDP bone scintigraphy; a compact radiomics score from top features is derived via LOOCV logistic regression to discriminate infected from normal bone.
records.headline_result: Single-feature LOOCV AUC 0.60-0.63; texture features showed large effect sizes (Cohen's d ~0.80-0.85, P<0.001) distinguishing infected vs normal bone

records.title: Benchmarking Generalizability in Deep Learning-Based White Matter Tract Segmentation.
records.journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
records.clinical_problem: How well do deep learning white matter tract segmentation models generalize across datasets, particularly when adult-trained models are applied to pediatric diffusion MRI data
records.patient_population: Independent diffusion MRI datasets with varying acquisition protocols and populations, including pediatric data
records.model_description: Four state-of-the-art deep learning architectures (including CNN-based TractSeg) for white matter tract segmentation on diffusion MRI/tractography are benchmarked across datasets; an ensemble model (EWMTS) combining complementary models is introduced to partially recover accuracy lost under domain shift, notably when adult-trained models are applied to pediatric data.
records.release_evidence: openly releasing this benchmark and a reproducible processing pipeline
records.headline_result: Performance dropped sharply under domain shift, most severely when applying adult-trained models to pediatric data; EWMTS partially recovered accuracy

records.title: Disseminating brief video-based mental health interventions on Instagram: Reach, engagement, and real-world implementation.

records.clinical_problem: Editorial perspective on the future of artificial intelligence in pediatric radiology

records.model_description: Radiomic features were extracted from ADC, T2-weighted and DCE-T1-weighted MRI sequences of children with posterior fossa tumors. LASSO regression selected features to build a radiomics score, which was combined with radiologist MRI findings into a nomogram to distinguish medulloblastoma from ependymoma. Diagnostic performance was compared against radiologists using the DeLong test.
records.headline_result: Combined sequence radiomics model AUC 0.981 (primary cohort) and 0.939 (validation cohort), outperforming radiologists and single-sequence models

records.title: A transfer learning − based DeepLabV3–UNet3+ hybrid model for automated fetal head circumference measurement

records.patient_population: fetal head ultrasound images (public HC18 dataset)
records.model_description: A hybrid DeepLabV3-UNet3+ deep learning model, assisted by transfer learning, segments the fetal head from an ultrasound image; an ellipse is then fitted to the segmentation to compute head circumference automatically, aiming to replace expert-dependent, inconsistent manual measurement.
records.headline_result: 97.83% Dice similarity coefficient, 0.67±2.62mm difference, 1.96±1.86mm absolute difference, 1.30±0.79mm Hausdorff distance on the HC18 dataset, achieved without data augmentation and with ~20 minutes training time

records.title: Artificial Intelligence methods for ultra-low- field MRI enhancement comparing brain volumes and neurodevelopment scores for small vs appropriate for gestational age children
records.model_family: pre-trained deep learning super-resolution model (GAMBAS) for ultra-low-field MRI
records.clinical_problem: brain volume assessment and neurodevelopmental correlation using portable ultra-low-field MRI in small-for-gestational-age vs appropriate-for-gestational-age children
records.patient_population: 64 children aged 3-5 years (from a birth cohort of 180 children: 90 small-for-gestational-age, 90 appropriate-for-gestational-age), scanned with a portable 64mT ultra-low-field MRI system
records.model_description: The pre-trained GAMBAS deep learning model generated super-resolved images from ultra-low-field (64mT, Hyperfine Swoop) brain MRI scans of children. Brain volumes derived from the super-resolved images were compared against high-field MRI in a subset for validation, and correlated with neurodevelopmental scores (Malawi Developmental Assessment Tool) to compare small-for-gestational-age and appropriate-for-gestational-age children.
records.dataset_size: 64 children aged 3-5 years from a cohort of 180 (90 SGA, 90 AGA); ground-truth comparison subset n=10
records.headline_result: strong correlation and high concordance between super-resolved and high-field brain volumes for total intracranial volume, white matter, cerebral cortex, basal ganglia and thalamus; correlation between super-resolved volumes and neurodevelopmental (MDAT) z-scores was not statistically significant

records.title: A self-supervised representation-transfer multimodal learning for automated diagnosis of Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip
records.model_family: Self-supervised representation-transfer framework (BYOL pretraining) with a multi-scale attention module and a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network classifier
records.clinical_problem: automated diagnosis of developmental dysplasia of the hip
records.patient_population: pediatric pelvic X-ray dataset spanning patients aged 6 months to 16 years
records.model_description: A large set of unlabeled pelvic X-rays is used to pretrain global feature representations with self-supervised (BYOL) learning; these are transferred into a detector and fine-tuned on a small labeled subset, reducing the need for large-scale annotation. An attention module highlights key anatomical structures, patient age and gender are embedded into the image features, and extracted anatomical indices are fed into a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network to classify developmental dysplasia of the hip severity.

records.title: ADBrainNet: a deep neural network for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and Attention Deficit and Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) classification using resting-state fMRI images based on explainable artificial intelligence
