records.title: Realizing the promise of machine learning in precision oncology: expert perspectives on opportunities and challenges.
records.exclusion_reason: general precision oncology ML discussion; not imaging-specific, not pediatric

records.title: Automatic Quantification of Serial PET/CT Images for Pediatric Hodgkin Lymphoma Using a Longitudinally Aware Segmentation Network.
records.model_family: longitudinally aware segmentation network with cross-attention between timepoints
records.clinical_problem: deciding from the interim PET whether a child's Hodgkin lymphoma is responding, which determines how much treatment they receive
records.patient_population: 297 children in two Children's Oncology Group trials (median age 15.4 and 15.8 years), 200 internal and 97 external
records.model_description: Reads the baseline and interim PET together rather than separately, letting features from the first scan inform where to look on the second, which is how a physician actually reads a response study. It then produces the quantities that drive therapy decisions — metabolic tumor volume, total lesion glycolysis, qPET and the change in SUVmax — which correlated strongly with physician measurements. Trained and externally tested on cooperative group trial data.
records.headline_result: F1 0.61 for detecting residual lymphoma on interim PET, beating all comparators (P < .01); baseline segmentation Dice 0.77; Spearman correlation with physician measurements 0.78-0.96 across the four PET metrics
records.study_design: retrospective study on clinical trial cohorts with external testing

records.title: Deep Learning-based Brain Age Prediction Using MRI to Identify Fetuses with Cerebral Ventriculomegaly.
records.clinical_problem: using a fetal brain age prediction model to identify fetuses with ventriculomegaly, its severity, and associated CNS abnormalities on fetal MRI
records.patient_population: 317 fetuses with ventriculomegaly and 183 typically developing fetuses
records.model_description: Input: multiplanar fetal brain MRI sections; output: a predicted fetal brain age, compared to gestational age (predicted age difference) to identify ventriculomegaly, its severity, and associated CNS abnormalities.
records.dataset_size: 317 fetuses with ventriculomegaly, 183 typically developing fetuses
records.headline_result: fetuses with VM had significantly larger absolute predicted age difference than typical fetuses (P<.001); severe VM larger than moderate VM (P=.004)

records.title: Comparison of different dental age estimation methods with deep learning: Willems, Cameriere-European, London Atlas.
records.exclusion_reason: dental age estimation methods compared on panoramic radiographs; dental imaging is excluded from this database's scope

records.title: Enhancing task fMRI individual difference research with neural signatures.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
records.clinical_problem: improving the reliability of task-fMRI individual-difference measures of cognition and psychopathology in early adolescents
records.patient_population: 9,024 early adolescents
records.model_description: A machine-learning classifier ('neural signature') is trained on task-based fMRI to distinguish high versus low working-memory load; its prediction captures individual differences and is compared against standard regional brain activation estimates for reliability and association with cognition/psychopathology.
records.headline_result: Signature predictions more reliable and more strongly associated with task performance, cognition and psychopathology than standard regional activation estimates

records.title: Impact of deep learning on pediatric elbow fracture detection: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.journal: European journal of trauma and emergency surgery : official publication of the European Trauma Society
records.model_family: deep learning models (various, e.g. ResNet backbone)
records.clinical_problem: diagnostic accuracy of deep learning models for detecting pediatric elbow fractures on radiographs
records.patient_population: children aged 0-16 years (pooled across 6 studies)
records.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of deep learning models (commonly ResNet-backbone CNNs) that classify elbow radiographs as fracture vs. no fracture in children aged 0-16.
records.headline_result: pooled sensitivity 0.93, specificity 0.89, AUC 0.95

records.title: SegFormer3D: Improving the Robustness of Deep Learning Model-Based Image Segmentation in Ultrasound Volumes of the Pediatric Hip.
records.clinical_problem: Robustly segmenting bone anatomy from 3D hip ultrasound to automate measurement of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) metrics
records.patient_population: Pediatric patients (newborns to 6 months) undergoing 3D hip ultrasound for DDH evaluation
records.model_description: A 3D extension of the SegFormer transformer architecture, with hierarchically structured encoders producing multi-scale features, segments hip bone anatomy from 3D ultrasound volumes to compute DDH diagnostic metrics more robustly than CNN/ViT baselines
records.dataset_size: not stated exactly (clinical pediatric test set)
records.headline_result: Up to 0.9% improvement in Dice score and up to 3% smaller 95% Hausdorff distance vs. state of the art
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and robustness evaluation study

records.title: Stratifying cognitive and behavioral comorbidities in children with new-onset seizures - The influence of sociodemographic disadvantage.
records.exclusion_reason: Unsupervised clustering of neuropsychological test scores and behavioral checklist data; no imaging data used

records.title: A comprehensive dataset of germinoma on MRI/CT with clinical and radiomic data.
records.body_region: brain (pineal/suprasellar region, intracranial germ cell tumor)
records.clinical_problem: Provide a public imaging dataset to support development of AI models to improve diagnostic accuracy for germinoma, avoiding unnecessary surgery
records.patient_population: 65 pathologically confirmed germinoma patients (adolescents, peak incidence age group; also children)
records.model_description: Releases a public multimodal imaging dataset (T2, FLAIR, T1, contrast-enhanced T1, DWI MRI, and CT) with clinical and radiomic features from 65 pathologically confirmed germinoma cases to support training and validation of future AI diagnostic models.
records.release_evidence: there are no publicly available imaging datasets for germinoma. This study aimed to create a comprehensive dataset for germinoma...

records.title: AI for image quality and patient safety in CT and MRI.
records.exclusion_reason: general review of AI for CT and MR image quality and dose; fetal motion is one passing example and the scope is not pediatric

records.title: Enhancing Pediatric Bone Age Assessment Using Artificial Intelligence: Implications for Orthopedic Surgery.
records.clinical_problem: automated pediatric bone age assessment from hand and wrist radiographs to guide orthopedic treatment decisions for growth-related disorders
records.patient_population: 12,611 training, 1,425 validation, 200 test hand/wrist radiographs (RSNA 2017 Pediatric Bone Age Challenge dataset)
records.model_description: A ResNet-50-based deep-learning model takes hand and wrist radiographs as input and outputs a predicted bone age in months, benchmarked against radiologist-determined ages.
records.headline_result: RMSE 11.07 months, MAE 8.54 months, R² 0.929
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study using a public benchmark dataset

records.title: A review of methods of age estimation based on postmortem computed tomography.
records.exclusion_reason: Forensic postmortem age-at-death estimation across all ages (fetuses to adults), not clinical pediatric radiology; ML is one of several methods reviewed, not a specific pediatric AI model.

records.title: 3D velocity and pressure field reconstruction in the cardiac left ventricle via physics informed neural network from echocardiography guided by 3D color Doppler.
records.journal: Computer methods and programs in biomedicine
records.clinical_problem: reconstructing detailed 3D blood flow velocity and pressure fields in the cardiac left ventricle from color Doppler echocardiography, tested using fetal and adult heart simulations
records.patient_population: image-based flow simulations of fetal and adult hearts (synthetic data, not patient imaging)
records.model_description: a physics-informed neural network takes sparse, noisy 3D color Doppler velocity data as input and outputs reconstructed 3D flow velocity and pressure fields in the cardiac left ventricle

records.title: Graph Neural Network Learning on the Pediatric Structural Connectome.
records.model_family: graph neural networks (simple and residual graph convolutional networks), compared with multi-layer perceptron, random forest, and SVM
records.clinical_problem: sex classification from pediatric and adult structural brain connectome data
records.patient_population: adult BRIGHT dataset (147 Hodgkin lymphoma survivors, 162 age-matched controls) and pediatric HCP-Development dataset (135 healthy subjects)
records.model_description: Structural brain connectome graphs (nodes as brain regions, edges as white matter connection strength) from adult and pediatric datasets are input to graph neural network models (simple and residual graph convolutional networks), compared against a multilayer perceptron, random forest, and support vector machine. Architecture experiments test network depth, pooling, and skip connections, with performance assessed by accuracy, AUC, and adversarial robustness; adult-trained models were also extended to and augmented with pediatric data.
records.headline_result: Adult GNN models achieved 85.1% accuracy in sex classification on unseen adult participants; the best model using pediatric data augmentation achieved 83.0% accuracy on pediatric and 81.3% on adult participants
records.study_design: retrospective multi-cohort methodological and classification study

records.title: Assessing Completeness of Clinical Histories Accompanying Imaging Orders Using Adapted Open-Source and Closed-Source Large Language Models.
records.exclusion_reason: large language model NLP applied to clinical-history text accompanying imaging orders in a mixed adult/pediatric emergency department; not an image-based imaging AI model and not pediatric-specific

records.title: Deep Learning-Enhanced Ultra-high-resolution CT Imaging for Superior Temporal Bone Visualization.
records.clinical_problem: Improve image quality and diagnostic visualization of temporal bone structures on ultra-high-resolution CT using deep learning reconstruction, including in a pediatric-dose protocol
records.patient_population: 35 patients (57 temporal bones): 30 in the adult protocol subgroup, 5 children in the pediatric protocol subgroup
records.model_description: Applies a vendor-specific deep learning reconstruction algorithm (AiCE Inner Ear) to ultra-high-resolution temporal bone CT raw data, producing denoised images with improved contrast-to-noise and signal-to-noise ratios compared to hybrid iterative reconstruction, evaluated in both adult- and pediatric-dose protocols.
records.release_evidence: a novel, vendor-specific deep learning-based reconstruction (DLR) algorithm called AiCE Inner Ear
records.dataset_size: 57 temporal bones from 35 patients (30 adult protocol, 5 pediatric protocol)
records.headline_result: DLR significantly improved subjective image quality (p<0.024), reduced noise (p<0.001), increased CNR/SNR (p<0.001) in both adult and pediatric protocol subgroups

records.title: Artificial Intelligence for Neuroimaging in Pediatric Cancer.
records.clinical_problem: use of AI to improve pediatric cancer neuroimaging (tumor detection, segmentation, characterization, treatment planning)
records.patient_population: children with cancer undergoing neuroimaging (narrative review, no single study population)
records.model_description: Narrative review of AI applications in pediatric cancer neuroimaging, covering accelerated image acquisition, reduced radiation dose, convolutional neural networks for tumor segmentation, radiomics for tumor characterization, and functional imaging tools; also discusses limited pediatric datasets, developmental variability, ethics, and explainability as challenges.

records.title: Diagnosis on Ultrasound Images for Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip with a Deep Learning-Based Model Focusing on Signal Heterogeneity in the Bone Region.
records.clinical_problem: automated diagnosis of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) in infants from ultrasound images
records.patient_population: 417 infants at risk of DDH
records.model_description: Combines CNN-based apex-point estimation (HigherHRNet-W48) with 3D-transformed 2D ultrasound images and signal-heterogeneity analysis of the ilium as input, outputting alpha-angle-based DDH diagnosis and image quality classification.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.92 for DDH detection in qualifying images, exceeding orthopedic resident accuracy
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and validation study

records.title: Evaluation of the Performance of a YOLOv10-Based Deep Learning Model for Tooth Detection and Numbering on Panoramic Radiographs of Patients in the Mixed Dentition Period.
records.exclusion_reason: tooth detection and numbering on dental panoramic radiographs; dental imaging is excluded from this database's scope

records.title: Automatic Evaluation of Bone Age Using Hand Radiographs and Pancorporal Radiographs in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis.
records.clinical_problem: Can automated bone age assessment support skeletal maturity monitoring in adolescents with idiopathic scoliosis?
records.patient_population: over 250 clinical AIS patients (testing); trained on RSNA Bone Age dataset
records.model_description: A custom DenseNet201-based deep neural network estimates bone age from hand radiographs, with Score-CAM explainability, trained on the RSNA Bone Age dataset and tested on adolescent idiopathic scoliosis patients; compared against the BoneXpert commercial system.
records.dataset_size: RSNA Bone Age dataset (training); >250 AIS patients (testing)
records.headline_result: MAE 4.87 months on clinical AIS test set
records.study_design: retrospective model development and clinical validation

records.title: The Effectiveness of Transabdominal Ultrasonography in Managing Chronic Constipation in the Elderly, with a Focus on the Underlying Pathological Conditions.

records.exclusion_reason: review of ultrasound diagnosis of polycystic ovary syndrome in women of reproductive age; adolescence is one modifying factor and the population is not pediatric

records.title: FHD deep learning prognosis approach: Early detection of fetal heart disease (FHD) using ultrasonography image-based IROI combined multiresolution DCNN.
records.journal: Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine
records.model_family: Multiresolution Deep Convolutional Neural Network (MDCNN) with intensified region-of-interest segmentation
records.clinical_problem: early detection of fetal heart disease (four-chamber and blood-vessel malformations) from ultrasound imaging
records.patient_population: fetal ultrasound images with normal and abnormal four-chamber/vessel findings
records.model_description: Input: 2D fetal ultrasound images preprocessed with adaptive median filtering; output: MDCNN classification of normal vs. abnormal fetal heart disease patterns after intensified region-of-interest segmentation.
records.headline_result: overall classification efficiency of 99.79% for normal and abnormal conditions

records.title: Deep Learning-based Aligned Strain from Cine Cardiac MRI for Detection of Fibrotic Myocardial Tissue in Patients with Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.
records.clinical_problem: Can a deep learning-derived strain measure from noncontrast cardiac MRI detect myocardial fibrosis in boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy?
records.patient_population: 139 male patients with DMD, mean age 15.2±3.1 years
records.model_description: A deep learning pipeline detects key cardiac-cycle frames and deformation fields on noncontrast cine cardiac MRI to derive an 'aligned strain' measure, used to identify myocardial segments with fibrosis in Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
records.headline_result: Identified 5x more fibrotic-vs-nonfibrotic differences (29 vs 5, p<.01); improved specificity by 40%, accuracy by 17%

records.title: MIMI-ONET: Multi-Modal image augmentation via Butterfly Optimized neural network for Huntington DiseaseDetection.
records.model_family: Hepta-GAN augmentation with deep neural network classification
records.clinical_problem: detecting/classifying Huntington's disease, including juvenile-onset disease, from brain MRI using augmented multimodal images
records.patient_population: Image-HD dataset patients classified as normal control, adult-onset HD, or juvenile HD
records.model_description: Input: multimodal brain MRI decomposed by stationary wavelet transform; output: Hepta-GAN-augmented images classified by a deep neural network into normal control, adult-onset Huntington disease, or juvenile Huntington disease.
records.headline_result: accuracy 98.85%, PSNR 48.05, improving overall accuracy 1.85-13.8 percentage points over compared architectures

records.title: Artificial Intelligence Iterative Reconstruction for Dose Reduction in Pediatric Chest CT: A Clinical Assessment via Below 3 Years Patients With Congenital Heart Disease.
records.clinical_problem: reducing radiation dose in pediatric chest CT while preserving image quality and diagnostic accuracy for pneumonia and airway stenosis in infants with congenital heart disease
records.patient_population: 191 patients below 3 years old with congenital heart disease, prospectively enrolled
records.model_description: Input: low-dose (~0.1 mSv) chest CT raw data; output: reconstructed images via AI iterative reconstruction (AIIR), compared to hybrid iterative reconstruction (HIR) and a routine-dose reference for image quality and diagnostic performance.
records.headline_result: AIIR images not significantly different from reference (P>0.05); airway stenosis grading consistency 88.5% (AIIR) vs 56.5% (HIR)

records.title: Development of an artificial intelligence-based multimodal diagnostic system for early detection of biliary atresia.
records.clinical_problem: early diagnosis of biliary atresia in infants using multimodal data including ultrasound images
records.patient_population: 1,579 participants in retrospective study (infants/newborns); 171 cases in prospective external validation
records.model_description: Input: ultrasound images combined with clinical data and laboratory results (a simplified version uses only easily obtainable data, no blood draw); output: probability of biliary atresia, compared against human experts of varying experience.
records.headline_result: internal test AUC 0.9870 (multimodal), 0.9799 (simplified); external test AUC 0.9740 vs. experienced radiologist AUC 0.9766; less-experienced radiologist AI-assisted AUC improved from 0.6667 to 0.9006
records.study_design: retrospective model development with prospective external validation and reader comparison

records.title: [Early diagnosis of ASD using biomarkers: a narrative review].
records.exclusion_reason: broad narrative review of ASD biomarkers spanning genetics, EEG, eye-tracking, and digital devices; neuroimaging AI is only one small part, not primarily a radiology AI review

records.title: Radiomics analysis of placental MRI for prenatal prediction of placenta accreta spectrum in pregnant women in the third trimester: A retrospective study of 594 patients.

records.title: Predicting the onset of mental health problems in adolescents.

records.patient_population: discovery N=3236 (168-513 per group with MRI), validation N=3851 (84-231, no MRI), ABCD study children/adolescents
records.model_description: Machine-learning models take demographic, symptom, and neuroimaging (MRI) data as input from children aged 9-10 years to predict onset of six different mental health problems by age 12 as output.
records.headline_result: AUCs 0.71-0.90 for predicting six mental health problems; neuroimaging added limited value over symptoms
records.study_design: prospective cohort study with machine learning model development and validation

records.title: Development of artificial neural network model for predicting the rapid maxillary expansion technique in children with cleft lip and palate.
records.exclusion_reason: orthodontic/dental imaging (CBCT of mid-palatal suture for maxillary expansion planning in cleft palate); dental imaging excluded per rule

records.title: Deep Learning Model for Real-Time Nuchal Translucency Assessment at Prenatal US.
records.clinical_problem: identifying the standard nuchal translucency imaging plane and measuring NT thickness in real time during prenatal ultrasound
records.patient_population: 3959 NT images from 3153 fetuses (internal dataset); 267 ultrasound videos from 267 fetuses (external dataset)
records.model_description: A deep learning model (AIM-NT) identifies the nuchal translucency plane in real time and measures NT thickness on prenatal ultrasound, benchmarked against experienced radiologists on internal and external multicenter datasets.
records.dataset_size: 3959 images (3153 fetuses) internal; 267 videos (267 fetuses) external
records.headline_result: AUC 0.92 for NT plane identification; no significant difference from radiologists in accuracy (88.8% vs 87.6%) or thickness measurement
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development with external validation

records.title: Multi-Parameter MRI for Evaluating Glymphatic Impairment and White-Matter Abnormalities and Discriminating Refractory Epilepsy in Children.
records.clinical_problem: Distinguishing refractory from drug-sensitive epilepsy in children using glymphatic-function and white-matter MRI markers
records.patient_population: 70 children with drug-sensitive epilepsy and 26 with refractory epilepsy
records.model_description: DTI-ALPS index, fractional anisotropy, mean diffusivity and nodal efficiency from multi-parameter MRI are combined into a machine-learning model, evaluated by five-fold cross-validation, to discriminate refractory from drug-sensitive pediatric epilepsy
records.headline_result: Cross-validated ROC AUC 0.83 (sensitivity 78.2%, specificity 84.8%)

records.title: Effects of Different Individuals and Verbal Tones on Neural Networks in the Brain of Children with Cerebral Palsy.
records.exclusion_reason: EEG-based study of brain neural activity in response to verbal tone in children with cerebral palsy; non-imaging (EEG signals), not radiology

records.title: Review of the Current State of Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance Imaging.
records.clinical_problem: cardiac MRI in congenital heart disease is slow to acquire and slow to analyze, which limits how widely it can be used
records.patient_population: children and adults with congenital heart disease
records.model_description: A review of AI across the whole cardiac MRI pipeline in congenital heart disease: acquisition and reconstruction, then image processing and reporting, then clinical use cases. The framing is throughput rather than accuracy — the barrier to using cardiac MRI more in this population is how long each study takes to acquire and to read.

records.title: Advances in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Precision Medicine in Necrotizing Enterocolitis and Neonatal Sepsis: A State-of-the-Art Review.
records.clinical_problem: predicting and diagnosing necrotizing enterocolitis early enough to change its course in preterm infants
records.patient_population: neonates, particularly preterm infants, across the reviewed literature
records.model_description: A state-of-the-art review of AI for necrotizing enterocolitis and neonatal sepsis, covering risk stratification from clinical variables, novel biomarkers, and deep learning on abdominal imaging, which it reports detects abnormality earlier than conventional reading. It names the usual obstacles — data heterogeneity, interpretability, no large-scale validation — which in this disease are compounded by how rare and how fast-moving it is.

records.title: Retrospective Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effectiveness of a New Tanner-Whitehouse-Based Bone Age Assessment Algorithm Trained with a Deep Neural Network System.
records.clinical_problem: How well does a commercial deep learning bone age system based on the Tanner-Whitehouse method agree with pediatric radiologists?
records.patient_population: 560 Korean children and adolescents (280 female, 280 male), mean age 9.43±2.92 years
records.model_description: A commercialized deep learning system, built on a Rotated Single Shot MultiBox Detector and EfficientNet-B0, automatically assigns Tanner-Whitehouse (TW3) bone age from hand and wrist radiographs.
records.release_evidence: A commercialized AI solution built upon the Rotated Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD) and EfficientNet-B0 was used
records.headline_result: r2=0.977 vs radiologists; RMSE 0.529 years, MAE 0.388 years; 82.3% within 0.6 years of radiologist assessment
records.study_design: retrospective clinical trial comparing AI to pediatric radiologists

records.title: Age-Related Regional Changes in Choroidal Vascularity in Healthy Emmetropic Eyes.
records.exclusion_reason: ophthalmic optical coherence tomography study of choroidal vascularity; non-radiologic imaging excluded per rule

records.title: Self-supervised denoising diffusion probabilistic models for abdominal DW-MRI.
records.clinical_problem: Can a deep learning denoising method improve image quality and lesion detection on single-repetition diffusion-weighted MRI of children's liver tumors, without needing longer scan times?
records.patient_population: 120 pediatric subjects with liver tumors
records.model_description: A self-supervised denoising diffusion probabilistic model (ssDDPM), constrained by the diffusion signal decay model, denoises single-repetition abdominal diffusion-weighted MRI images in pediatric patients to improve ADC accuracy and lesion visibility while shortening scan time.
records.headline_result: Superior image quality, lesion conspicuity, and ADC accuracy vs. non-local means and deep image prior denoising
records.study_design: retrospective method development and comparison study

records.title: The gSOS Polygenic Score is Associated with Bone Density and Fracture Risk in Childhood.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
records.exclusion_reason: polygenic risk score (genetic/genomics-based) model for bone density and fracture risk; DXA-derived bone density is used only as an outcome measure, not as imaging model input

records.title: Brain Age Prediction in Type II GM1 Gangliosidosis.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
records.clinical_problem: Predict brain age and regional brain structure age gaps from MRI to serve as a neuroimaging biomarker of disease severity/progression in GM1 gangliosidosis
records.patient_population: 81 MRI scans from 41 Type II GM1 gangliosidosis patients (juvenile and late-infantile subtypes) and 897 MRI scans from 556 neurotypical controls
records.model_description: Applies a machine learning MRI analysis pipeline (BrainStructuresAges) to compute predicted brain age and regional Brain Structures Age Gap Estimation from structural MRI, showing accelerated brain aging rates in GM1 gangliosidosis patients that correlate with clinical severity, intended as a surrogate outcome measure for clinical trials.
records.dataset_size: 81 MRI scans from 41 GM1 patients; 897 MRI scans from 556 neurotypical controls
records.headline_result: Whole-brain aging rate: 0.83/year (controls) vs 1.57/year (juvenile GM1) vs 12.25/year (late-infantile GM1); predicted brain age and BSAGE correlated with clinical assessments
records.study_design: retrospective cross-sectional/longitudinal neuroimaging biomarker study (medRxiv preprint)

records.title: Research advancements in the Use of artificial intelligence for prenatal diagnosis of neural tube defects.
records.model_family: CNNs, SVMs, and deep-learning methods (including Oct-U-Net and PAICS)
records.clinical_problem: Reviewing how AI and machine learning improve early detection, prediction, and assessment of neural tube defects through prenatal ultrasound
records.patient_population: review of studies using fetal ultrasound images, genetic data, and maternal health records for neural tube defect detection
records.model_description: A review of AI and machine-learning techniques (CNNs, SVMs, and deep-learning segmentation/detection methods such as Oct-U-Net and PAICS) applied to prenatal ultrasound, genetic data, and maternal health records for detecting and predicting neural tube defects.
records.headline_result: detection accuracy up to 95%; AI-assisted ultrasound sensitivity 88.9% and specificity 98.0% (versus 81.5%/92.2% for traditional methods); deep-learning models (Oct-U-Net, PAICS) recall/precision 0.93/0.96

records.title: Automatic ultrasound image alignment for diagnosis of pediatric distal forearm fractures.
records.journal: International journal of computer assisted radiology and surgery
records.model_family: deep learning bone-boundary delineation with optimization-based image alignment
records.clinical_problem: using AI-aligned point-of-care ultrasound instead of X-rays to diagnose pediatric distal forearm fractures and reduce radiation exposure
records.patient_population: children with distal forearm injuries imaged with point-of-care ultrasound
records.model_description: Input: paired point-of-care ultrasound images of the distal forearm; output: deep-learning-delineated bone boundaries and landmarks used to automatically align ultrasound image pairs for fracture classification and angulation measurement.

records.title: Brain tissue biomarker impact bone age in central precocious puberty more than hormones: a quantitative synthetic magnetic resonance study.
records.model_family: deep learning (TW3 bone age scoring) + quantitative synthetic MRI
records.clinical_problem: Determine whether brain tissue composition biomarkers from synthetic MRI relate more strongly to bone age development than reproductive hormones in central precocious puberty
records.patient_population: 84 children with central precocious puberty and 84 controls
records.model_description: Uses quantitative synthetic MRI (SyMRI) to derive brain tissue component volumes (myelin, white matter, gray matter, CSF) and a deep learning model to score Tanner-Whitehouse III bone age from hand-wrist X-rays, then correlates these with hormone levels in children with central precocious puberty.
records.headline_result: TW3-Carpal score positively correlated with myelin content (r=0.397, P<0.001); not correlated with hormone levels

records.title: Birth weight prediction using artificial intelligence-based placental assessment from macroscopic photo: a retrospective study.
records.exclusion_reason: AI applied to macroscopic photographs of gross placental pathology specimens, not a standard radiologic imaging modality

records.title: Quantitative T1 Mapping Indicates Elevated White Matter Myelin in Children With RASopathies.
records.clinical_problem: distinguishing children with RASopathies from typically developing children using myelin content measures
records.patient_population: 72 children (49 with RASopathies, 23 typically developing)
records.model_description: Quantitative T1 mapping (macromolecular tissue volume in white matter, cortical R1) is combined with a support vector machine classifier to distinguish children with RASopathies from typically developing children based on myelination patterns.
records.headline_result: SVM classification accuracy 87%

records.title: Efficacy of artificial intelligence in radiographic dental age estimation of patients undergoing dental maturation: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
records.exclusion_reason: dental radiographic age estimation review; excluded as non-radiologic dental imaging per scope rules

records.title: Artificial intelligence in fetal brain imaging: Advancements, challenges, and multimodal approaches for biometric and structural analysis.
records.clinical_problem: how AI can improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in fetal brain imaging via ultrasound and MRI
records.patient_population: fetal brain imaging patients generally
records.model_description: A review of deep learning and attention-based AI methods for fetal brain biometric and structural analysis on ultrasound and MRI, with emphasis on multimodal integration of the two modalities' complementary strengths.

records.title: Automated cervix biometry, volumetry and normative models for 3D motion-corrected T2-weighted 0.55-3T fetal MRI during 2nd and 3rd trimesters.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
records.clinical_problem: Can an automated deep learning pipeline measure cervical biometry on fetal MRI to track cervical remodeling during pregnancy?
records.patient_population: 20 evaluation datasets (0.55T and 3T); 270 normal term pregnancies (16-40 weeks GA) for the normative model
records.model_description: A deep learning pipeline performs automated multi-layer segmentation and biometric measurement of the pregnant cervix on 3D motion-corrected T2-weighted fetal MRI, used to build normative growth models and population-averaged cervix atlases.
records.headline_result: Good agreement with manual measurements; inlet diameter and length correlated most strongly with gestational age
records.study_design: method development and normative modeling study (preprint)

records.title: Maternal Plasma Proteins Associated with Birth Weight: A Longitudinal, Large Scale Proteomic Study.
records.exclusion_reason: proteomic biomarker study of maternal plasma proteins predicting birth weight; no imaging component

records.title: Predicting Postoperative Prognosis in Pediatric Malignant Tumor With MRI Radiomics and Deep Learning Models: A Retrospective Study.
records.model_family: gradient boosting / deep learning (3D ResNet-18 features + radiomics)
records.clinical_problem: Predict 3-year postoperative disease-free survival in pediatric malignant brain tumor patients by combining MRI radiomics, deep learning features, and clinical indices
records.patient_population: 260 pediatric patients with brain tumors who underwent R0 resection, age <=14 years
records.model_description: Extracts 1,130 radiomics features (Pyradiomics) and 511 deep learning features (3D ResNet-18) from preoperative T1-enhanced MRI with manually delineated tumors, combines them with clinical indices via Lasso feature reduction, and trains machine learning models (SVM, random forest, LightGBM) to predict 3-year disease-free survival.
records.headline_result: Fusion model (LightGBM): AUC 0.859, accuracy 85.2%; combined with clinical indexes AUC improved to 0.909
records.study_design: retrospective multimodal ML model development study

records.title: A fully automatic Cobb angle measurement framework of full-spine DR images based on deep learning.
records.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society
records.clinical_problem: Automatically measure the Cobb angle from full-spine radiographs to assess scoliosis severity, replacing time-consuming manual measurement with variability
records.patient_population: children and adolescents undergoing full-spine DR for scoliosis (1,163 AP and 1,378 LAT view images)
records.model_description: A deep learning framework (YOLOv8 with CBAM) classifies AP/LAT spine views, locates the region of interest, detects vertebral boundaries, types, and corner points, and automatically computes the Cobb angle from full-spine digital radiographs.
records.dataset_size: 1,163 AP view and 1,378 LAT view DR images
records.headline_result: Mean Cobb angle error 2.56 deg (AP), 2.50 deg (LAT); ICC 0.956 (AP), 0.925 (LAT); reader study major curve error 3.92 deg, ICC 0.943
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development with reader study validation

records.title: Integrating neuron-specific enolase and venous-phase enhanced computed tomography radiomics for improved survival prediction in high-risk neuroblastoma: a two-center study.
records.model_family: radiomics score (Cox regression) combined with a clinical biomarker (neuron-specific enolase)
records.clinical_problem: improving survival prediction in high-risk pediatric neuroblastoma by combining a clinical marker (neuron-specific enolase) with CT radiomics
records.patient_population: 140 patients with high-risk neuroblastoma (70 training, 30 test, 40 external validation) from two centers
records.model_description: Input: venous-phase enhanced CT radiomics features plus neuron-specific enolase; output: combined model predicting overall survival in high-risk neuroblastoma, externally validated.
records.headline_result: combined model 5-year overall survival AUC 0.780 (train), 0.742 (test), 0.710 (external validation); concordance indices 0.730/0.707/0.690
records.study_design: two-center retrospective study with external validation

records.title: Tailoring ventilation and respiratory management in pediatric critical care: optimizing care with precision medicine.
records.exclusion_reason: review of precision medicine for pediatric ventilation/respiratory management; imaging (lung ultrasound) is only one of several non-imaging technologies discussed (EIT, NAVA, ventilator monitoring ML), not the focus

records.title: Deep learning-based auto-contouring of organs/structures-at-risk for pediatric upper abdominal radiotherapy.
records.journal: Radiotherapy and oncology : journal of the European Society for Therapeutic Radiology and Oncology
records.clinical_problem: automated multi-organ segmentation of organs at risk for radiotherapy planning in pediatric patients with upper abdominal tumors (renal tumors, neuroblastoma)
records.patient_population: 189 in-house pediatric postoperative CTs (renal tumors/neuroblastoma) + 189 public thoracoabdominal CTs
records.model_description: CT-based deep-learning multi-organ segmentation models (Model-PMC-UMCU trained on in-house data; Model-Combined trained on combined in-house and public data) take pediatric upper abdominal CT scans as input and output contours of 17 organs at risk for radiotherapy planning.
records.headline_result: Mean DSC >0.95 for 5/9 clinician-delineated OARs; stomach-bowel and pancreas DSC <0.90
records.study_design: retrospective multi-dataset deep learning segmentation model development and validation study

records.title: Computed tomography based radiomics signature for predicting the expression of vascular endothelial growth factor in pediatric patients with nephroblastoma.
records.model_family: radiomics signature (logistic regression) combined with a clinical nomogram
records.clinical_problem: predicting vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) expression in pediatric nephroblastoma (Wilms tumor) using CT radiomics
records.patient_population: 73 pediatric patients with nephroblastoma
records.model_description: Input: CT radiomics features extracted from a manually marked tumor region of interest plus clinicopathological data; output: radiomics-based nomogram predicting VEGF expression level.
records.headline_result: logistic regression radiomics model AUC 0.761 (training), 0.791 (test)

records.title: Retinal and choroidal microvasculature and structural analysis in OCTA for refractive amblyopia diagnosis using machine learning.
records.exclusion_reason: non-radiologic ophthalmic imaging (retinal and choroidal OCTA) for amblyopia diagnosis

records.title: Combining lipidomics and machine learning to identify lipid biomarkers for nonsyndromic cleft lip with palate.
records.exclusion_reason: maternal serum lipidomics biomarkers for cleft lip; non-imaging

records.title: Interpretable deep neural networks for advancing early neonatal birth weight prediction using multimodal maternal factors.
records.exclusion_reason: Predicts neonatal birth weight from tabular maternal clinical, nutritional, and lifestyle data using a TabNet deep-learning model; the abstract explicitly contrasts this with traditional ultrasonography-based prediction and does not use imaging inputs.

records.title: New developments in ultrasound and MRI imaging of pediatric rheumatic diseases.
records.exclusion_reason: review of ultrasound/MRI imaging techniques and standardization in pediatric rheumatic disease; AI integration is mentioned only as a topic 'to be discussed,' without substantive detail in the abstract

records.title: Artificial intelligence for children with attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a scoping review.
records.clinical_problem: using AI for prediction, early diagnosis and classification of attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder in children
records.patient_population: children with ADHD (across 52 reviewed studies)
records.model_description: A scoping review of 52 studies applying AI, mostly machine learning (especially support vector machines) and convolutional neural networks, to MRI and other data for ADHD diagnosis, prediction and classification in children.
records.dataset_size: 52 studies reviewed, most (54%) with under 1,000 samples
records.headline_result: Highest reported accuracy 98.23% among CNN-based studies

records.title: Automatic segmentation and quantitative analysis of brain CT volume in 2-year-olds using deep learning model.
records.clinical_problem: Can deep learning automatically segment and measure brain volumes on CT in healthy 2-year-old children to create normative reference values?
records.patient_population: 1,487 head CT scans of healthy 2-year-old children
records.model_description: A ResU-Net deep learning model automatically segments brain regions on head CT of 2-year-old children, producing regional brain volume measurements used to build a normative reference database.
records.headline_result: Dice coefficient 0.96 (testing set) with ResU-Net (3,3,3) kernel

records.title: Artificial intelligence in pediatric osteopenia diagnosis: evaluating deep network classification and model interpretability using wrist X-rays.
records.model_family: CNN and transformer models (six networks compared; DenseNet201 with transfer learning best)
records.clinical_problem: Classifying osteopenia versus healthy bone from pediatric wrist X-rays as an alternative to bone mineral density assessment, with interpretable visual explanations
records.patient_population: pediatric wrist X-rays from the GRAZPEDWRI-DX dataset
records.model_description: Six deep networks (CNNs and transformer models) are trained to classify osteopenia versus healthy bone from pediatric wrist X-rays in the public GRAZPEDWRI-DX dataset, with two explainable-AI techniques used to visualize and interpret the networks' decisions.
records.dataset_size: GRAZPEDWRI-DX pediatric wrist X-ray dataset (exact n not stated)
records.headline_result: DenseNet201 with transfer learning achieved the top classification accuracy of 95.2%
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and evaluation on a public pediatric wrist radiograph dataset

records.title: Computer-aided assessment for enlarged fetal heart with deep learning model.
records.model_family: YOLOv8 with CBAM attention module and ResNeXtBlock
records.clinical_problem: automating detection of fetal heart enlargement on prenatal ultrasound as an indicator of possible congenital heart disease
records.patient_population: prenatal ultrasound video dataset (size not stated)
records.model_description: A YOLOv8 object-detection model with a CBAM attention module and a ResNeXtBlock residual network automatically detects fetal heart enlargement from prenatal ultrasound videos, compared against a YOLOv11 self-attention variant.
records.study_design: retrospective algorithm development and benchmark comparison

records.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging in the Clinical Evaluation of Lung Disorders: Current Status and Future Prospects.
records.journal: Journal of magnetic resonance imaging : JMRI
records.exclusion_reason: Narrative review of pulmonary MRI technique and clinical applications across all patient populations; AI is mentioned only briefly as a future development direction, not the review's focus, and pediatric patients are mentioned only as one beneficiary group among several (pregnant women, patients needing longitudinal monitoring).

records.title: TIER-LOC: Visual Query-based Video Clip Localization in fetal ultrasound videos with a multi-tier transformer.
records.clinical_problem: Can an AI model automatically find relevant video clips (e.g., standard views) within fetal ultrasound sweep videos, to assist sonographer workflow and anomaly detection?
records.patient_population: fetal ultrasound heart-sweep videos and the large-scale PULSE dataset for fetal anomaly detection
records.model_description: TIER-LOC is a multi-tier spatio-temporal transformer that retrieves the video clip in a fetal ultrasound sweep matching a given example (query) frame, used to detect standard-view clips in fetal heart sweeps and to support fetal anomaly detection.
records.dataset_size: two ultrasound video datasets plus PULSE dataset
records.headline_result: Outperformed best prior state-of-the-art model by 7%, 4%, and 4% across three datasets
records.study_design: retrospective method development and benchmark comparison

records.title: Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy Imaging Endophenotypes and Relationship With Cognition and Resting-State EEG.
records.model_family: supervised machine learning classifier + K-means clustering
records.clinical_problem: Explaining heterogeneous cortical-thickness findings in Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy by defining imaging-based endophenotypes and relating them to cognition and EEG
records.patient_population: 64 JME patients aged 12-25 and 41 age/sex-matched healthy controls
records.model_description: Data-driven comparison of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes between JME patients and controls; supervised machine learning confirms the classification power of these differences, and K-means clustering groups patients into imaging endophenotypes correlated with cognition and EEG
records.headline_result: Three discrete imaging endophenotypes identified (left, right, symmetric), with left-hemisphere disease linked to lower general cognitive performance
records.study_design: prospective cohort study (Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy Connectome Project)

records.title: Machine learning-based approaches for distinguishing viral and bacterial pneumonia in paediatrics: A scoping review.
records.journal: Computer methods and programs in biomedicine
records.clinical_problem: scoping review of machine learning approaches distinguishing viral from bacterial pneumonia on pediatric chest X-ray
records.patient_population: children 0-18 years, across 35 included studies
records.model_description: scoping review summarizing machine learning/deep learning (predominantly CNN) models that take pediatric chest X-rays as input and output classification of viral vs. bacterial pneumonia, largely using the public Kermany dataset
records.headline_result: median accuracy 92.3% (binary viral vs. bacterial), 91.8% (multiclass)

records.title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Echocardiographic Image-Analysis for the Diagnosis of Fetal Congenital Heart Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
records.model_family: various AI/deep learning models for ultrasound image analysis (ResNet, DenseNet among others)
records.clinical_problem: assessing the diagnostic accuracy of AI-assisted echocardiography for fetal congenital heart disease
records.patient_population: fetal echocardiography studies pooled across 7 included studies (19 datasets)
records.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI-assisted echocardiographic image-analysis models used to diagnose fetal congenital heart disease, pooling diagnostic accuracy across 7 studies.
records.headline_result: pooled sensitivity 0.93, specificity 0.93, AUC (SROC) 0.98; ResNet/DenseNet architectures had better diagnostic performance than other models

records.title: Get the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Edge in Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
records.journal: Journal of obstetrics and gynaecology of India
records.exclusion_reason: general editorial on AI across obstetrics and gynaecology (fertility, cancer treatment, CTG, imaging); not focused on pediatric or fetal radiology AI specifically

records.title: A Medical Multimodal Large Language Model for Pediatric Pneumonia.
records.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
records.clinical_problem: Support differential diagnosis, treatment planning, and generation of medical records/radiology reports for pediatric pneumonia
records.patient_population: 163,999 outpatient and 8,684 inpatient pediatric cases; test set of 642 samples verified by pediatric pulmonology specialists
records.model_description: A medical multimodal large language model trained on a three-stage strategy using plain-text clinical records and interleaved image-text pairs (2D chest X-ray, 3D chest CT, and radiology reports) to generate free-text medical records and radiology reports and support clinical decision-making for pediatric pneumonia.
records.dataset_size: 163,999 outpatient and 8,684 inpatient cases (training); 642-sample test set
records.headline_result: Automated LLM scoring corroborated by manual specialist scoring on 642-sample test set demonstrating superiority of P2Med-MLLM (no single numeric headline given)
records.study_design: retrospective large-scale multimodal model development and evaluation study

records.title: Machine Learning-Based Identification of Children With Intermittent Exotropia Using Multiple Resting-State Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Features.
records.model_family: machine learning (logistic regression best; multiple classifiers compared)
records.clinical_problem: Can resting-state functional brain MRI distinguish children with intermittent exotropia from healthy peers?
records.patient_population: 41 children with intermittent exotropia and 36 healthy controls
records.model_description: Machine learning classifiers (best: logistic regression with ANOVA feature selection) use resting-state fMRI regional activity/connectivity features across 360 brain regions to distinguish children with intermittent exotropia from healthy controls.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.957 (training), 0.804 (validation), 0.818 (test)

records.title: MRI-based deep learning with clinical and imaging features to differentiate medulloblastoma and ependymoma in children.
records.clinical_problem: differentiating medulloblastoma from ependymoma in children, tumors that are difficult to distinguish clinically
records.patient_population: 201 patients across three study centers
records.model_description: A fine-tuned AlexNet-based deep learning classifier applied to T2-weighted MRI is fused with clinical and imaging features via a decision-tree model to differentiate medulloblastoma from ependymoma.
records.headline_result: Fusion model AUC 0.987 (train) / 0.889 (test), versus 0.712/0.689 for the imaging-only DL model

records.title: Comparison of bone age assessment using manual Greulich and Pyle method versus automated BoneXpert method in South African children.
records.model_family: automated bone age software (image analysis algorithm)
records.clinical_problem: Compare automated (BoneXpert) versus manual (Greulich-Pyle) bone age assessment methods in children with pediatric endocrinology diagnoses
records.patient_population: 260 left hand-wrist radiographs of South African children with various pediatric endocrinology diagnoses
records.model_description: BoneXpert automatically analyzes hand-wrist radiographs to compute a composite (carpal + tubular bone) bone age score, compared against the manual Greulich-Pyle method performed by three independent readers.
records.release_evidence: BoneXpert software performed automated bone age assessment
records.headline_result: ICC between Manual BA and BoneXpert BA = 0.982; best-fit composite weighting: 50% carpal, 50% tubular bones

records.title: [Artificial intelligence and ultrasound in fetal medicine].
records.clinical_problem: What is the current and future role of AI in fetal ultrasound diagnosis and training?
records.model_description: Narrative review of AI applications in fetal ultrasound medicine, covering workflow improvement, diagnostic standardization, clinician training, and current limitations and regulatory challenges.

records.title: Evaluation of an artificial intelligence noise reduction tool for conventional X-ray imaging - a visual grading study of pediatric chest examinations at different radiation dose levels using anthropomorphic phantoms.
records.clinical_problem: improving image quality or allowing radiation dose reduction for pediatric chest radiography using an AI noise-reduction tool
records.patient_population: anthropomorphic phantoms simulating pediatric chest radiography, multiple dose levels
records.model_description: An AI-based intelligent noise-reduction algorithm is applied to conventional pediatric chest radiographs across a range of radiation dose levels and graded by pediatric radiologists using visual grading characteristics analysis.
records.headline_result: Image quality significantly better with INR at dose levels >=80% versus standard-dose reference

records.title: Development and validation of an early diagnosis model for severe mycoplasma pneumonia in children based on interpretable machine learning.
records.exclusion_reason: early warning model for severe mycoplasma pneumonia built from serum biomarkers; chest CT contributes one variable among 21 serum indicators and no image is analyzed

records.title: Prevention of Pre-Eclampsia: Modern Strategies and the Role of Early Screening.
records.exclusion_reason: general review of pre-eclampsia screening (maternal biomarkers, risk factors); imaging AI mentioned only briefly as one of several approaches, not the review's focus

records.title: The role of AI in reducing maternal mortality: Current impacts and future potentials: Protocol for an analytical cross-sectional study.
records.exclusion_reason: study protocol for a maternal-health system intervention (SMS-based PROMPTS plus point-of-care ultrasound); not a radiology AI model development/validation study and imaging component is not described as AI-based interpretation

records.title: Machine learning-based predictive modeling of depressive symptoms in Chinese adolescents.
records.exclusion_reason: machine learning prediction of depressive symptoms in adolescents from lifestyle survey data; explicitly no neuroimaging biomarkers used

records.title: CLIF-Net: Intersection-Guided Cross-View Fusion Network for Infection Detection From Cranial Ultrasound.
records.model_family: cross-view fusion convolutional neural network (dual-branch with cross-attention)
records.clinical_problem: detecting possible serious bacterial infection in newborns using multi-view cranial ultrasound images
records.patient_population: newborn infants undergoing cranial ultrasound at Mbale Regional Referral Hospital, Uganda
records.model_description: Input: paired coronal and sagittal cranial ultrasound images; output: intersection-guided cross-view fusion network combining both views to classify possible serious bacterial infection vs. non-infection.
records.headline_result: CLIF-Net demonstrated substantially enhanced performance over prevailing state-of-the-art infection detection techniques (no single numeric metric stated)
records.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation study

records.title: SegQC: a segmentation network-based framework for multi-metric segmentation quality control and segmentation error detection in volumetric medical images.
records.clinical_problem: Automatically estimate segmentation quality and detect segmentation errors in fetal MRI structures to support clinical QC and model development
records.patient_population: 198 fetal MRI scans
records.model_description: SegQCNet, a deep network, takes a scan and its segmentation mask and outputs voxel-wise segmentation error probabilities, from which quality metrics and error-region localization are computed for fetal brain, fetal body, and placenta segmentations, compared against expert radiologist corrections.

records.title: Lack of children in public medical imaging data points to growing age bias in biomedical AI.
records.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
records.clinical_problem: whether children are represented at all in the data that medical imaging AI is built on
records.patient_population: 181 public medical imaging datasets surveyed; adult-trained chest radiograph models then tested on children
records.model_description: A systematic audit rather than a model. It finds children make up just under 1% of the data in 181 public imaging datasets, while most machine learning imaging conference papers build methods on exactly those datasets, and only 17% of FDA-approved medical AI devices carry a pediatric label. It then demonstrates the consequence directly: adult-trained chest radiograph models show significant age bias applied to children, with higher false positive rates in younger ones.
records.headline_result: children are under 1% of data in 181 public imaging datasets; adult-trained chest radiograph models show higher false positive rates in younger children

records.clinical_problem: whether a general-purpose chatbot can substitute for dedicated bone age software, which is expensive
records.patient_population: 180 left-hand wrist radiographs of children aged 0-18 from the RSNA Pediatric Bone Age dataset
records.model_description: A clean negative result, and a useful one. Three general multimodal chatbots were asked to read bone age directly from the radiograph with no fine-tuning. They can do it, in the sense of producing plausible numbers, but errors of two to three years and limits of agreement beyond four and a half years put them nowhere near clinical or medico-legal use. Worth citing whenever someone proposes a general chatbot in place of dedicated software.
records.dataset_size: 180 radiographs from the public RSNA dataset
records.headline_result: best model (Gemini 2.5 Pro) mean absolute error 28.5 months; all models had 95% limits of agreement exceeding ±4.5 years

records.title: Cumulative impacts of early life adversity and persistent/recurrent pain in children: A longitudinal normative modelling study from the ABCD Study cohort.

records.title: The prediction models for the optimal timing of surgical intervention for necrotizing enterocolitis: nomogram vs. five machine learning models.

records.title: Validation of an artificial intelligence-based automated PRAGMA and mucus plugging algorithm in pediatric cystic fibrosis.

records.title: Predictive tools and scoring systems for surgical intervention in antenatal hydronephrosis and pelviureteric junction obstruction: An ATLAS based on comprehensive review of literature.

records.title: Predictive model integrating deep learning and clinical features based on ultrasound imaging data for surgical intervention in intussusception in children younger than 8 months.
records.model_family: pretrained deep-learning transfer-learning features + LASSO + logistic regression (combined model)

records.model_description: Deep transfer-learning features extracted from abdominal ultrasound images (via pretrained networks and LASSO feature selection) are combined with clinical variables in a logistic regression model to predict which infants with intussusception will require surgery after enema reduction, validated in an external-center and a prospective cohort.

records.title: Development and validation of a keypoint region-based convolutional neural network to automate thoracic Cobb angle measurements using whole-spine standing radiographs.

records.headline_result: MAE 2.22°, MSE 9.1, SMAPE 4.29%, ICC 0.98

records.title: A New Paradigm for Autism Spectrum Disorder Discrimination in Children Utilizing EEG Data Collected During Cartoon Viewing With a Focus on Atypical Semantic Processing.
records.journal: Autism research : official journal of the International Society for Autism Research
records.exclusion_reason: EEG-based semantic-processing study in autism; non-imaging (EEG) modality.

records.title: Predicting pediatric age from chest X-rays using deep learning: a novel approach.
records.clinical_problem: Estimating pediatric age from chest radiographs as a complement to bone age assessment, to help screen for abnormal growth and development
records.patient_population: 128,008 pediatric chest X-rays from two tertiary hospitals in Shanghai
records.model_description: A ResNet-based deep neural network with a Coordinate Attention mechanism predicts pediatric age directly from chest radiographs, using heatmap visualization to identify the anatomic regions (spine, mediastinum, heart) driving the prediction.
records.headline_result: MAE 5.86 (M)/5.80 (F) months internal; 7.40/7.29 months external; Spearman r>0.98
records.study_design: retrospective model development with internal and external validation

records.title: Machine learning-based method for the detection of dextrocardia in ultrasound video clips.
records.journal: Computer methods and programs in biomedicine
records.clinical_problem: Automatically detecting dextrocardia (a congenital anomaly) from routine fetal ultrasound sweeps.
records.patient_population: 142 pairs of Situs/4CH ultrasound images for training; 14 ultrasound videos (7 normal, 7 dextrocardia) for testing
records.model_description: A SegFormer transformer-based model segments fetal chest, spine, stomach, and heart from ultrasound video (Situs and four-chamber views), a quality-assessment module filters uninformative frames, and the relative left/right orientation of stomach and heart is used to classify dextrocardia.
records.dataset_size: 142 pairs of Situs/4CH images (training); 14 ultrasound videos, 2,916 frames total (testing)
records.headline_result: Dice scores 0.968/0.958/0.953/0.949 for chest/spine/stomach/heart segmentation; dextrocardia classification score (FBCS) of 0.99
records.study_design: retrospective model development and internal test-set evaluation

records.title: Development and Validation of an Interpretable Machine Learning Model for Predicting Adverse Clinical Outcomes in Placenta Accreta Spectrum: A Multicenter Study.
records.clinical_problem: Predicting adverse clinical outcomes (major hemorrhage, hysterectomy) in placenta accreta spectrum using MRI morphological indicators and clinical features
records.patient_population: 125 clinically confirmed PAS patients from two centers
records.model_description: Interpretable machine learning classifiers (AdaBoost, TabPFN, CatBoost) combine MRI morphological indicators with clinical features to predict adverse outcomes in placenta accreta spectrum, deployed as an online SHAP-explained risk calculator.
records.headline_result: CatBoost AUROC 0.90 internal, 0.84 external
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and external validation

records.title: Biomarker development in Sturge-Weber syndrome.
records.exclusion_reason: General biomarker review of Sturge-Weber syndrome; machine learning mentioned only briefly as future direction, not the focus.

records.title: Comparative Evaluation of Diagnosis and Treatment Plan Given by Pediatric Dentists and Generated by ChatGPT: A Cross-Sectional Pilot Study.
records.exclusion_reason: Comparison of ChatGPT text-based diagnosis/treatment planning with pediatric dentists; dental, not radiologic imaging AI

records.title: The Hidden Threat of Hallucinations in Binary Chest X-ray Pneumonia Classification.
records.journal: Proceedings. IEEE International Symposium on Computer-Based Medical Systems
records.clinical_problem: Whether binary deep-learning classifiers for pediatric pneumonia subtype (bacterial vs. viral) on chest X-ray are learning genuine pathogen-specific features or 'hallucinating' by relying on generic pneumonia signs.
records.patient_population: Pediatric chest X-ray dataset (size not stated)
records.model_description: Two binary CNN classifiers (bacterial-vs-normal, viral-vs-normal) and a third bacterial-vs-viral classifier are evaluated on pediatric chest radiographs using Matthews Correlation Coefficient and prediction entropy, to test whether they hallucinate confident but wrong predictions when shown an unseen pneumonia subtype.
records.dataset_size: pediatric chest X-ray dataset (size not stated)
records.headline_result: Normal/bacterial and normal/viral classifiers consistently and confidently misclassified the unseen pneumonia subtype into their own disease class (hallucination)

records.title: Evaluation of Bladder Dysfunction Outcomes Among Standardized Bladder Shapes in Children With Spina Bifida.
records.clinical_problem: Whether bladder shape on fluoroscopic imaging is associated with filling pressures and bladder dysfunction in children with spina bifida, and standardizing bladder-shape terminology.
records.patient_population: 417 pediatric and adolescent patients with spina bifida who underwent video urodynamics, median age 2.6 years
records.model_description: Unsupervised machine-learning cluster analysis is applied to fluoroscopic bladder images from video urodynamics to group bladder shapes objectively, compared against standardized expert classifications (round/oblong/Christmas tree, smooth/trabeculated), and related to bladder filling pressures and dysfunction.
records.dataset_size: 417 patients (fluoroscopic bladder images from video urodynamics)
records.headline_result: Clusters with more trabeculated-appearing bladders had statistically significantly higher filling pressures

records.title: Illuminating radiogenomic signatures in pediatric-type diffuse gliomas: insights into molecular, clinical, and imaging correlations. Part I: high-grade group.
records.clinical_problem: synthesizing molecular, clinical and imaging (MRI) correlations in pediatric-type high-grade diffuse gliomas, including emerging AI/radiomics approaches to imaging biomarkers
records.patient_population: children with pediatric-type high-grade diffuse glioma (literature review)
records.model_description: Narrative review of radiological-molecular correlations in pediatric-type high-grade diffuse gliomas (diffuse midline glioma H3 K27-altered, diffuse hemispheric glioma H3 G34-mutant, H3/IDH-wildtype glioma, infant-type hemispheric glioma), highlighting emerging AI-based radiomics and deep-learning approaches for imaging biomarkers of molecular subtype.

records.title: TransSeg: Leveraging Transformer With Channel-Wise Attention and Semantic Memory for Semi-Supervised Ultrasound Segmentation.
records.journal: IEEE journal of biomedical and health informatics
records.clinical_problem: Segmenting the pubic symphysis and fetal head on transperineal ultrasound to calculate the angle of progression, which quantifies fetal head descent during labor, without needing large amounts of manually annotated data.
records.patient_population: FH-PS-AoP transperineal ultrasound dataset (size not stated)
records.model_description: TransSeg uses a Vision Transformer backbone with a Channel-wise Cross Attention mechanism and a Semantic Information Storage module to semi-supervised-ly segment the pubic symphysis and fetal head on transperineal ultrasound images, using both labeled and unlabeled data, to compute the angle of progression.
records.headline_result: TransSeg outperformed existing mainstream semi-supervised segmentation methods across all evaluation metrics (numeric values not given)

records.title: Integrating snapshot ensemble learning into masked autoencoders for efficient self-supervised pretraining in medical imaging.

records.model_description: Snap-MAE, a self-supervised masked-autoencoder pretraining method using snapshot ensemble learning, is fine-tuned for multi-label pediatric thoracic disease classification (among other medical imaging tasks) and compared against standard MAE, ViT-S, and ResNet-34 baselines.

records.title: How consistent is the interpretation of renal scarring in pediatric patients using technetium-99m dimercaptosuccinic acid scintigraphy.
records.exclusion_reason: Interobserver/intraobserver reliability study of human DMSA scan interpretation; no AI/ML model applied (mentioned only as future work).

records.title: Deep adversarial learning identifies ADHD-specific associations between apoptotic genes and white matter microstructure in frontal-striatum-cerebellum circuit.
records.model_family: adversarial deep canonical correlation analysis deep learning model

Interpretable deep learning analysis then identifies which white matter regions and genes contribute to ADHD-specific versus non-specific associations.

records.study_design: cross-sectional case-control cohort study, technical development

records.title: Chinese expert consensus on imaging examination and diagnosis of nasal cavity and paranasal sinus tumors.

records.title: Comparison of BoneXpert and IB-Lab-PANDA automated Bone Age Evaluation in Children With Growth and Puberty Disorders.
records.clinical_problem: comparing agreement between two commercial automated bone-age assessment programs in children with growth and puberty disorders
records.patient_population: 521 left-hand radiographs of children aged 2-19 years
records.model_description: Two commercially available AI bone-age assessment programs, BoneXpert and IB-Lab-PANDA, are compared against each other and against manual Greulich-Pyle ratings on hand radiographs, across age, sex, puberty and diagnosis subgroups.
records.release_evidence: BoneXpert(R) and IB-Lab-PANDA(R) described as commercially available AI bone age assessment programs
records.dataset_size: 521 radiographs (213 compared to manual Greulich-Pyle reference)
records.headline_result: Mean absolute deviation 0.61 years between the two AI methods; BoneXpert significantly more accurate in prepubertal children (MAD 0.7 vs 0.83 years, P=.027)

records.title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence into Perinatal Care Pathways: A Scoping Review of Reviews of Applications, Outcomes, and Equity.
records.clinical_problem: Synthesizing what AI/ML applications across the perinatal continuum (fertility, prenatal imaging, postpartum, neonatal care) have been shown to do, and their equity implications

records.model_description: Scoping review of 39 reviews of AI/ML applications across perinatal care, including deep-learning fetal ultrasound anatomy segmentation and anomaly detection, gestational-age/fetal-weight prediction, and neonatal risk-prediction tools (e.g., sepsis, retinopathy of prematurity, necrotizing enterocolitis)
records.headline_result: Deep-learning fetal anatomy segmentation exceeded 90% overlap with expert annotation; anomaly detection sensitivity exceeded 93%

records.title: Machine Learning and Feature Selection in Pediatric Appendicitis.
records.model_family: random forest, logistic regression, LightGBM, GANDALF
records.clinical_problem: predicting diagnosis, management and severity of pediatric appendicitis using clinical and ultrasound data
records.patient_population: 781 pediatric patients aged 0-18, 2016-2023, single center (Germany)
records.model_description: Multiple machine learning models (random forest, logistic regression, LightGBM, and a tabular deep learner GANDALF), paired with various feature-selection methods, predict pediatric appendicitis diagnosis, management and severity, evaluated with and without ultrasound image-descriptive features.
records.headline_result: Diagnosis: 98.1% accuracy, AUROC 0.993 (random forest with LGBM feature selection); ultrasound features significantly improved diagnostic accuracy

records.title: Computer-aided reading of chest radiographs for paediatric tuberculosis: current status and future directions.

records.model_description: Review of computer-aided detection (CAD) approaches, largely using transfer learning from existing deep learning CXR models, for pediatric tuberculosis screening, diagnosis and severity stratification; discusses the current lack of approved pediatric CAD systems and the need for large pediatric CXR datasets.
records.release_evidence: CAD systems ... have been developed and approved for tuberculosis triage in adults but not in children

records.title: A Fully Automated Analysis Pipeline for 4D Flow MRI in the Aorta.
records.model_family: series of deep learning networks (background-phase correction, noise masking, velocity anti-aliasing, 3D segmentation)
records.clinical_problem: automating quantitative assessment of aortic hemodynamics from 4D flow MRI
records.patient_population: 379 subjects (mean age 43.5±18.6 years) including 147 healthy controls, 147 with bicuspid aortic valve, 10 with mechanical valve prostheses, and 75 pediatric patients with hereditary aortic disease
records.model_description: A fully automated pipeline integrates a series of previously validated deep learning networks to replace manual steps in 4D flow MRI processing (background-phase correction, noise masking, velocity anti-aliasing, aortic 3D segmentation), automatically quantifying pulse wave velocity, peak velocity, and flow energetics, including in a pediatric subgroup with hereditary aortic disease.
records.dataset_size: 379 subjects, including 75 pediatric patients with hereditary aortic disease
records.headline_result: automated pipeline succeeded in 365/379 (96%); close correlation with manual analysis (r≥0.99)

records.title: Evaluating Hemodynamic Changes in Preterm Infants Using Recent YOLO Models.

records.patient_population: Preterm infants (echocardiographic waveform datasets)
records.model_description: YOLO-based deep learning models automatically detect and measure five key cardiac parameters (LVET, LVIDd, LVIDs, HES, RR interval) from echocardiographic waveforms to assess cardiac function and screen for PDA-related hemorrhagic complications in preterm infants.
records.headline_result: detection accuracies: 97.56% (LVET), 88.69% (LVIDd), 99.50% (LVIDs), 82.29% (HES), 81.15% (RR interval)

records.title: Clinical Failure of General-Purpose AI in Photographic Scoliosis Assessment: A Diagnostic Accuracy Study.

records.title: Quantifying "Medical Renal Disease": A Pediatric Pilot Study Using Ultrasound Radiomics for Differentiating Acute Kidney Injury and Chronic Kidney Disease.

records.release_evidence: 124 advanced texture features were extracted using the open-source ©PyFeats
records.headline_result: XGBoost macro-averaged F1 score 0.90

records.title: FBStrNet: Automatic Fetal Brain Structure Detection in Early Pregnancy Ultrasound Images.

records.headline_result: outperforms state-of-the-art methods; inference time 11.5 ms

records.title: Altered neuronal network connectivity in children with fetal alcohol spectrum disorder and its association with inhibitory function.
records.exclusion_reason: Seed-based functional connectivity group comparison and correlation analysis; no AI/ML model built

records.title: Accuracy of Large Language Models in Detecting Cases Requiring Immediate Reporting in Pediatric Radiology: A Feasibility Study Using Publicly Available Clinical Vignettes.

records.title: Development of a Deep-Learning Model for Estimating Newborn Gestational Age via Lumbar Vertebral Segmentation on Plain Radiography.

records.title: Canadian radiology: 2025 update.
records.exclusion_reason: Broad multi-topic overview of Canadian radiology research; pediatric AI mentioned only briefly among many unrelated topics, not the article's focus.

records.title: HarmonicEchoNet: Leveraging harmonic convolutions for automated standard plane detection in fetal heart ultrasound videos.
records.clinical_problem: automated detection of standard fetal echocardiography views to identify congenital heart conditions
records.patient_population: fetal echocardiography from two private studies (PULSE and CAIFE)
records.model_description: HarmonicEchoNet uses harmonic convolution blocks (DCT-based decomposition) and a harmonic spatial/channel squeeze-and-excitation module to automatically detect standard fetal heart views in transverse-sweep or freehand ultrasound video, aiding acquisition for congenital heart disease screening.
records.dataset_size: four datasets from two private studies (PULSE, CAIFE)

records.title: Deep learning-based prediction of axillary pathological complete response in patients with breast cancer using longitudinal multiregional ultrasound.
records.exclusion_reason: adult breast cancer population, no pediatric component

records.title: Personalized MRI-based characterization of subcortical anomalies in Ataxia-Telangiectasia using deep-learning.

records.title: Role of artificial intelligence in congenital heart disease.

records.title: Automated system of analysis to quantify pediatric hip morphology.

records.title: FaithfulNet: An explainable deep learning framework for autism diagnosis using structural MRI.

records.dataset_size: ABIDE-II public structural MRI dataset (size not stated)
records.headline_result: Classification accuracy of 99.74% with AUC of 1

records.title: Using deep learning to predict internalizing problems from brain structure in youth.
records.model_family: deep learning model using structural MRI brain measures
records.clinical_problem: predicting current and future internalizing problems (anxiety and depression) in youth from structural brain MRI
records.patient_population: youth from four large-scale datasets: ABCD, Healthy Brain Network, HCP-Development, and Province of Ontario Neurodevelopmental network (N=14,523 cross-sectional; N=10,540 longitudinal)

records.headline_result: Cross-sectional model AUC 0.80 [95% CI 0.71-0.88]; longitudinal model AUC 0.66 [0.65-0.67] in the general population, AUC 0.80 [0.78-0.81] in an external test set of primarily neurodevelopmental conditions, AUC 0.73 [0.70-0.76] across all neurodevelopmental conditions
records.study_design: cross-sectional and longitudinal multi-dataset cohort study
