records.title: Population-specific calibration and validation of an open-source bone age AI.
records.model_family: deep learning bone age model (Deeplasia) with sex-specific linear recalibration
records.clinical_problem: skeletal maturity / bone age assessment
records.patient_population: Georgian children undergoing hand radiography for bone age assessment (retrospective cohort of 381 pediatric hand radiographs)
records.model_description: The model takes a hand radiograph and outputs an estimated bone age. The existing open-source deep learning tool Deeplasia was recalibrated with a sex-specific linear correction fit on 121 Georgian children's hand radiographs, rated by seven local pediatric radiologists and endocrinologists, to produce Deeplasia-GE, then tested on a held-out set of 260 images.
records.dataset_size: 381 pediatric hand radiographs (121 used for calibration, 260 held out for testing)
records.headline_result: Calibration reduced mean absolute difference from 6.57 to 5.69 months on the held-out test set (n=260); Deeplasia-GE had smaller error than any of the individual human raters.

records.dataset_size: pretraining on CheXpert and ChestX-ray14; fine-tuning/evaluation on PediCXR
records.headline_result: CurriMAE outperforms ResNet, ViT-S, and standard MAE on PediCXR (specific metric not given)

records.title: Validity of machine learning algorithms for automatically extract growing rod length on radiographs in children with early-onset scoliosis

records.title: A fully automated measurement of migration percentage on ultrasound images in children with cerebral palsy

records.model_description: A pipeline combining signal filtering, convolutional neural networks, and U-Nets segments the regions of interest and detects landmarks on hip ultrasound images to automatically compute migration percentage (MP), the standard measure of hip displacement severity in cerebral palsy, as a radiation-free alternative to the conventional X-ray-based measurement.
records.dataset_size: 62 hips (36 used for training with augmentation, 8 for validation, 18 for testing)
records.headline_result: ICC(2,1) of 0.86 and mean absolute difference of 6.5%+-5.5% between automated ultrasound-based MP and manual X-ray-based MP; automated measurement took an average of 104 seconds per hip

records.title: Ultra-Low-Field Paediatric MRI in Low- and Middle-Income Countries: Super-Resolution Using a Multi-Orientation U-Net
records.clinical_problem: super-resolution reconstruction of ultra-low-field MRI to improve paediatric neurodevelopmental imaging in low-resource settings
records.patient_population: infants scanned with paired ultra-low-field and high-field MRI

It was trained and evaluated on paired ultra-low-field and high-field infant brain MRI data.
records.headline_result: improved deep brain structure (caudate) volume estimation versus prior state-of-the-art methods: linear correlation r=0.94 (vs. 0.84), concordance correlation 0.94 (vs. 0.80), mean error 0.05 cm3 (vs. 0.36 cm3)

records.title: Automatic skeletal maturity grading from pelvis radiographs by deep learning for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
records.journal: Medical and Biological Engineering and Computing

records.clinical_problem: skeletal maturity (Risser stage) assessment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis evaluation and treatment
records.patient_population: adolescents with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis undergoing pelvis radiography
records.model_description: A multi-task deep learning approach extracts the iliac region from pelvis radiographs and forwards it to an improved Swin Transformer to automatically grade Risser stage, a skeletal-maturity measure used in scoliosis evaluation and treatment, aiming to reduce inter- and intra-observer variability seen with manual grading. Grad-CAM visualization was used to interpret model predictions, and code was released on GitHub.
records.headline_result: Overall accuracy 81.53% for Risser stage assessment, improving on ResNet50 (+5.85%), ResNet101 (+4.6%), Uni-former (+3.6%), Next-ViT (+2.7%), ConvNeXt (+2.25%), and the original Swin Transformer (+1.8%)

records.title: Analysis of Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip Using Deep Learning Techniques
records.model_family: EfficientNet (B0/B1/B2) CNN with SVM and KNN classifiers

records.model_description: Hip ultrasound images were classified with EfficientNet convolutional neural networks (B0, B1, B2 variants), without manual image annotation, first into normal (Type 1) versus dysplastic hips, then into four Graf sub-types based on the alpha angle. records.headline_result: accuracy 0.9577 (EfficientNetB1) for 2-class classification and 0.8571 (EfficientNetB0) for 4-class classification; with added classifiers, up to 0.99-1.00 (2-class) and 0.97 (4-class)

records.dataset_size: Mexican boys aged 7-9 years (sample size not given numerically)
records.headline_result: High correlation with AMRA Researcher reference (R2=0.98 for ASAT, R2=0.95 for VAT, both P<1e-11); no significant difference in means (ASAT P=0.1765, VAT P=0.7757); reproducibility coefficients 0.32 L (ASAT) and 0.17 L (VAT)

records.title: Artificial Intelligence in Bone Age Assessment of Pediatric Hand-Wrist X-Rays: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Studies from 2019–2024

records.title: Development of deep learning-based classification models for opacity differentiation in pediatric chest radiography

records.dataset_size: 1,297 chest radiographs (500 consolidation, 499 atelectasis, 298 without opacities)
records.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation study

records.model_family: deep learning framework with multiscale quality-aware fusion module and clustering-based mix-up (CMX) augmentation
records.body_region: fetal (general, anatomical structures visualized on prenatal ultrasound)

records.title: Towards growth-accommodating deep learning-based semantic segmentation of pediatric hand phalanges
records.model_family: compared FCN-8, FCN-32, U-Net, Inception U-Net, and DeepLabv3+ semantic segmentation networks

records.patient_population: pediatric subjects, from near-skeletally-mature adolescents to younger children, undergoing hand radiography
records.model_description: Five deep learning segmentation networks (FCN-8, FCN-32, U-Net, Inception U-Net, DeepLabv3+) were trained and compared to segment individual hand phalanges on radiographs, first using near-skeletally-mature subjects, then testing strategies (synthetic scaling-based augmentation and incremental substitution of real pediatric data) to improve generalization to younger pediatric patients whose bone shapes differ due to ongoing growth.
records.headline_result: DeepLabv3+ and Inception U-Net performed best on near-skeletally-mature subjects (Mean IoU 0.899 and 0.887); adding 20% real pediatric training data improved Mean IoU by up to 21.1% on pediatric subjects with no adverse effect on near-skeletally-mature performance

records.title: Chronological age estimation for medico-legal expertise-based on sternoclavicular joint CT images using a deep neural network
records.model_family: deep learning pipeline (nine models compared) with transfer learning for landmark segmentation and age estimation
records.clinical_problem: forensic / medico-legal chronological age estimation
records.patient_population: 742 whole-body CT and 164 pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis CT scans, ages 1-60 years (437 male, 469 female), with fine-tuning and validation subgroups ages 15-35
records.model_description: A deep learning pipeline segments the clavicle volume of interest on sternoclavicular joint CT and estimates chronological age, comparing nine deep learning models and using transfer learning fine-tuned on a smaller age group. The model also classifies age thresholds (over 14 and over 18 years) and ossification stage, and its performance was compared with age assessment by a radiologist and two forensic pathologists.
records.dataset_size: 742 whole-body CT and 164 pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis CT scans (training); fine-tuning and validation groups of 10 scans each
records.headline_result: mean absolute error 4.23 ± 4.49 years in cross-validation (3.30 ± 3.58 years after fine-tuning); AUC 0.99 for age classification (>14 and >18 years); accuracy 0.97 for ossification stage classification

records.headline_result: Dice similarity coefficient 98.02%+-0.8, Hausdorff distance 1.20+-0.68 mm, HC difference -0.08+-1.2 mm, HC absolute difference 1.11+-1.3 mm on the HC18 dataset

records.title: FB-ZWUNet: A deep learning network for corpus callosum segmentation in fetal brain ultrasound images for prenatal diagnostics
records.model_family: U-Net variant with Zernike Attention, Wavelet Attention, and Morphological Constraint modules

records.title: Comparison of nine machine learning models based on multi-parameter MRI radiomics for predicting the risk of cerebral palsy in infants
records.journal: Chinese Journal of Anatomy and Clinics
records.model_family: nine machine learning models compared (logistic regression, decision tree, random forest, k-nearest neighbor, SVM, naive Bayes, gradient boosting machine, LightGBM, XGBoost) on MRI radiomics features
records.clinical_problem: prediction of cerebral palsy risk in infants
records.patient_population: 178 infants aged 4 months to 2 years (89 cerebral palsy, 89 non-cerebral palsy controls), single center; training set n=142, test set n=36
records.model_description: T1- and T2-weighted MRI from infants aged 4 months to 2 years was segmented and 11,190 radiomics features extracted per patient; after feature selection (t-test, LASSO, Z-score normalization), nine machine learning algorithms were trained to predict cerebral palsy risk, with performance compared by ROC analysis and the best model further evaluated with five-fold cross-validation.
records.dataset_size: 178 infants (89 cerebral palsy, 89 non-cerebral palsy controls); training set n=142, test set n=36

records.title: Artificial Intelligence-based Characterization of Fetal Facial Motor Activity Patterns Using 4D Ultrasound Imaging

records.release_evidence: a commercial AI engine (Visage|SDK) for facial landmark tracking
records.headline_result: Estimated AI frame-level detection success averaged 70.4%; FBAI scores higher during verbal interaction and stimulating music than baseline/calming stimuli (P<0.05); moderate correlation between FBAI and fetal heart rate (r=0.52)

records.title: 8K Fetal Ultrasound Imaging: Why So Skeptical? A Critical Evaluation of Clinical, Ethical, and Diagnostic Limits

records.release_evidence: AI-enhanced 8K fetal ultrasound imaging, a rapidly emerging technology marketed as a breakthrough in prenatal diagnostics

records.title: Deformable symmetry attention for nuclear medicine image segmentation
records.model_family: attention module combined with existing CNN and transformer-based segmentation models
records.body_region: whole body (bone scan), chest, and brain across different experiments
records.clinical_problem: segmentation of lesions in noisy nuclear medicine images and other medical images, leveraging anatomical symmetry
records.patient_population: adolescents undergoing whole-body bone scans, among other imaging cohorts used to validate the general method
records.model_description: Deformable Symmetry Attention (DSA) is an attention module that exploits left-right anatomical symmetry to improve automated lesion segmentation on grainy nuclear medicine images. It reflects the image to leverage symmetry, applies deformable registration to correct local anatomical variation, and redistributes attention with learnable Gaussian kernels to address pixel-level noise. It was combined with CNN and transformer segmentation models and tested on several tasks, including lesion segmentation on adolescent whole-body bone scans, 3D MRI brain tumor segmentation, and chest X-ray anatomical segmentation.
records.headline_result: 3.8% to 8.48% Dice improvement segmenting lesions in adolescent whole-body bone scans; 2.88% improvement in 3D MRI brain tumor segmentation; 0.63% to 10.57% improvement in chest X-ray anatomical segmentation

records.patient_population: pediatric brain tumor cases from the BraTS-PED 2024 dataset
records.model_description: This study tests whether adding T1w/T2w ratio maps, a voxel-wise combination of T1- and T2-weighted MRI signal previously used to study cortical architecture, as extra input channels improves nnU-Net segmentation of pediatric brain tumor subregions on the BraTS-PED 2024 dataset.
records.headline_result: T1w/T2w ratio maps did not improve nnU-Net segmentation performance for pediatric brain tumor subregions

records.title: Artificial intelligence iterative reconstruction for low-dose chest CT images of infants with congenital heart disease
records.journal: Chinese Journal of Medical Imaging Technology
records.clinical_problem: low-dose chest CT image quality for congenital heart disease imaging
records.patient_population: infants with congenital heart disease undergoing chest CT
records.model_description: This prospective study compared an AI-based iterative reconstruction algorithm (AIIR) with conventional hybrid iterative reconstruction (HIR) for low-dose chest CT in infants with congenital heart disease. Low-dose scans reconstructed with AIIR were compared subjectively and objectively against low-dose HIR images and conventional-dose HIR images. AIIR-reconstructed low-dose images matched the image quality of conventional-dose images while lowering the effective dose.
records.headline_result: Subjective scores of low-dose AIIR images did not differ from conventional-dose HIR images (most comparisons P>0.05); effective dose fell from 0.85 mSv (conventional) to 0.09 mSv (low-dose).

records.title: Ai-Driven Predictive Medicine: Geometric Morphometrics for Assisted Scoliosis Diagnosis
records.model_family: Geometric Morphometric Methods (GMM) with Elastic Net logistic regression (landmark-based, not deep learning)
records.clinical_problem: non-invasive screening for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, aiming to reduce radiographic exposure
records.patient_population: 168 individuals (135 with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, 33 controls)
records.model_description: Automatic landmark extraction from 3D torso surface scans is combined with geometric morphometric analysis and principal component analysis to derive shape variables, which are then classified with a regularized (Elastic Net) logistic regression model to detect adolescent idiopathic scoliosis without radiographs.
records.headline_result: AUC 0.925, sensitivity 93%, specificity 86%, balanced accuracy 89% on an unseen test set

records.title: The Accuracy of Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) for TB Diagnosis Among Children in Zambia

records.model_description: Three commercial computer-aided detection (CAD) systems for chest X-ray - CAD4TB_v7, qXR_v4, and InferRead DR Chest - were evaluated for their ability to identify TB-consistent findings on children's chest radiographs, compared against a microbiological reference standard (Xpert Ultra), a composite reference standard, and consensus reads by six expert human readers.
records.release_evidence: 3 CAD systems (CAD4TB_v7, qxr_v4, and InferRead DR Chest (InfV))
records.dataset_size: 609 children enrolled; 515 with corresponding GeneXpert Ultra results and CXR outcomes
records.headline_result: Against the microbiological reference standard, CAD4TB_v7 AUC 0.75, qXR_v4 AUC 0.69, InfV AUC 0.54; against the expert-reader reference standard, CAD4TB_v7 AUC 0.81, qXR_v4 AUC 0.83, InfV AUC 0.63

records.title: Unsupervised spatial registration of fetal cranial ultrasound slices for radiomics analysis
records.journal: Journal of Radiation Research and Applied Sciences
records.clinical_problem: spatial registration/localization of 2D fetal cranial ultrasound slices to support standard-plane radiomics analysis of fetal brain development
records.patient_population: 39 cases of mid-gestation fetal 3D ultrasound data
records.model_description: An unsupervised contrastive-learning method predicts the 3D spatial position of 2D fetal cranial ultrasound slices by learning anatomical features of slices at different positions from a retrieval database, without predefined registration standards or manual annotation. It is intended to automate localization of the standard fetal cranial plane for subsequent radiomics analysis, replacing manual probe adjustment.
records.headline_result: plane angle error 6.870 degrees, Euclidean distance 8.969 voxels, normalized cross-correlation 0.882, structural similarity 0.771

records.title: A novel deep learning-based spider wasp optimization approach for enhancing brain tumor detection and physical therapy prediction
records.journal: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine Update
records.model_family: Spider Wasp Optimization (SWO) feature selection combined with K-Nearest Neighbor classifier, using features from a ResNet50V2 residual learning architecture
records.clinical_problem: classification of pediatric brain tumor type
records.patient_population: pediatric patients with brain tumors (brain MRI from King Abdullah Hospital)
records.model_description: The model classifies pediatric brain tumor type from MRI images. Features are extracted with a ResNet50V2 deep learning architecture, then a Spider Wasp Optimization metaheuristic algorithm selects the most informative features, which are fed into a K-Nearest Neighbor classifier for binary and multiclass tumor classification. It was compared against other deep learning architectures (MobileNetV2, ResNet50V2) and machine learning classifiers (KNN, SVM, Random Forest).
records.dataset_size: brain MRI images from King Abdullah Hospital (exact n not stated)
records.headline_result: SWO+KNN achieved 97.5% accuracy for binary classification and 95.5% for multiclass classification, outperforming other deep learning and machine learning models compared.
records.study_design: retrospective single-center diagnostic accuracy / technical development

records.title: Artificial Intelligence enhanced R1 maps can improve lesion detection in focal epilepsy in children
records.clinical_problem: detection of subtle cortical lesions in pediatric focal epilepsy surgery evaluation
records.patient_population: paediatric focal epilepsy patients (17 MRI-lesion-positive, 14 MRI-negative; 26 evaluable after exclusions), plus 10 healthy volunteers used for network training
records.model_description: A 3D U-Net, trained on paired 3T and 7T MRI from 10 healthy volunteers, enhances quantitative R1 relaxation maps acquired at standard 3T field strength to approximate the image quality of ultra-high-field 7T MRI. It was applied to 3T R1 maps from a separate cohort of pediatric focal epilepsy patients scanned at a different site, and radiologists compared lesion visibility and detection on the AI-enhanced maps versus original 3T maps and 3D-FLAIR.
records.dataset_size: 10 healthy volunteers for training; 17 MRI-positive and 14 MRI-negative pediatric epilepsy patients for application
records.headline_result: Lesions detected on AI-enhanced R1 maps in 14/15 (93%) MR-positive and 4/11 (36%) MR-negative patients, with superior image quality compared to original 3T R1 maps and 3D-FLAIR
records.study_design: retrospective technical development with radiological review

records.clinical_problem: segmentation of pneumonia-infected lung regions on chest CT in children

records.model_description: A dual-encoder deep learning network segments pneumonia-infected regions on pediatric chest CT. A boundary feature enhancement module uses prior contour labels and multi-directional edge detectors with cross-attention to sharpen lesion boundaries, while a channel recalibration module suppresses background noise, together improving segmentation of small, low-contrast infected regions; the network also generalized to adult COVID-19 CT images.
records.headline_result: Dice, Jaccard index, sensitivity and Matthews correlation coefficient improved by 2.99%, 4.76%, 2.56% and 3.03% respectively versus the best-performing comparison network on pediatric pneumonia CT

records.title: Correlations of artificial intelligence measured parameters on anteroposterior and lateral spinal X-ray films with severity of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
records.journal: Chinese Journal of Medical Imaging Technology
records.clinical_problem: quantifying spinal deformity severity in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
records.patient_population: adolescents with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS)
records.model_description: The uAI DR scoliosis analysis system automatically measures multiple spinal alignment parameters (Cobb angle, coronal balance distance, T1 slope, pelvic tilt, sacral slope, apical vertebral translation, thoracic trunk shift, thoracic kyphosis, sagittal vertical axis) from anteroposterior and lateral spinal radiographs. The study correlated these AI-measured parameters with AIS severity and coronal/sagittal balance status in a large retrospective cohort.
records.release_evidence: Parameters were measured using the named 'uAI DR scoliosis analysis System' software product.
records.headline_result: Cobb angle, coronal balance distance, apical vertebral translation and thoracic trunk shift increased significantly with AIS severity (all P<0.001); T1 slope, apical vertebral translation and thoracic trunk shift were independent predictors of severity.

records.title: Domain shifts in infant brain diffusion MRI: Quantification and mitigation for fODF estimation
records.model_family: MLP-based, Transformer-based, and U-Net/CNN-based deep learning architectures (compared)
records.clinical_problem: estimation of fiber orientation distributions from diffusion MRI to study early brain development, addressing generalizability across scanners and protocols
records.patient_population: 488 infant subjects from the developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP) and Baby Connectome Project (BCP)
records.model_description: Three deep learning architectures (MLP-based, transformer-based, and U-Net/CNN-based) were trained to estimate fiber orientation distribution functions from infant diffusion MRI, and their robustness to domain shifts (scanner/protocol differences, age, number of input gradient directions) was systematically evaluated. Two adaptation strategies, method-of-moments and fine-tuning, were tested to correct inter-site domain shift, with fine-tuning giving the best results.
records.headline_result: U-Net outperformed other models with fewer diffusion gradient directions; performance plateaued from 28-45 input directions across all models; fine-tuning outperformed method-of-moments for correcting inter-site domain shift

records.title: PW-GAN: Pseudo-Warping Field Guided GAN for Unsupervised Denoising of Fetal Brain MRI Images
records.clinical_problem: image-quality improvement for reconstructed fetal brain MRI to support prenatal neural disorder diagnosis
records.patient_population: fetuses undergoing fetal brain MRI (simulated and in vivo data)
records.model_description: PW-GAN is an unsupervised generative adversarial network that denoises 3D fetal brain MRI volumes reconstructed from motion-corrupted thick-slice scans. It treats denoising as an unpaired style-transfer problem between low- and high-quality MRI domains and adds a pseudo-deformation-field module, based on optical flow, to keep structures consistent between adjacent slices while removing residual noise and interpolation artifacts.
records.dataset_size: not stated precisely (simulated and in vivo data)
records.headline_result: Outperforms existing unsupervised denoising models and achieves performance on par with several state-of-the-art supervised methods

records.title: Intersecting effects of social circumstances and transcendent thinking on mid-adolescents’ longitudinal functional connectome development
records.model_family: machine learning predictor analysis on graph-theoretic functional connectome measures
records.clinical_problem: predicting longitudinal functional brain network development in mid-adolescents from social circumstances and psychological disposition
records.patient_population: Mid-adolescents from low-socioeconomic-status contexts followed longitudinally with fMRI (n=65)
records.model_description: Longitudinal (2-year) resting-state fMRI graph-theory metrics were computed to characterize functional brain network (FBN) development in mid-adolescents. Machine learning analysis identified transcendent thinking (a psychological disposition) and community violence exposure, but not IQ, as the principal predictors of FBN change, with effects differing by parental education and violence exposure subgroup.
records.headline_result: Machine learning identified transcendent thinking and community violence exposure, but not IQ, as principal predictors of functional brain network change.
records.study_design: longitudinal resting-state fMRI study with machine learning predictor analysis

records.title: Recognition of normal fetal echocardiogram based on an explainable denosing deep learning model
records.model_name: GSCAViT (grouped sharing convolutional attention - vision transformer)
records.model_family: vision transformer with denoising group-sharing convolutional attention module
records.clinical_problem: classification of standard fetal echocardiographic views
records.patient_population: 358 fetuses undergoing cardiac ultrasound examinations
records.model_description: GSCAViT is a deep learning model that classifies seven standard fetal echocardiogram view types (e.g., three-vessel and trachea, four-chamber, aortic arch, bicaval, outflow tracts) from ultrasound images. It combines a denoising group-sharing convolutional attention module with a vision transformer, and uses SHAP explainability to visualize which image features drive classification.
records.headline_result: Accuracy 97.1%, precision 97.1%, recall 97.0%, F1-score 97.0% in validation; AUCs of 0.994, 0.928, and 0.932 on three separate test sets

records.title: Improving Pneumonia Diagnosis with Radimagenet: A Deep Transfer Learning Approach
records.clinical_problem: pneumonia detection on chest X-ray

Performance was compared across six evaluation metrics to test whether a medically pretrained backbone improves classification on a small pediatric imaging dataset.
records.dataset_size: not stated precisely (chest X-ray images of children aged 1-5)
records.headline_result: RadImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 outperformed ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 across six evaluation metrics for pediatric pneumonia detection

records.title: PIOFSF: A deep learning-based pediatric inferior orbital fracture screening framework
records.model_family: 3D diffusion and symmetrical attention-based frequency-domain adaptive global feature network (DSA-FAGFNet), CNN-based
records.clinical_problem: screening for pediatric orbital fractures
records.patient_population: children undergoing head/orbital CT for suspected orbital fracture
records.model_description: PIOFSF is a deep learning pipeline for screening pediatric orbital fractures on CT: it performs 3D reconstruction, corrects for head tilt so the orbits are symmetrically aligned, localizes the orbits using clustering and a Hough transform, then classifies fracture presence with a 3D network (DSA-FAGFNet) combining diffusion-based orbital position coding, symmetrical attention and frequency-domain feature extraction, aiming to catch subtle fractures that are often missed or misdiagnosed as other conditions in children.
records.headline_result: F1 score 82.50%
records.study_design: retrospective technical development / diagnostic accuracy study

records.title: Comparison of three artificial intelligence-assisted bone age assessment methods for predicting adult height in girls
records.journal: Chinese Journal of Endocrinology and Metabolism
records.model_family: AI-assisted bone age assessment (architecture not stated), applied to three established prediction formulas (Bayley-Pinneau, Tanner-Whitehouse 3, China 05)
records.clinical_problem: skeletal maturity (bone age) assessment for adult height prediction in girls with pubertal disorders
records.patient_population: 278 female children undergoing pubertal development assessment at Shenzhen Children's Hospital, 2014-2020, followed until adult height was reached
records.model_description: AI-assisted bone age assessment of left-hand-wrist radiographs was used to apply three adult-height prediction methods (Bayley-Pinneau, Tanner-Whitehouse 3, and China 05) in girls followed to adult height, comparing which method most accurately predicted final adult height and how errors varied by age, bone age delay/advancement, and pubertal stage.
records.headline_result: TW3 and BP methods overestimated adult height by 2.6+-3.0 cm and 1.7+-3.7 cm; China 05 underestimated by 2.3+-3.5 cm; proportion of predictions within +-5 cm of final height: TW3 80.0%, BP 77.0%, China 05 74.2% (P=0.038)

records.title: A Novel Real-Time Deep Learning Screening for Prenatal and Neonatal Biliary Atresia Diagnosis for Ghost Gallbladders: Better Interpretation and More Novice-Friendly
records.model_name: NRDLS (Novel Real-time Deep Learning method for Ultrasound Screening)
records.model_family: ensemble deep learning model with transfer learning; two-stage detection and classification
records.clinical_problem: screening and diagnosis of biliary atresia via gallbladder localization ('ghost gallbladder') in prenatal and neonatal jaundice
records.patient_population: neonates aged 25-77 days with obstructive jaundice at first diagnosis; also addresses prenatal fetal gallbladder screening
records.model_description: NRDLS is a two-stage deep learning system that localizes the fetal or neonatal gallbladder (including difficult-to-find 'ghost' gallbladders) on ultrasound and then classifies the images to diagnose biliary atresia. It fuses information from both views with a gated multi-scale attentive fusion module and applies an anatomical constraint loss reflecting vertebral geometry to stabilize predictions. It was evaluated on the public AASCE challenge dataset and a private hospital dataset, showing high agreement with radiologists' assessments.

records.title: Machine Learning and Deep Learning Predictive Models for Diagnosis and Prognosis in Pediatric Patients with Brain Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
records.model_family: machine learning and deep learning models (various, pooled across included studies)
records.clinical_problem: pediatric brain tumor diagnosis (tumor type, molecular subtype) and prognosis (survival)
records.patient_population: pediatric patients with brain cancer imaged with MRI, pooled across included studies
records.model_description: A systematic review and meta-analysis of machine learning and deep learning models applied to MRI in pediatric brain cancer. Included studies used ML/DL to predict tumor type (e.g., distinguishing pilocytic astrocytoma, medulloblastoma, ependymoma), molecular markers (e.g., BRAF mutation/fusion in low-grade glioma), or prognosis (overall, progression-free, or event-free survival). Reporting quality was assessed with TRIPOD+AI and risk of bias with PROBAST+AI.
records.headline_result: Among low-risk-of-bias studies, median AUC 0.85 (IQR 0.82-0.94) for diagnostic models and 0.88 (IQR 0.86-0.89) for prognostic models; no consistent trend of deep learning outperforming machine learning or of models outperforming clinical experts

records.title: Establishment and validation of an artificial intelligence model for ultrasound image quality control in early pregnancy
records.model_family: deep learning-based image quality assessment system
records.clinical_problem: quality control and standardization of first-trimester ultrasound screening planes
records.patient_population: fetuses at 11 to 13+6 weeks gestation undergoing routine first-trimester ultrasound at a single hospital, 2018-2024
records.model_description: PSAIS is a deep-learning system trained on 17,910 static first-trimester ultrasound images across 8 quality-control planes to automatically recognize anatomical structures and assess image quality/standardization, split into training (12,536), test (3,582) and validation (1,792) sets. Its output was compared against two expert sonographers using intraclass correlation and Kappa statistics, and its processing speed was compared to manual quality control.
records.dataset_size: 17,910 images from first-trimester ultrasound exams (First Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University, 2018-2024)
records.headline_result: mAP >0.800 for anatomical structure recognition on all 8 planes; ICC 0.678-0.843 and Kappa 0.530-0.768 agreement with two experts; total processing time 413s vs. 77,008-94,918s for manual QC (P<0.001)
records.study_design: retrospective single-center technical development and reader-comparison study

records.title: Application of a hybrid artificial intelligence model integrating view detection and structural segmentation in evaluating cardiac function of anemic fetuses
records.model_family: hybrid AI model combining view detection and structural segmentation (deep learning)
records.clinical_problem: quantitative assessment of fetal cardiac size, morphology and function in fetal anemia
records.patient_population: 47 fetuses: 15 anemic (diagnosed via umbilical venous puncture) and 32 normal controls, 2018-2024
records.model_description: A hybrid AI model combining four-chamber view detection with structural segmentation extracts a panel of fetal cardiac size, shape, and function measurements (chamber lengths, ventricular diameters, sphericity indices, strain, fractional area change and shortening) and their Z-scores from four-chamber echocardiographic ultrasound videos. It was used to compare anemic and normal fetuses, and its measurement agreement with conventional fetal HQ software was assessed by intraclass correlation.
records.dataset_size: 47 fetuses (15 anemic: 44 videos/1,056 segments; 32 control: 46 videos/1,104 segments)
records.headline_result: AI-based measurements agreed well with conventional fetal HQ technology (ICC 0.788 control, 0.837 anemia); anemic fetuses showed larger right ventricular dimensions, lower ventricular sphericity indices, and reduced LVGLS/LVFAC (P<0.05 to P<0.001)

records.title: Value of artificial intelligence in assisting ultrasound residents training for the identification，measurement and diagnosis of fetal nuchal translucency thickness
records.clinical_problem: nuchal translucency measurement and screening for fetal abnormality
records.patient_population: fetuses undergoing first-trimester nuchal translucency ultrasound; retrospective images used to train ultrasound resident sonographers
records.model_description: An AI model automatically identifies the nuchal translucency (NT) plane on fetal ultrasound images and measures NT thickness. In this study it was used as a training aid: after an initial round of independent NT identification, measurement and diagnosis, two resident sonographers received additional AI-assisted training, then all sonographers performed a second independent round that was compared to a fetal medicine expert's blinded review. The AI model itself was not the subject of an accuracy evaluation here, only its effect on trainee performance.
records.headline_result: AI-assisted training significantly improved NT measurement standardization rate in both resident sonographers (chi2=25.768 and 17.035, both P<0.05) and diagnostic accuracy in one resident (chi2=10.180, P<0.05); traditional lecture-only training produced no significant improvement in the middle-age sonographer

records.title: AI-Powered Segmentation and Prognosis with Missing MRI in Pediatric Brain Tumors
records.model_family: dropout-trained nnU-Net (3D CNN) with modality-dropout training, compared to generative image synthesis and heuristic imputation
records.clinical_problem: pediatric brain tumor segmentation and prognosis when MRI sequences are missing from the exam
records.patient_population: children with pediatric brain tumors: 715 patients from the Children's Brain Tumor Network and BraTS-PEDs, plus 43 patients with longitudinal MRI from PNOC003/007 clinical trials
records.model_description: An nnU-Net tumor segmentation model was trained with random dropout of FLAIR and/or non-contrast T1-weighted sequences to simulate incomplete pediatric brain tumor MRI exams. It was compared against a generative image-synthesis model and simple copy-substitution/zeroing heuristics for handling missing sequences. The evaluation is unusually thorough about the things that decide whether a measurement is usable: repeatability on repeat scans in the same scanner, reproducibility across scanners, and accuracy against actual birth weight. It correctly identified every fetus below the tenth birth-weight centile, and found three referred as normal who were in fact below the third.
records.headline_result: Dice 0.973, repeatability coefficient 4.01%, ICC 0.99; estimated weight differed from birth weight by -0.39% on average; correctly predicted all 18 fetuses below the 10th birth-weight centile
records.study_design: retrospective study with repeatability and reproducibility analysis

records.title: The unintended consequences of artificial intelligence in paediatric radiology.
records.clinical_problem: the harms AI can cause in a pediatric setting that are not visible from its accuracy figures
records.patient_population: children imaged in radiology practice
records.model_description: A deliberately sceptical companion to the enthusiastic reviews: it works through AI ethics, bias, limitations and unintended consequences for patients, for society and for the profession, with attention to what is specific about a pediatric population. Worth reading alongside the position statements rather than instead of them.

records.title: Research priorities for diagnostic instrumentation in urinary incontinence.

records.title: Machine learning and regression analysis for age estimation from the iliac crest based on computed tomographic explorations in an Indian population.

records.title: Validation of machine-learning model for first-trimester prediction of pre-eclampsia using cohort from PREVAL study.

records.title: Evaluation of height prediction models: from traditional methods to artificial intelligence.

records.release_evidence: BoneXpert is referenced with a registered trademark (BoneXpert®) as an existing automated commercial bone age reading method

records.title: Brain Functional Connectome Defines a Transdiagnostic Dimension Shared by Cognitive Function and Psychopathology in Preadolescents.
records.clinical_problem: identifying a brain-connectivity-based transdiagnostic dimension linking cognition and psychopathology risk in preadolescents
records.patient_population: 11,875 youths (ages 9-10 years at baseline) from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study
records.model_description: Takes resting-state functional MRI connectome data as input and outputs a latent brain-connectivity pattern, identified via canonical correlation analysis, that is associated with cognitive function and psychopathology and is evaluated for its ability to predict future psychiatric diagnosis transitions over 2-year follow-up.
records.headline_result: 5-fold cross-validation correlation ρ=0.68-0.73 (training set), ρ=0.56-0.58 (test set); heritability h²=74.42%

records.title: Can lung airway geometry be used to predict autism? A preliminary machine learning-based study.

records.headline_result: Cross-validation accuracy ~89%, sensitivity 94%, specificity 78%

records.title: Deep-learning model for prenatal congenital heart disease screening generalizes to community setting and outperforms clinical detection.
records.journal: Ultrasound in obstetrics & gynecology : the official journal of the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology
records.model_family: deep learning classifier, previously trained at a tertiary center
records.clinical_problem: congenital heart defects missed at the routine second-trimester anomaly scan in a low-risk population
records.patient_population: 66 pregnancies with isolated severe congenital heart disease and 42 normal fetuses from a Dutch region, screened in community practice in 2015-2016
records.model_description: Takes a model developed on tertiary-center images and tests it on stored images from ordinary community screening, which is the transfer that usually breaks. It did not: the model reached 91% sensitivity where the original clinical reading had caught only half the cases, and where three blinded human experts working from the same stored images averaged 55%. Model correctness varied with image quality, which points at where the remaining errors come from.
records.headline_result: model sensitivity 91% and specificity 78%, versus 53% sensitivity for the original clinical diagnosis and 55% for blinded human experts on the same stored images

records.title: Performance of machine-learning approach for prediction of pre-eclampsia in a middle-income country.

records.exclusion_reason: Clinical/biomarker prediction model for pre-eclampsia using maternal characteristics, serum biomarkers, and a Doppler pulsatility-index value; not an image-analysis AI model.

records.title: Prenatal diagnosis of hypoplastic left heart syndrome on ultrasound using artificial intelligence: How does performance compare to a current screening programme?

records.patient_population: Fetal four-chamber ultrasound views (patients not further quantified in the abstract), compared against national/local screening programme data
records.model_description: A ResNet-based classifier takes four-chamber fetal cardiac ultrasound views as input and outputs a prediction of hypoplastic left heart syndrome, calibrated as either a high-sensitivity or high-specificity model and compared to the current national screening programme's detection performance.
records.headline_result: Current screening programme: sensitivity 94.3%, specificity 99.985%; AI model either sensitivity 100%/specificity 94.0% or sensitivity 93.3%/specificity 100% depending on calibration; AI alone performed slightly worse than the screening programme
records.study_design: retrospective comparative study of AI model versus real-world national screening programme performance

records.title: Development and validation of an artificial intelligence assisted prenatal ultrasonography screening system for trainees.

records.patient_population: fetuses 18-32 weeks gestation, images from 2017-2018; validated on 836 videos (12,697 images) from four hospitals

records.headline_result: internal validation multiclass macro-average AUC 0.943 (95% CI 0.815-1.000); external validation AUC 0.958 (0.864-1.000); micro-average AUC 0.974/0.973; 90.9% accurate labeling of similar-to-standard views
records.study_design: retrospective multicenter development and external validation study

records.headline_result: Parental sensory profile predicted offspring ASD likelihood with 71.4% accuracy

records.title: Detection of fetal facial anatomy in standard ultrasonographic sections based on real-time target detection network.

records.title: External validation of an artificial intelligence solution for the detection of elbow fractures and joint effusions in children.
records.model_family: commercial deep learning fracture and effusion detection

records.patient_population: 712 children (mean age 7.3 years, range 7 months to 15 years) presenting consecutively to an emergency room with elbow trauma
records.model_description: An external validation on consecutive real emergency attendances, scored four ways including detection of joint effusion, which is the finding that matters most in a child's elbow because the fracture itself frequently is not visible. Eleven senior radiologists set the reference. The authors end on the number a department should weigh: 8% of the radiographic sets the algorithm called normal came from children who did have a traumatic lesion.
records.release_evidence: external validation of an AI solution
records.headline_result: sensitivity above 89% on all four approaches, highest at 95.0% for lesion detection; specificity 63-77%; 8% of sets ruled out by the algorithm belonged to children with a genuine traumatic lesion

records.title: Deeplasia: deep learning for bone age assessment validated on skeletal dysplasias.
records.model_family: ensemble of convolutional neural networks, prior-free

records.title: Interpretable and intervenable ultrasonography-based machine learning models for pediatric appendicitis.

records.model_description: The model predicts through an intermediate layer of concepts a clinician can read and correct — appendix diameter, wall layering, free fluid — rather than straight from pixels to a label. That means a radiologist who disagrees can intervene on the concept rather than override a black box. It matched comparable black-box networks on the same data, and it does not require the time-consuming image annotation at deployment.
records.headline_result: AUROC 0.80 and area under the precision-recall curve 0.92 for diagnosis, comparable to black-box networks on the same dataset

records.title: FHUSP-NET: A Multi-task model for fetal heart ultrasound standard plane recognition and key anatomical structures detection.

records.title: Artificial intelligence-based detection of paediatric appendicular skeletal fractures: performance and limitations for common fracture types and locations.
records.clinical_problem: which pediatric fracture types a marketed AI tool actually detects, including indirect signs and dislocations that earlier studies ignored
records.patient_population: up to 1,000 radiographs per body part from a single emergency department, children aged 0-18
records.model_description: The most clinically pointed of the fracture-detection validations, because it breaks performance down by injury type rather than reporting one headline number. Overall accuracy is high for forearm and lower leg, but the tool essentially missed the characteristically pediatric injuries: toddler's fractures, trampoline fractures, proximal tibial Salter-Harris II, and one of eleven radial and none of seven ulnar bowing fractures. Elbow dislocation sensitivity was 66% with a 50% positive predictive value.
records.release_evidence: assessment of an existing AI tool, BoneView (Gleamer, Paris, France)
records.dataset_size: up to 1,000 radiographs per body part; 607 lower leg, 1,137 forearm and 517 elbow fractures
records.headline_result: forearm sensitivity 92.9% and specificity 98.1%; lower leg 87.5%/87.5%; elbow sensitivity 80.5%; bowing fractures and several pediatric-specific fracture types largely undetected; elbow dislocation sensitivity 65.8% with 50% positive predictive value

records.model_description: Diffusion tensor imaging white matter estimates from 18 international sites were combined into the largest OCD DTI dataset to date. records.title: Using brain structural neuroimaging measures to predict psychosis onset for individuals at clinical high-risk.

records.model_description: Trains on the clinical high-risk individuals who later converted versus healthy controls, harmonizing subcortical volume, cortical thickness and surface area across 21 sites before modelling. Applied to the non-converters and the unknown-outcome group, most were classified as healthy, which is the behaviour a screening tool should show. Accuracy falls from 85% in training to 73% in the independent confirmatory set.
records.headline_result: 85% accuracy on training and 73% on the independent confirmatory dataset; 30% of converters classified as healthy versus 73% of non-converters and 80% of unknown-outcome individuals

records.title: Artificial Intelligence to Determine Fetal Sex.

records.headline_result: Accuracy 88.27%, Cohen's kappa 0.843; AUC 0.896-0.981 across classes

records.title: Role of artificial-intelligence-assisted automated cardiac biometrics in prenatal screening for coarctation of aorta.
records.journal: Ultrasound in obstetrics & gynecology : the official journal of the International Society of Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology
records.model_family: AI plane detection and biometry feeding a logistic regression predictor
records.clinical_problem: coarctation of the aorta, which is missed before birth in about 60% of cases and where prenatal detection changes survival
records.patient_population: 73 fetuses with a postnatal diagnosis of coarctation and 7,300 matched healthy controls from four Danish regions, 2008-2018
records.model_description: Rather than classifying the image directly, the model finds the standard cardiac planes and measures them automatically, and those measurements — ventricle areas and lengths, right-to-left ventricle area ratio, great vessel diameter ratio — go into a conventional regression. That makes the prediction inspectable in terms clinicians already use, at the routine 18-22 week anomaly scan rather than at a specialist referral.
records.headline_result: area under the ROC curve 0.96, with 90.4% sensitivity at 88.9% specificity

records.title: Fibre orientation atlas guided rapid segmentation of white matter tracts.
records.model_family: atlas-based direct tract mapping (compared with deep-learning method TractSeg)
records.clinical_problem: rapid, robust segmentation of white matter fiber tracts on diffusion MRI for neurosurgical planning, including in pediatric and adult brain tumor patients
records.patient_population: two public healthy diffusion MRI datasets (TractoInferno, Human Connectome Project) plus a clinical dataset comprising pediatric and adult brain tumor scans
records.model_description: Input: diffusion MRI fiber orientation distribution data; output: tract-specific probability maps of white matter tract location, generated by registering atlas-derived orientation/spatial priors (built from 10-20 training samples) to the subject, avoiding streamline tractography at application time.
records.dataset_size: 10-20 training samples for atlas construction; evaluated on public datasets (TractoInferno, HCP) plus a pediatric and adult brain tumor clinical dataset
records.headline_result: high agreement with established techniques (streamline tractography, TractSeg); processing time <3 min per subject; higher robustness on tumor/resection scans
records.study_design: retrospective method development and comparative evaluation

records.title: Estimating cortical thickness trajectories in children across different scanners using transfer learning from normative models.

records.model_description: Input is structural MRI-derived regional cortical thickness; a large-scale normative model trained across the lifespan is transferred to a longitudinal pediatric cohort scanned on unseen scanners, producing scanner-independent individual deviation scores from expected cortical thickness.
records.dataset_size: reference model N=42,993; transferred to longitudinal cohort N=6,285 children (three scan waves, two scanners)
records.headline_result: a transfer set of as few as 25 samples per site achieved good performance; deviation scores detected morphological heterogeneity in individuals born preterm

records.dataset_size: 88,063 images for development, 8,187 images for evaluation

records.title: Altered White-Matter Functional Network in Children with Idiopathic Generalized Epilepsy.

records.title: Commercially available artificial intelligence tools for fracture detection: the evidence.

records.title: Radiation reduction for interventional radiology imaging: a video frame interpolation solution.

records.title: MRI-based synthetic CT for assessment of the bony elements of the sacroiliac joints in children.
records.clinical_problem: assessing the bony sacroiliac joints in children, which conventionally needs a CT and therefore ionizing radiation
records.patient_population: 10 children aged 9-16 (mean 14 years) who had a PET-CT and an additional MRI

Two readers compared synthetic against real CT on specific bony features — cortical delineation, joint facet defects, growth plate fusion, ossified nuclei, bony bridges — and on quantitative measurements, with agreement from substantial to perfect. The cohort is very small, which is the main limitation on the equivalence claim.
records.headline_result: perfect agreement for cortical delineation, bony bridges and joint facet defects; measurements statistically equivalent to CT within a 1 mm margin; inter-reader ICC 0.806-0.998

records.title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Label Free-Text Operative and Ultrasound Reports for Grading Pediatric Appendicitis.

records.model_description: Not a diagnostic model but a data-extraction one, and the comparison is against trained human abstractors rather than against a machine baseline. Of the discordant fields, 98% of the errors were the humans'; the model assigned the appendicitis severity grade wrongly in 3% of cases against 28% manually, and worked roughly forty times faster. Anyone building a pediatric imaging dataset from an electronic record should read this before hiring abstractors.
records.headline_result: 98% of discordant-field errors were in manual extraction; appendicitis grade misassigned in 28.2% of cases manually versus 2.9% by the model, about 40 times faster
records.study_design: retrospective comparison against manual data extraction

records.title: Intelligent ultrafast total-body PET for sedation-free pediatric [18F]FDG imaging.

records.title: AI-Assisted X-ray Fracture Detection in Residency Training: Evaluation in Pediatric and Adult Trauma Patients.
records.model_family: machine learning fracture detection algorithm used as a reading aid

records.patient_population: 200 radiographs from patients aged 1 to 95 (mean 40.7 years), half containing at least one fracture, read by four residents of differing experience
records.model_description: A reader study framed around residency training rather than around the algorithm. Residents gained 19 points of sensitivity with the aid, at essentially no cost in specificity, with the largest gains for the least experienced. The authors raise the training question directly: a tool that lifts a trainee to expert-level detection also removes the errors trainees learn from.
records.headline_result: resident sensitivity rose from 58% to 77% with AI (p < 0.001) with specificity unchanged; stand-alone AI sensitivity 93% at 77% specificity; interpretation time fell and confidence rose

records.headline_result: Superior performance compared to recent similar ASD-classification studies (exact accuracy not given in abstract)

records.title: Impact of Deep Learning Denoising Algorithm on Diffusion Tensor Imaging of the Growth Plate on Different Spatial Resolutions.

records.title: Human-Level Differentiation of Medulloblastoma from Pilocytic Astrocytoma: A Real-World Multicenter Pilot Study.

records.headline_result: AUC 0.986; 62/64 (97%) correct diagnoses in test set; on par with pediatric neuro-oncology experts, better than inexperienced readers (p<0.05)

records.title: Diagnosis for autism spectrum disorder children using T1-based gray matter and arterial spin labeling-based cerebral blood flow network metrics.

records.title: Artificial intelligence improves resident detection of pediatric and young adult upper extremity fractures.
records.model_family: open-access deep learning fracture detection algorithm
records.clinical_problem: upper extremity fractures missed by residents and pediatricians, who read most of these radiographs first
records.patient_population: 240 patients (mean age 11.3 years, range 0-22, 37.9% female) with elbow, hand, humerus, wrist, forearm and clavicle radiographs
records.model_description: An openly accessible model, which is unusual in this literature and is the point: it is available at childfx.com rather than sold. Seven readers across three experience levels read the same cases with and without it. Residents and pediatric residents improved substantially; subspecialist musculoskeletal radiologists did not. With the model, residents reached the same accuracy as unaided subspecialists, and everyone read faster.
records.release_evidence: an open-source artificial intelligence algorithm at https://www.childfx.com
records.headline_result: radiology resident AUC rose from 0.768 to 0.876 and pediatric resident AUC from 0.706 to 0.844 (both p < 0.001), with no significant gain for subspecialists; residents with AI matched unaided subspecialists (0.863 vs 0.867); reading time fell from 52.1 to 38.9 seconds
